/**
 * Short commit stamped into the APK so every collector run record names the
 * exact code that produced it. A record without it cannot be compared with the
 * source after a fix; a missing git (source zip) simply records "unknown".
 */
val gitHash: String = runCatching {
    providers.exec { commandLine("git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD") }
        .standardOutput.asText.get().trim()
}.getOrDefault("unknown")

/*
 * One signing key for every machine that builds this app.
 *
 * Without it each computer signs with its own ~/.android/debug.keystore, and an
 * APK built on one machine cannot update the copy installed from another
 * (2026-11-02: the phone held a build signed by a second PC, so the laptop's
 * fix could only be installed by uninstalling, which loses the guard's data,
 * accessibility grant and battery exemption).
 *
 * The keystore and its passwords stay out of the repo, in the uncommitted
 * local.properties:
 *
 *     rewardadguard.signing.storeFile=D:\\Claude\\keystore\\<file>.keystore
 *     rewardadguard.signing.storePassword=...
 *     rewardadguard.signing.keyAlias=...
 *     rewardadguard.signing.keyPassword=...
 *
 * When they are missing the build still works with the machine's default debug
 * key, but warns that the APK will not update a phone installed from elsewhere.
 */
val localProps = Properties().apply {
    val file = rootProject.file("local.properties")
    if (file.isFile) file.inputStream().use { load(it) }
}
val sharedKeystore = localProps.getProperty("rewardadguard.signing.storeFile")
    ?.let { file(it) }
    ?.takeIf { it.isFile }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
  Debug-only manifest overlay.

  This file is merged only into the debug variant, so the release APK does not
  contain the test entry point at all. DebugTestActivity additionally checks
  BuildConfig.DEBUG before doing anything.

  Purpose: run the rewarded-ad behaviour tests on demand, without spending the
  once-per-day ad. See TOOLS/auto_test.ps1 and TOOLS/auto_test.md.

  HISTORY, measured on the POCO X6 Pro (2311DRK48G, Android 16 / HyperOS V816):
  an earlier DebugTestReceiver driven by `adb shell am broadcast` was
  UNREACHABLE, because a broadcast from the shell cannot force-start a stopped
  app's process - it reaches ActivityManager and `am` still prints
  `Broadcast completed: result=0`, but no process starts and onReceive never
  runs. `exported="true"` did not help, and adding a `signature` permission only
  added a second way to fail.

  The receiver has been REMOVED (ISS-09): with the shell unable to drive it, and
  all scripts on DebugTestActivity, it was dead weight whose command set had
  drifted from the Activity's.

  ADB-driven tests use DebugTestActivity below, whose explicit Activity start has
  no "existing process" escape hatch: with `exported="false"` it fails loudly
  with a SecurityException, which is exactly the behaviour a test instrument
  needs.
-->
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">

    <application>
        <!--
          The entry point that `adb shell` can actually reach.

          `exported="true"` is REQUIRED here, and this is measured, not assumed:
          with `exported="false"` the shell is rejected with
          `SecurityException: Permission Denial: starting Intent {...} from null
          (pid=..., uid=2000) not exported from uid <app>`.

          Unlike the broadcast case, an Activity start from the shell has no
          "start an already-running process" escape hatch, so `am start -n` on a
          non-exported activity fails loudly. That loud failure is the reason this
          is the reliable test entry point.

          Exposure is bounded by: this overlay is debug-only (never merged into
          release), and DebugTestActivity re-checks BuildConfig.DEBUG on create.
          The shipped APK IS the debug build, though, so the activity also
          requires android.permission.DUMP: adb shell (uid 2000) holds it, an
          ordinary installed app cannot. Without it any app on the phone could
          start collector_run (automatic taps) or turn the guard off (review
          P0-2, 2026-11-12).
        -->
        <activity
            android:name="com.rewardadguard.app.debug.DebugTestActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:permission="android.permission.DUMP"
            android:noHistory="true"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:launchMode="singleTask"
            android:theme="@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.NoActionBar" />
    </application>

</manifest>

package com.rewardadguard.app.debug

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import android.widget.TextView
import com.rewardadguard.app.BuildConfig
import com.rewardadguard.app.RewardAdGuardApp
import com.rewardadguard.app.collector.CollectorController
import com.rewardadguard.app.collector.CollectorEngine
import com.rewardadguard.app.collector.CollectorProfiles
import com.rewardadguard.app.collector.CornerGlyphDetector
import com.rewardadguard.app.collector.ScreenReader
import com.rewardadguard.app.data.AssistAction
import com.rewardadguard.app.data.ProtectionMode
import com.rewardadguard.app.data.RedirectPolicy
import com.rewardadguard.app.manager.MonitoringState
import com.rewardadguard.app.manager.RewardAppsRepository.AddResult
import com.rewardadguard.app.service.RewardAdAccessibilityService
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancel
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File

/**
 * Debug-only entry point for scripted tests, started with `am start`.
 *
 * ### Why this exists
 *
 * A broadcast receiver cannot be driven from `adb shell` on modern Android.
 * Measured on the device (Android 16 / HyperOS V816):
 *
 * * `am broadcast` reaches `ActivityManager` (`Broadcasting:` in logcat) but the
 *   target process is **never started** (`ps -A` stays empty, no `FATAL`), because
 *   a broadcast from the shell cannot force-start a stopped app's process.
 * * `Broadcast completed: result=0` therefore means "nothing ran", not "success".
 *   Making the receiver `exported="true"` does **not** help; neither does adding a
 *   `signature` permission (it only adds a second, independent way to fail, since
 *   `com.android.shell` does not hold an app-private signature permission).
 *
 * An explicit **Activity** started by `am start -n` is guaranteed to work, which is
 * the fallback the original debug manifest comment pointed at. This class is that
 * entry point. The old `DebugTestReceiver` has been removed (ISS-09).
 *
 * ### Safety
 *
 * Debug variant only (`src/debug`), declared `exported="true"` in the debug
 * manifest (it must be, so `adb shell am start` can reach it; a non-exported
 * Activity fails loudly with a `SecurityException` - see the debug manifest for
 * the measured detail), and every command re-checks [BuildConfig.DEBUG]. It does
 * not exist in a release build (this overlay is never merged into release), and
 * the debug receiver covers in-process use only.
 *
 * ### Usage
 *
 * ```text
 * adb shell am start -n com.rewardadguard.app/com.rewardadguard.app.debug.DebugTestActivity \
 *     -f 0x10008000 --es cmd set_assist_action --es value ASSIST_WHEN_IDLE
 * adb shell am start -n com.rewardadguard.app/com.rewardadguard.app.debug.DebugTestActivity \
 *     -f 0x10008000 --es cmd dump_settings
 * adb shell am start -n com.rewardadguard.app/com.rewardadguard.app.debug.DebugTestActivity \
 *     -f 0x10008000 --es cmd collector_snapshot
 * adb shell am start -n com.rewardadguard.app/com.rewardadguard.app.debug.DebugTestActivity \
 *     -f 0x10008000 --es cmd collector_corners
 * adb shell am start -n com.rewardadguard.app/com.rewardadguard.app.debug.DebugTestActivity \
 *     -f 0x10008000 --es cmd collector_run --es apps bitwalk --es limit 0 --es dryrun true
 * ```
 *
 * > **Never add `-S`.** `-S` force-stops the app, which unbinds the accessibility
 * > service and makes a working build look broken ??see [onNewIntent] and
 * > `ANALYSIS_REPORT.md` 禮3. `-f 0x10008000` is `FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK |
 * > FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK`; combined with [onNewIntent] it re-runs the command
 * > without killing the process.
 *
 * Output goes to **two** places on purpose:
 *
 * 1. logcat, under `RewardAdGuardDebug` (a unique tag, so `adb logcat -s` is
 *    unambiguous ??the production service logs under `RewardAdGuardService` and the
 *    old receiver under `RewardAdGuard`, which is easy to get wrong);
 * 2. the activity's own `TextView`, for when logcat is unavailable.
 */
class DebugTestActivity : Activity() {

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        handleCommand()

        // NOTE: onNewIntent() below re-runs the same dispatch when a second
        // `am start` targets this already-running Activity. That pairing is what
        // lets the script omit `-S` (see the onNewIntent doc comment).
    }

    /**
     * Re-runs the test command when an `am start` lands on this already-live
     * Activity.
     *
     * ### Why this method exists (do not delete it)
     *
     * `TOOLS/auto_test.ps1` used to pass `-S` to every `am start`, because without
     * it the second command reaches the existing instance and `onCreate` never runs
     * again ??the Activity just sits there and logcat replays the previous output.
     *
     * But `-S` means **force-stop the app first**, and force-stopping unbinds the
     * accessibility service (`AccessibilityManagerService.onHandleForceStop`
     * strips it from `enabled_accessibility_services`). The test tool was therefore
     * killing the very service it was trying to measure, producing a convincing
     * but false "this ROM never binds the service" conclusion.
     *
     * Implementing `onNewIntent()` fixes the original problem at its source: the
     * script drops `-S` (it now uses `-f 0x10008000`, NEW_TASK | CLEAR_TASK) and
     * each command is still executed, while the process ??and therefore the bound
     * accessibility service ??stays alive.
     *
     * `setIntent()` is required: without it `getStringExtra()` inside
     * [runCommand] would return the *first* intent's extras forever.
     */
    override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent)
        setIntent(intent)
        handleCommand()
    }

    /**
     * Cancels the command scope when the Activity goes away (ISS-04).
     *
     * The manifest sets `android:noHistory="true"`, so the Activity is destroyed
     * as soon as it loses the foreground; without this, a command that is still
     * reading DataStore/Room would finish and then call [report] on a destroyed
     * window.
     */
    override fun onDestroy() {
        scope.cancel()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    /**
     * Dispatches whatever command the current intent carries.
     *
     * Split out of [onCreate] so both the first launch and every subsequent
     * `am start` (via [onNewIntent]) go through exactly the same path.
     */
    private fun handleCommand() {
        // Defence in depth: the debug manifest plus this check means a release
        // build can never expose these hooks even if the manifest is mis-merged.
        if (!BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
            Log.w(TAG, "not a debug build; refusing to run test command")
            finish()
            return
        }

        val command = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_COMMAND)
        val app = applicationContext as? RewardAdGuardApp
        if (app == null) {
            report("FAILED: application is not RewardAdGuardApp")
            return
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "test command=$command package=${intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PACKAGE)}")
        if (command == CMD_REMINDER_FIRE) {
            // Posts the reset reminder now for --es apps (default: all), so its
            // ???嗅? button can be tested without waiting for the alarm.
            val keys = com.rewardadguard.app.collector.CollectorProfiles
                .resolve(intent.getStringExtra("apps")).map { it.key }
            com.rewardadguard.app.collector.RewardReminders.notifyReset(
                applicationContext,
                com.rewardadguard.app.collector.ScheduleEntry(0L, 0, 0, keys)
            )
            Log.i(TAG, "RESULT OK: REMINDER_POSTED ${keys.joinToString(",")}")
            finish()
            return
        }
        if (command == CMD_COLLECTOR_RESUME) {
            // A run paused for the user (??App, ?怠?) has no 蝜潛? button when it
            // was started from here (2026-11-17).
            com.rewardadguard.app.service.RewardAdAccessibilityService.instance?.collectorRuntime()?.resume()
            Log.i(TAG, "RESULT OK: RESUME_REQUESTED")
            finish()
            return
        }
        if (command == CMD_COLLECTOR_STOP) {
            CollectorController.stop()
            Log.i(TAG, "RESULT OK: STOP_REQUESTED")
            finish()
            return
        }

        if (command == CMD_COLLECTOR_SNAPSHOT || command == CMD_COLLECTOR_CORNERS ||
            command == CMD_COLLECTOR_RUN
        ) {
            handleCollectorCommand(app, command)
            return
        }
        scope.launch {
            val outcome = try {
                runCommand(app, command)
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                // Never swallow cancellation (P1#7): scope.cancel() must propagate.
                if (t is kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) throw t
                // A test hook must never take the app down with it.
                Log.e(TAG, "test command '$command' failed", t)
                "FAILED: ${t::class.java.simpleName}: ${t.message}"
            }
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { report(outcome) }
        }
    }

    /** Publishes the outcome to logcat and the window. */
    private fun report(outcome: String) {
        // logcat first: a script reads the RESULT line and must see it even when
        // the window is already gone.
        Log.i(TAG, "RESULT $outcome")
        // `noHistory="true"` means the Activity can be destroyed while the IO
        // coroutine is still running; touching the window afterwards leaks and
        // crashes (ISS-04).
        if (isFinishing || isDestroyed) return
        setResult(if (outcome.startsWith("OK")) RESULT_OK else RESULT_CANCELED)
        setContentView(TextView(this).apply { text = outcome })
    }

    /** Executes one command and returns a `OK:` / `FAILED:` summary. */
    private suspend fun runCommand(app: RewardAdGuardApp, command: String?): String =
        when (command) {
            CMD_DUMP_SETTINGS -> dumpSettings(app)
            CMD_SET_ASSIST_ACTION -> setAssistAction(app)
            CMD_SET_REDIRECT_POLICY -> setRedirectPolicy(app)
            CMD_SET_REWARD_APP -> setRewardApp(app)
            CMD_CLEAR_REWARD_APPS -> clearRewardApps(app)
            CMD_DUMP_REWARD_APPS -> dumpRewardApps(app)
            CMD_SIMULATE_FOREGROUND -> simulateForeground()
            CMD_DUMP_STATE -> dumpState()
            else -> "FAILED: unknown test command '$command'"
        }

    /**
     * Feeds a synthetic foreground transition into the real guard.
     *
     * This is the **only** reason the debug harness exists: it lets the redirect,
     * return and close-button paths be exercised on demand, as often as wanted,
     * without spending the once-per-day rewarded ad.
     *
     * It delegates to [RewardAdAccessibilityService.simulateForeground], which
     * builds a genuine `AccessibilityEvent` and hands it to the production
     * `handleWindowEvent`. Only the trigger is synthetic; the code under test is
     * exactly the shipped code.
     *
     * Reachability caveat, measured on HyperOS (see known-issues.md): some ROMs
     * never *bind* third-party accessibility services even though they list them
     * as enabled. When that happens `instance` is null and `onServiceConnected`
     * has never run, so there is no live object to drive. That case is reported
     * explicitly here instead of silently reporting success.
     */
    private fun simulateForeground(): String {
        val packageName = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PACKAGE)
        if (packageName.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return "FAILED: simulate_foreground needs --es package"
        }
        val service = RewardAdAccessibilityService.instance
            ?: return "FAILED: accessibility service is not bound, so no synthetic " +
                "transition can be delivered. Check dump_state (serviceConnected) and " +
                "whether this ROM actually binds the service."
        service.simulateForeground(packageName)
        // Report the resulting snapshot, so a script can assert on the effect and
        // not merely on the absence of an error.
        val s = MonitoringState.snapshot.value
        return "OK: simulated foreground=$packageName " +
            "sessionState=${s.sessionState} sourcePackage=${s.sourcePackage} " +
            "currentForeground=${s.currentForegroundPackage} " +
            "previousForeground=${s.previousForegroundPackage} " +
            "adSessionActive=${s.adSessionActive} redirectRisk=${s.redirectRisk}"
    }

    /**
     * Persists an [AssistAction] through the production settings repository.
     *
     * `assist_action = NONE` is the nastiest state this app can be in: the guard
     * keeps finding the close button, keeps declining to press it, and every log
     * line looks like an ordinary throttle. This command puts the device into a
     * known-good state and reads it back, so a script can prove the write landed.
     */
    private suspend fun setAssistAction(app: RewardAdGuardApp): String {
        val value = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_VALUE)
        if (value.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return "FAILED: set_assist_action needs --es value <${AssistAction.entries.joinToString("|")}>"
        }
        val action = AssistAction.entries.firstOrNull { it.name.equals(value, ignoreCase = true) }
            ?: return "FAILED: unknown assist action '$value'"

        app.settingsRepository.setAssistAction(action)
        // Read back from disk; trusting the write alone is how NONE hid for so long.
        val persisted = app.settingsRepository.settingsNow().assistAction
        return if (persisted == action) {
            "OK: assistAction=$persisted"
        } else {
            "FAILED: wanted $action but read back $persisted"
        }
    }

    /**
     * Switches the redirect policy and reads it back.
     *
     * BLOCK_AFTER_GRACE (the default) deliberately lets a single, short, low-risk
     * store/browser hop complete (spec test 55); a live ad that only bounces the
     * user for under a second is therefore observed and never blocked.
     * BLOCK_IMMEDIATELY blocks the repeat hops, which is what a comparison of the
     * two policies needs to exercise.
     */
    private suspend fun setRedirectPolicy(app: RewardAdGuardApp): String {
        val value = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_VALUE)
        if (value.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return "FAILED: set_redirect_policy needs --es value <${RedirectPolicy.entries.joinToString("|")}>"
        }
        val policy = RedirectPolicy.entries.firstOrNull { it.name.equals(value, ignoreCase = true) }
            ?: return "FAILED: unknown redirect policy '$value'"
        app.settingsRepository.setRedirectPolicy(policy)
        val persisted = app.settingsRepository.settingsNow().redirectPolicy
        return if (persisted == policy) {
            "OK: redirectPolicy=$persisted"
        } else {
            "FAILED: wanted $policy but read back $persisted"
        }
    }

    /**
     * Adds a package to the monitored list so no real reward app is needed.
     *
     * Defaults (`enabled=true`, mode `BLOCK`) keep a simulated session exercising
     * the active guard rather than the passive LOG_ONLY default. The optional
     * `--es enabled` / `--es mode` / `--es label` extras let a caller restore an
     * *exact* earlier entry, which is how auto_test.ps1 snapshots and restores the
     * user's real list around its tests instead of wiping it.
     */
    private suspend fun setRewardApp(app: RewardAdGuardApp): String {
        val packageName = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PACKAGE)
        if (packageName.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return "FAILED: set_reward_app needs --es package"
        }
        val enabled = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_ENABLED)?.toBooleanStrictOrNull() ?: true
        val modeRaw = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_MODE)
        val mode: ProtectionMode? = when {
            modeRaw == null -> ProtectionMode.BLOCK
            modeRaw.isBlank() || modeRaw.equals("null", ignoreCase = true) -> null
            else -> ProtectionMode.entries.firstOrNull { it.name.equals(modeRaw, ignoreCase = true) }
                ?: return "FAILED: unknown mode '$modeRaw'"
        }
        val result = app.rewardAppsRepository.add(
            packageName = packageName,
            label = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_LABEL),
            enabled = enabled,
            mode = mode
        )
        return if (result == AddResult.ADDED) {
            "OK: reward app set $packageName enabled=$enabled mode=${mode?.name ?: "null"}"
        } else {
            // A refused add must be visible: set_reward_app(com.google.android.inputmethod.latin)
            // used to "succeed" and quietly configure a keyboard as a reward app.
            "FAILED: reward app refused $packageName ($result)"
        }
    }

    private suspend fun clearRewardApps(app: RewardAdGuardApp): String {
        val current = app.rewardAppsRepository.current()
        current.forEach { app.rewardAppsRepository.remove(it.packageName) }
        return "OK: cleared ${current.size} reward app(s)"
    }

    /**
     * Lists the monitored reward apps so a test script can snapshot them.
     *
     * Format: `OK: REWARD_APPS count=N pkg|enabled|mode|label;...`, where an empty
     * `mode` means "no per-app override". `|` and `;` are the delimiters because
     * the whole answer has to survive a single logcat line; labels are scrubbed of
     * them so the split is unambiguous.
     */
    private suspend fun dumpRewardApps(app: RewardAdGuardApp): String {
        val apps = app.rewardAppsRepository.current()
        val encoded = apps.joinToString(";") { a ->
            val label = a.label.replace('|', ' ').replace(';', ' ')
            "${a.packageName}|${a.enabled}|${a.protectionMode?.name ?: ""}|$label"
        }
        return "OK: REWARD_APPS count=${apps.size} $encoded"
    }

    /** Reports the live snapshot, so a script can assert on it. */
    private fun dumpState(): String {
        val s = MonitoringState.snapshot.value
        return "OK: STATE serviceConnected=${s.serviceConnected} " +
            "monitoringActive=${s.monitoringActive} sessionState=${s.sessionState} " +
            "sourcePackage=${s.sourcePackage} currentForeground=${s.currentForegroundPackage} " +
            "previousForeground=${s.previousForegroundPackage} " +
            "adSessionActive=${s.adSessionActive} redirectRisk=${s.redirectRisk}"
    }

    /** Logs every setting the guard consults, so a script can diff the real state. */
    private suspend fun dumpSettings(app: RewardAdGuardApp): String {
        val s = app.settingsRepository.settingsNow()
        return "OK: SETTINGS protectionMode=${s.protectionMode} assistAction=${s.assistAction} " +
            "closeButtonAssistance=${s.closeButtonAssistance} " +
            "externalRedirectProtection=${s.externalRedirectProtection} " +
            "xClickAreaMultiplier=${s.xClickAreaMultiplier} " +
            "smartRedirectEnabled=${s.smartRedirectEnabled} redirectPolicy=${s.redirectPolicy} " +
            "blockGraceMillis=${s.blockGraceMillis} " +
            "newAppSafeModeEnabled=${s.newAppSafeModeEnabled} canBlock=${s.canBlock} " +
            "loggingEnabled=${s.loggingEnabled}"
    }

    /**
     * Read-only collector commands ("dry run").
     *
     * Both commands move this Activity to the back first, because the screen
     * that matters is the one *underneath* it (a reward app or an ad), not the
     * debug window. `noHistory="true"` then destroys the Activity, so the work
     * runs on a process-wide [collectorScope] and reports through logcat: the
     * window is gone by the time the screenshot is analysed.
     *
     * Neither command taps, presses Back, or writes a collector event. They are
     * the phase-1 acceptance tool: prove the phone can *see* before it acts.
     */
    private fun handleCollectorCommand(app: RewardAdGuardApp, command: String) {
        val service = RewardAdAccessibilityService.instance
        if (service == null) {
            Log.i(
                TAG,
                "RESULT FAILED: accessibility service is not bound, so the screen cannot be read. " +
                    "Check dump_state (serviceConnected)."
            )
            finish()
            return
        }
        val activity = this
        val apps = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_APPS)
        val limit = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_LIMIT)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
        val dryRun = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_DRYRUN)?.toBooleanStrictOrNull() ?: false
        collectorScope.launch {
            val outcome = try {
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { activity.moveTaskToBack(true) }
                // The window manager needs a moment to bring the previous screen
                // back before takeScreenshot sees it.
                delay(1_000)
                when (command) {
                    CMD_COLLECTOR_SNAPSHOT -> collectorSnapshot(app, service)
                    CMD_COLLECTOR_CORNERS -> collectorCorners(app, service)
                    else -> collectorRun(app, service, apps, limit, dryRun)
                }
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                if (t is kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) throw t
                "FAILED: ${t::class.java.simpleName}: ${t.message}"
            }
            Log.i(TAG, "RESULT $outcome")
        }
    }

    /**
     * Runs the collection engine. This is the real thing: it launches the
     * reward app, reads screens, taps, handles ads and writes the run record.
     * `dryrun=true` reads and decides but never taps.
     */
    private suspend fun collectorRun(
        app: RewardAdGuardApp,
        service: RewardAdAccessibilityService,
        apps: String?,
        limit: Int,
        dryRun: Boolean
    ): String {
        val environment = service.collectorRuntime()
            ?: return "FAILED: collector runtime is not ready; reconnect the accessibility service"
        val profiles = CollectorProfiles.resolve(apps)
        if (profiles.isEmpty()) {
            return "FAILED: no known app in '${apps ?: ""}' " +
                "(choose bitwalk, ahealth, walkearn, hahago, or all)"
        }
        val results = ArrayList<String>()
        // Same sequence rule as the ?芸??嗅? tab: collector_stop (or a locked
        // phone) during one app must not let the next app start.
        environment.beginSequence()
        com.rewardadguard.app.collector.CollectorRunPolicy.runSequence(
            items = profiles,
            stopRequested = { environment.stopRequested },
            keyguardLocked = { environment.isKeyguardLocked() }
        ) { profile ->
            Log.i(TAG, "RUN start app=${profile.key} dryRun=$dryRun limit=$limit")
            val engine = CollectorEngine(
                service = service,
                environment = environment,
                foreground = service::collectorForeground,
                logger = RewardAdGuardApp.Container.logger,
                selfClicks = service.collectorSelfClicks(),
                profile = profile,
                dryRun = dryRun,
                rewardLimit = limit
            )
            val outcome = engine.run()
            Log.i(
                TAG,
                "RUN end app=${outcome.app} reason=${outcome.endReason} " +
                    "rewards=${outcome.rewards} ads=${outcome.ads} taps=${outcome.taps} " +
                    "timeouts=${outcome.timeouts} redirects=${outcome.redirects} " +
                    "errors=${outcome.errors} dir=${outcome.runDir}"
            )
            results.add("${profile.key}:${outcome.endReason}/rewards=${outcome.rewards}")
            // A stop/pause left behind by a run must not leak into the next app.
            if (environment.state != com.rewardadguard.app.collector.CollectorState.IDLE) {
                environment.stop()
            }
            outcome.endReason
        }
        if (results.size < profiles.size) results.add("sequence_stopped")
        return "OK: RUN dryRun=$dryRun ${results.joinToString(" ")}"
    }

    /**
     * Reads one screen and writes every text box to logcat (`BOX ...`), plus the
     * screenshot to the app's private directory for later comparison.
     */
    private suspend fun collectorSnapshot(app: RewardAdGuardApp, service: RewardAdAccessibilityService): String {
        val reader = ScreenReader(service)
        try {
            val reading = reader.readDetailed(
                foregroundPackage = MonitoringState.snapshot.value.currentForegroundPackage
            )
            val snapshot = reading.snapshot
            Log.i(
                TAG,
                "SNAPSHOT size=${snapshot.width}x${snapshot.height} " +
                    "package=${snapshot.foregroundPackage ?: "-"} boxes=${snapshot.boxes.size} " +
                    "node=${snapshot.nodeCount()} ocr=${snapshot.ocrCount()} " +
                    "ocrMillis=${snapshot.ocrMillis} ocrError=${snapshot.ocrError ?: "-"}"
            )
            for (box in snapshot.boxes) {
                Log.i(
                    TAG,
                    "BOX source=${box.source.name} bounds=${box.bounds} " +
                        "text=${box.text.replace('\n', ' ')}"
                )
            }
            var saved: String? = null
            reading.bitmap?.let { bitmap ->
                val dir = File(app.filesDir, "collector-snapshots").apply { mkdirs() }
                val file = File(dir, "snapshot-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.png")
                val ok = runCatching {
                    FileOutputStream(file).use { out ->
                        bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, out)
                    }
                }.getOrDefault(false)
                if (ok) saved = file.absolutePath
                bitmap.recycle()
            }
            return "OK: SNAPSHOT size=${snapshot.width}x${snapshot.height} " +
                "boxes=${snapshot.boxes.size} node=${snapshot.nodeCount()} ocr=${snapshot.ocrCount()} " +
                "ocrMillis=${snapshot.ocrMillis} ocrError=${snapshot.ocrError ?: "-"} " +
                "file=${saved ?: "-"}"
        } finally {
            reader.close()
        }
    }

    /** Runs the corner `>>` / `X` / `<-` matcher and reports each region's best. */
    private suspend fun collectorCorners(app: RewardAdGuardApp, service: RewardAdAccessibilityService): String {
        val reader = ScreenReader(service)
        try {
            val capture = reader.captureScreen()
            val bitmap = capture.bitmap
                ?: return "FAILED: no screenshot (${capture.error}) in ${capture.elapsedMillis}ms"
            try {
                val detector = CornerGlyphDetector(app)
                for (best in detector.bestPerRegion(bitmap)) {
                    val hit = best.hit
                    if (hit == null) {
                        Log.i(TAG, "CORNER region=${best.regionIndex} bounds=${best.region} best=none")
                    } else {
                        Log.i(
                            TAG,
                            "CORNER region=${best.regionIndex} bounds=${best.region} " +
                                "kind=${hit.kind} score=${formatScore(hit.score)} " +
                                "at=${hit.bounds} center=(${hit.bounds.centerX},${hit.bounds.centerY})"
                        )
                    }
                }
                val hits = detector.find(bitmap)
                for (hit in hits) {
                    Log.i(
                        TAG,
                        "CORNER HIT kind=${hit.kind} region=${hit.regionIndex} " +
                            "score=${formatScore(hit.score)} bounds=${hit.bounds}"
                    )
                }
                val top = hits.firstOrNull()
                return "OK: CORNERS hits=${hits.size} " +
                    "bestKind=${top?.kind ?: "-"} " +
                    "bestScore=${top?.let { formatScore(it.score) } ?: "-"} " +
                    "captureMillis=${capture.elapsedMillis}"
            } finally {
                bitmap.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            reader.close()
        }
    }

    private fun formatScore(value: Double): String = String.format(Locale.US, "%.3f", value)

    companion object {
        /**
         * A dedicated tag. `RewardAdGuard` was already taken by the receiver and
         * `RewardAdGuardService` by the accessibility service, and mixing them up
         * makes `adb logcat -s` silently look empty.
         */
        const val TAG = "RewardAdGuardDebug"

        const val EXTRA_COMMAND = "cmd"
        const val EXTRA_PACKAGE = "package"
        const val EXTRA_VALUE = "value"
        const val EXTRA_LABEL = "label"
        const val EXTRA_MODE = "mode"
        const val EXTRA_ENABLED = "enabled"

        const val CMD_DUMP_SETTINGS = "dump_settings"
        const val CMD_SET_ASSIST_ACTION = "set_assist_action"
        const val CMD_SET_REDIRECT_POLICY = "set_redirect_policy"
        const val CMD_SET_REWARD_APP = "set_reward_app"
        const val CMD_CLEAR_REWARD_APPS = "clear_reward_apps"
        const val CMD_DUMP_REWARD_APPS = "dump_reward_apps"
        const val CMD_SIMULATE_FOREGROUND = "simulate_foreground"
        const val CMD_DUMP_STATE = "dump_state"

        /** Read-only collector dry run: one screen reading, logged box by box. */
        const val CMD_COLLECTOR_SNAPSHOT = "collector_snapshot"

        /** Read-only collector dry run: corner template scores for this screen. */
        const val CMD_COLLECTOR_CORNERS = "collector_corners"

        /** Runs the collection engine; extras apps/limit/dryrun. */
        const val CMD_COLLECTOR_RUN = "collector_run"

        /** Stops a run started by collector_run; safe to call when idle. */
        const val CMD_COLLECTOR_STOP = "collector_stop"

        /** Resumes a paused run (debug only). */
        const val CMD_COLLECTOR_RESUME = "collector_resume"

        /** Posts the reward reset reminder now (debug only). */
        const val CMD_REMINDER_FIRE = "reminder_fire"

        const val EXTRA_APPS = "apps"
        const val EXTRA_LIMIT = "limit"
        const val EXTRA_DRYRUN = "dryrun"

        /**
         * Survives the Activity: `noHistory` destroys it as soon as it is moved
         * to the back, and the collector reading has to finish after that. Only
         * debug builds have this scope, and it never touches the window.
         */
        private val collectorScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
    }
}

    <!--

      Cloud update (2026-11-04, requested by the user). INTERNET is used only
      when the user taps "check for updates": one request to this project's
      GitHub releases, then the APK and its .sha256 file. No data about the
      user, the reward apps or the log is ever sent by the update check.
      Since 2026-11-13 the user can also turn on "?喲?? Telegram" on the
      ?芸??嗅? tab: each run's record then goes to the user's own bot, using a

      lets the verified APK be handed to the system installer, which always
      asks the user to confirm.
    -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />

FILE: app\src\main\java\com\rewardadguard\app\collector\ActionGate.kt

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * Whether the collector may act on what is in front right now.
 *
 * A tap on a screen that does not belong to the target app is how a
 * non-reward app gets operated by mistake (2026-11-12: HAHAGO received Back
 * presses for four minutes while the collector believed it was in LINE). The
 * only safe rule is positive identification: a tap needs the active window to
 * be the target package, and a window the collector cannot identify is
 * treated as foreign.
 */
object ActionGate {

    enum class Action { TAP, BACK, HOME, LAUNCH }

    enum class Decision { ALLOW, DENY, UNKNOWN }

    fun decide(action: Action, foreground: String?, target: String): Decision {
        val fg = foreground?.trim().orEmpty()
        return when (action) {
            // Only ever tap inside the target app.
            Action.TAP -> when {
                fg.isEmpty() -> Decision.UNKNOWN
                fg == target -> Decision.ALLOW
                else -> Decision.DENY
            }
            // Back is how the collector leaves a store page or a browser the
            // ad opened, so a known foreign app is fine; an unknown one is not.
            Action.BACK -> if (fg.isEmpty()) Decision.UNKNOWN else Decision.ALLOW
            // Home and launching the target app cannot operate another app.
            Action.HOME, Action.LAUNCH -> Decision.ALLOW
        }
    }
}

FILE: app\src\main\java\com\rewardadguard\app\collector\ActiveTimeBudget.kt
==============================================================================
package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * A timeout that only counts time the collector was actually running.
 *
 * pc-collector's `Control.checkpoint` subtracts paused time from its deadlines
 * (`paused_seconds`), because a ten-minute ad timeout must not expire while the
 * user has the phone locked. The same rule is needed here, but the comparison
 * has to be testable without a clock, so the caller feeds it monotonic
 * timestamps instead of this class reading one.
 */
class ActiveTimeBudget(private val timeoutMillis: Long) {

    private var lastAt: Long = -1L
    private var activeMillis: Long = 0L
    private var pausedMillis: Long = 0L

    /** Time counted towards [timeoutMillis]. */
    val active: Long get() = activeMillis

    /** Time spent paused since the first [advance]. */
    val paused: Long get() = pausedMillis

    /** Starts the clock. Later calls measure from the previous tick. */
    fun start(nowMillis: Long) {
        lastAt = nowMillis
    }

    /**
     * Accounts for the time since the previous tick. Paused intervals go to
     * [paused] and never towards the timeout. A clock that goes backwards (or
     * repeats) adds nothing.
     */
    fun advance(nowMillis: Long, paused: Boolean) {
        if (lastAt < 0L) {
            lastAt = nowMillis
            return
        }
        if (nowMillis < lastAt) return
        val delta = nowMillis - lastAt
        if (paused) pausedMillis += delta else activeMillis += delta
        lastAt = nowMillis
    }

    fun isExpired(): Boolean = activeMillis >= timeoutMillis

    fun remainingMillis(): Long = (timeoutMillis - activeMillis).coerceAtLeast(0L)
}

/**
 * A monotonic clock that stands still while the collector is paused.
 *
 * The engine's ad deadline, the lottery's 240-second wait and the run cap used
 * the wall clock, so a two-minute pause (locked phone, a finger on the screen)
 * made the ad "time out" the moment the run resumed and the reward was lost
 * (review P1-5, 2026-11-12). Deadlines measured with [activeAt] only count the
 * time the collector was actually running, like [ActiveTimeBudget] does for
 * [Actor.waitFor].
 */
class ActiveClock {

    private var pausedTotal = 0L
    private var pausedAt = -1L

    /** Marks the start of a pause; repeated calls keep the first timestamp. */
    fun pauseStarted(nowMillis: Long) {
        if (pausedAt < 0L) pausedAt = nowMillis
    }

    /** Ends the current pause, if any, and banks its length. */
    fun pauseEnded(nowMillis: Long) {
        if (pausedAt < 0L) return
        if (nowMillis > pausedAt) pausedTotal += nowMillis - pausedAt
        pausedAt = -1L
    }

    /** True between [pauseStarted] and [pauseEnded]. */
    val isPaused: Boolean get() = pausedAt >= 0L

    /** Running time at [nowMillis]: the raw clock minus every pause so far. */
    fun activeAt(nowMillis: Long): Long {
        val ongoing = if (pausedAt >= 0L && nowMillis > pausedAt) nowMillis - pausedAt else 0L
        return nowMillis - pausedTotal - ongoing
    }
}

/**
 * The collector's only way to touch the screen.
 *
 * Every action goes through one class on purpose: the guard has to be able to
 * say "the collector is driving", every click has to be marked as our own (so
 * [SelfClickTracker] stops the guard mistaking it for a finger), and every
 * action has to leave a row in the event log. pc-collector had the same
 * separation (`adb.py`), which is what made its runs auditable.
 */
class Actor(
    private val service: AccessibilityService,
    private val logger: EventLogger,
    private val selfClicks: SelfClickTracker,
    private val sessionId: () -> String?,
    private val stateProvider: () -> CollectorState,
    /**
     * Called between wait polls to let the runtime pause the collector (lock
     * screen, real touch). A lambda instead of a [CollectorEnvironment] so this
     * class stays independent of the environment and usable from a JVM test.
     */
    private val interruptionCheck: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    private val clock: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() },
    private val monotonicClock: () -> Long = { SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() },
    private val pollMillis: Long = DEFAULT_POLL_MILLIS,
    /** The reward app this run works on; null disables the foreground gate (tests). */
    private val targetPackage: String? = null,
    /** The active window's package, read fresh at the moment of acting. */
    private val foregroundNow: (() -> String?)? = null
) {

    /**
     * Taps (x, y).
     *
     * The tap is refused unless the collector is [CollectorState.RUNNING], so a
     * stale coroutine can never click after a pause or stop, and the self-click
     * marker is set *before* dispatch because the system can deliver the
     * resulting `TYPE_VIEW_CLICKED` before the gesture callback returns.
     */
    suspend fun tap(x: Int, y: Int): Boolean {
        // A locked phone or a finger must pause the collector before it acts,
        // not at the next wait poll: no tap and no app launch on a lock screen.
        pauseIfInterrupted()
        if (stateProvider() != CollectorState.RUNNING) {
            log("TAP", "SKIPPED", "collector is not running")
            return false
        }
        if (!foregroundAllows(ActionGate.Action.TAP, "TAP")) return false
        if (FloatingControls.covers(x, y)) {
            // Never press our own ?怠?/?迫 panel by accident.
            log("TAP", "SKIPPED", "x=$x y=$y is on the floating controls")
            return false
        }
        selfClicks.markOwnClick(clock())
        markAction()
        val path = Path().apply { moveTo(x.toFloat(), y.toFloat()) }
        val dispatched = dispatch(path, TAP_DURATION_MILLIS)
        log(
            action = "TAP",
            result = if (dispatched) "SUCCESS" else "FAILED",
            message = "x=$x y=$y"
        )
        return dispatched
    }

    /**
     * Drags from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2) to scroll the reward app (AHEALTH's
     * home goes on below the first screen, 2026-11-14). Same gates as [tap].
     */
    suspend fun swipe(x1: Int, y1: Int, x2: Int, y2: Int, durationMillis: Long = SWIPE_DURATION_MILLIS): Boolean {
        pauseIfInterrupted()
        if (stateProvider() != CollectorState.RUNNING) {
            log("SWIPE", "SKIPPED", "collector is not running")
            return false
        }
        if (!foregroundAllows(ActionGate.Action.TAP, "SWIPE")) return false
        if (FloatingControls.covers(x1, y1) || FloatingControls.covers(x2, y2)) {
            log("SWIPE", "SKIPPED", "path touches the floating controls")
            return false
        }
        selfClicks.markOwnClick(clock())
        markAction()
        val path = Path().apply {
            moveTo(x1.toFloat(), y1.toFloat())
            lineTo(x2.toFloat(), y2.toFloat())
        }
        val dispatched = dispatch(path, durationMillis)
        log("SWIPE", if (dispatched) "SUCCESS" else "FAILED", "($x1,$y1)->($x2,$y2)")
        return dispatched
    }

    private suspend fun dispatch(path: Path, durationMillis: Long): Boolean {
        val gesture = GestureDescription.Builder()
            .addStroke(GestureDescription.StrokeDescription(path, 0L, durationMillis))
            .build()
        val resumed = AtomicBoolean(false)
        val dispatched = try {
            suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
                val started = runCatching {
                    service.dispatchGesture(
                        gesture,
                        object : AccessibilityService.GestureResultCallback() {
                            override fun onCompleted(gestureDescription: GestureDescription?) {
                                if (resumed.compareAndSet(false, true)) continuation.resume(true)
                            }

                            override fun onCancelled(gestureDescription: GestureDescription?) {
                                if (resumed.compareAndSet(false, true)) continuation.resume(false)
                            }
                        },
                        null
                    )
                }.getOrDefault(false)
                if (!started && resumed.compareAndSet(false, true)) continuation.resume(false)
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            if (t is CancellationException) throw t
            false
        }
        return dispatched
    }

    @Volatile
    private var lastActionAt = -1L

    /** Time since the last tap, Back, Home or launch this actor performed; -1 before any. */
    fun sinceLastActionMillis(): Long =
        if (lastActionAt < 0L) -1L else monotonicClock() - lastActionAt

    private fun markAction() {
        lastActionAt = monotonicClock()
    }

    suspend fun back(): Boolean = guardAction("BACK", AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK)

    suspend fun home(): Boolean = guardAction("HOME", AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME)

    /**
     * Starts [packageName] the same way the guard's return controller does:
     * a launcher intent from a background accessibility service, with
     * NEW_TASK so it works without a foreground activity.
     */
    suspend fun launch(packageName: String, fresh: Boolean = false): Boolean {
        pauseIfInterrupted()
        if (stateProvider() != CollectorState.RUNNING) {
            log("LAUNCH", "SKIPPED", "collector is not running")
            return false
        }
        val ok = withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
            try {
                val intent = service.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
                if (intent == null) {
                    false
                } else {
                    intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_RESET_TASK_IF_NEEDED)
                    // fresh: clear the app's task, so an ad activity stacked
                    // on top of it (one Back cannot leave) is gone and the
                    // app opens on its own first screen.
                    if (fresh) intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK)
                    markAction()
                    service.startActivity(intent)
                    true
                }
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                if (t is CancellationException) throw t
                false
            }
        }
        log(
            action = "LAUNCH",
            result = if (ok) "SUCCESS" else "FAILED",
            message = "package=$packageName"
        )
        return ok
    }

    /**
     * Waits for [condition] while respecting pause and stop.
     *
     * Time spent [CollectorState.PAUSED] does not count towards [timeoutMillis]
     * (pc-collector's `paused_seconds` rule): a user who locks the phone for a
     * minute must not make the 10-minute ad timeout expire. Reaching
     * [CollectorState.IDLE] ends the wait at once - "stop" must be immediate,
     * not after the timeout. Between checks, [interruptionCheck] lets the
     * runtime pause the collector when the keyguard comes up or a real finger
     * touches the screen.
     */
    suspend fun waitFor(timeoutMillis: Long, condition: suspend () -> Boolean): Boolean {
        val budget = ActiveTimeBudget(timeoutMillis)
        budget.start(monotonicClock())
        while (true) {
            interruptionCheck?.invoke()

            val state = stateProvider()
            if (state == CollectorState.IDLE) {
                log("WAIT", "SKIPPED", "collector ended")
                return false
            }
            budget.advance(monotonicClock(), paused = state == CollectorState.PAUSED)
            if (state == CollectorState.PAUSED) {
                delay(pollMillis)
                continue
            }
            if (budget.isExpired()) {
                log("WAIT", "FAILED", "timeout after ${timeoutMillis}ms active (paused=${budget.paused}ms)")
                return false
            }
            val matched = try {
                condition()
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                if (t is CancellationException) throw t
                log("WAIT", "FAILED", "condition failed: ${t::class.java.simpleName}: ${t.message}")
                return false
            }
            if (matched) return true
            delay(pollMillis)
        }
    }

    /**
     * A global action is refused unless the collector is running, exactly like
     * [tap]. A pause or stop that lands between a decision and its execution
     * must not let a stale coroutine press Back, go Home, or launch an app.
     */
    private suspend fun guardAction(name: String, action: Int): Boolean {
        pauseIfInterrupted()
        if (stateProvider() != CollectorState.RUNNING) {
            log(name, "SKIPPED", "collector is not running")
            return false
        }
        if (action == AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK &&
            !foregroundAllows(ActionGate.Action.BACK, name)
        ) {
            return false
        }
        markAction()
        val ok = withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
            runCatching { service.performGlobalAction(action) }.getOrDefault(false)
        }
        log(action = name, result = if (ok) "SUCCESS" else "FAILED", message = "global action $action")
        return ok
    }

    /**
     * Re-reads the foreground right before acting. A window that cannot be
     * identified gets a few short retries (it is usually a transition), then
     * the action is refused rather than guessed.
     */
    private suspend fun foregroundAllows(action: ActionGate.Action, name: String): Boolean {
        val target = targetPackage ?: return true
        val read = foregroundNow ?: return true
        var last: String? = null
        repeat(GATE_ATTEMPTS) { attempt ->
            last = runCatching { read() }.getOrNull()
            when (ActionGate.decide(action, last, target)) {
                ActionGate.Decision.ALLOW -> return true
                ActionGate.Decision.DENY -> {
                    log(name, "SKIPPED", "foreground is $last, not $target")
                    return false
                }
                ActionGate.Decision.UNKNOWN -> if (attempt < GATE_ATTEMPTS - 1) delay(GATE_RETRY_MILLIS)
            }
        }
        log(name, "SKIPPED", "foreground app unknown; refusing to act blind")
        return false
    }

    /**
     * Only ever pauses here: an automatic resume belongs to a wait loop, never
     * to the moment a stale decision is about to be executed.
     */
    private fun pauseIfInterrupted() {
        if (stateProvider() == CollectorState.RUNNING) interruptionCheck?.invoke()
    }

    private fun log(action: String, result: String, message: String) {
        logger.log(
            eventType = EventType.COLLECTOR,
            sessionId = sessionId(),
            detectionMethod = "Actor",
            action = action,
            result = result,
            message = message
        )
    }

    companion object {
        /** Long enough for the system to report a real click, short enough to be a tap. */
        const val TAP_DURATION_MILLIS = 60L
        const val SWIPE_DURATION_MILLIS = 450L

        /** One wait poll; also the granularity at which pause/stop is noticed. */
        const val DEFAULT_POLL_MILLIS = 250L

        private const val GATE_ATTEMPTS = 3
        private const val GATE_RETRY_MILLIS = 300L
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * Giving up on an ad early, and remembering the reward for later.
 *
 * Before: an ad with no way out (a playable "??瞍?", a frozen "Ad 1 of 2")
 * held the run for its whole timeout plus two Back waits - about three
 * minutes - and then the same button was tapped again at once. Now an ad that
 * shows no countdown, offers no control and does not change for a minute is
 * abandoned, its reward is retried once after everything else, and a second
 * failure leaves it to the user (2026-11-13).
 */
object AdStuck {

    /** No change, no countdown, nothing to tap: this long means stuck. */
    const val NO_PROGRESS_MILLIS = 60_000L

    fun isStuck(adSeen: Boolean, elapsedMillis: Long, minWatchMillis: Long, sinceProgressMillis: Long): Boolean =
        adSeen && elapsedMillis >= minWatchMillis && sinceProgressMillis >= NO_PROGRESS_MILLIS

    /**
     * Identity of a reward button across passes. LINE's labels carry a count
     * ("?脣?蟡典\n4") that is not part of what the button is, so digits are
     * dropped; the position grid tells two buttons with the same words apart.
     */
    fun deferId(tab: String, target: Target): String {
        val words = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(target.text).filterNot { it.isDigit() }.take(8)
        return "$tab|$words@${target.centerX / GRID},${target.centerY / GRID}"
    }

    /** The button's words for the user: one line, no counts. */
    /**
     * The button's words for the user. Only a line that is just a count
     * ("?脣?蟡典\n17") is dropped; numbers inside the words stay
     * ("?脣?5??BTC" read "?脣???BTC" before, 2026-11-13).
     */
    fun label(text: String): String =
        text.split('\n')
            .map { it.trim() }
            .filter { it.isNotEmpty() && !it.all { ch -> ch.isDigit() } }
            .joinToString(" ")
            .replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")

    /**
     * Video motion counts as progress only this long into an ad, so an
     * animated playable that never ends is still left in the end.
     */
    const val MOTION_PROGRESS_MAX_MILLIS = 90_000L

    private const val SIG_GRID = 12

    /** A coarse gray thumbnail of the screen (12x12 samples). */
    fun signature(bitmap: android.graphics.Bitmap): IntArray? = runCatching {
        val w = bitmap.width
        val h = bitmap.height
        IntArray(SIG_GRID * SIG_GRID) { i ->
            val x = ((i % SIG_GRID) + 0.5) * w / SIG_GRID
            val y = ((i / SIG_GRID) + 0.5) * h / SIG_GRID
            val c = bitmap.getPixel(x.toInt().coerceIn(0, w - 1), y.toInt().coerceIn(0, h - 1))
            ((c shr 16 and 0xFF) * 3 + (c shr 8 and 0xFF) * 6 + (c and 0xFF)) / 10
        }
    }.getOrNull()

    /**
     * True when a fair part of the screen changed between two thumbnails:
     * a playing video. A blinking cursor or a ticking clock moves a sample or
     * two, which is not enough.
     */
    fun imageMoved(previous: IntArray?, current: IntArray?): Boolean {
        if (previous == null || current == null || previous.size != current.size) return false
        val changed = previous.indices.count { kotlin.math.abs(previous[it] - current[it]) > 24 }
        return changed >= previous.size / 10
    }

    /** Bad ads in a row on the same button before it is deferred. */
    const val DEFER_AFTER_STREAK = 2

    fun shouldDefer(streak: Int): Boolean = streak >= DEFER_AFTER_STREAK

    private const val GRID = 80
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * One reward app's rules, ported from pc-collector's per-app profile modules.
 *
 * The PC profile classes are Python class attributes; here they are plain data
 * so the engine has no subclassing and the rules can be exercised against the
 * recorded fixtures on the JVM.
 *
 * Times are milliseconds (the PC values are seconds) and tab points are in the
 * PC's 1220x2712 reference frame; [scaledTabPoint] rescales them to the phone.
 */
/**
 * How to scroll a page for rewards below or beside the first screen.
 * [pages] swipes at most; [horizontal] drags right-to-left along [atY]
 * (a fraction of the screen height) instead of bottom-to-top.
 */
data class TabScroll(val pages: Int, val horizontal: Boolean = false, val atY: Double = 0.5)

data class AppProfile(
    val key: String,
    val name: String,
    val packageName: String,
    val collectionTabs: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val tabPoints: Map<String, Pair<Int, Int>> = emptyMap(),
    /** A collection tab reached through other tabs first, e.g. 隞餃? = ?犖 then 隞餃?. */
    val tabPaths: Map<String, List<String>> = emptyMap(),
    /** Pages that go on past the first screen: how to scroll them for more. */
    val tabScrolls: Map<String, TabScroll> = emptyMap(),
    /**
     * Text that proves the app's own page where there is no tab bar
     * (AHEALTH's 甇亥? page: "??甇交暺").
     */
    val altChromeTerms: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /** The button that closes the app's "reward received" sheet (AHEALTH: 摰?). */
    val doneTerms: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val rewardTerms: List<String>,
    val avoidTerms: List<String>,
    val exactTerms: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val chromeTerms: List<String>,
    val pageMarkers: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /** Title words of the app's own "no ad available" help dialog. */
    val infoDialogTerms: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /**
     * The app's balance on screen; group 1 is the number. A rise after an ad
     * proves the reward was credited (BITWALK: "0.000269 mBTC").
     */
    val balancePattern: Regex? = null,
    /** Extra words that identify a reward dialog (LINE: 撘萇巨?賂???撟?. */
    val dialogTermsExtra: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /** Extra phrases that prove an ad is on screen (LINE: 頛銝?. */
    val adHardMarkersExtra: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /** LINE ??郊頞?only: choice sheet, challenge and banner rules apply. */
    val lineRules: Boolean = false,
    /** LINE ?賣璅?mode: open the sheet and draw instead of collecting tabs. */
    val lotteryMode: Boolean = false,
    val maxBonusFailures: Int = 2,
    val maxLotteryDraws: Int = 600,
    val maxLotteryFailures: Int = 2,
    /** Words of a "watch an ad" button; a vanished tab bar after tapping one means an ad. */
    val adButtonWords: List<String> = listOf("撱??", "敶梁?", "watch", "video"),
    /** (term, page marker): the term is unavailable while the marker is on screen. */
    val unavailablePairs: List<Pair<String, String>> = emptyList(),
    val statusTerms: List<String> = CollectorRules.STATUS_TERMS,
    val adMinWatchMillis: Long,
    val adTimeoutMillis: Long,
    val maxRewards: Int,
    val maxRepeatPerTarget: Int,
    val launchWaitMillis: Long = 6_000L,
    val settleWaitMillis: Long = 2_000L,
    val pollMillis: Long = 1_500L,
    val maxNextAds: Int = 8,
    val cornerSkipGraceMillis: Long = 15_000L,
    val maxCornerSkips: Int = 3,
    val maxBackPresses: Int = 2,
    val endCardTimeoutMillis: Long = 40_000L,
    val maxInstallCardBacks: Int = 3,
    /**
     * Prefer accessibility nodes over OCR. pc-collector set this false because
     * `uiautomator dump` was unusable on BitWalk; on the phone the node tree is
     * the opposite - the primary source - so the default is true.
     */
    val useNodes: Boolean = true,
    val includeInAll: Boolean = true,
    /**
     * Screens the collector must never touch, with what to tell the user
     * (AHEALTH's sleep mode, 2026-11-16: its ??鈭?ends the sleep record).
     * Seeing one skips the app and lists the message for the user.
     */
    val blockerScreens: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    /** One button gives a reward per ad, again and again (BITWALK's ?嗥?撱??敶梁?). */
    val repeatableRewards: Boolean = false
) {

    fun scaledTabPoint(tab: String, screenWidth: Int, screenHeight: Int): Pair<Int, Int>? {
        val raw = tabPoints[tab] ?: return null
        val x = (raw.first * screenWidth / REFERENCE_WIDTH.toDouble()).toInt()
        val y = (raw.second * screenHeight / REFERENCE_HEIGHT.toDouble()).toInt()
        return if (x in 0 until screenWidth && y in 0 until screenHeight) x to y else null
    }

    companion object {
        const val REFERENCE_WIDTH = 1220
        const val REFERENCE_HEIGHT = 2712
    }
}

    val builtIn: List<AppProfile> = listOf(BITWALK, AHEALTH, WALK_EARN, HAHAGO, LINE_WALK, LINE_LOTTERY)

    /**
     * The collector's app list (editable since 2026-11-15): the built-in
     * profiles the user did not hide, then the apps the user added.
     */
    val all: List<AppProfile>
        get() {
            val hidden = CustomApps.hidden.value
            return builtIn.filter { it.key !in hidden } + CustomApps.custom.value.map { it.toProfile() }
        }

    /** What "all" means: special options (LINE lottery) are excluded. */
    val default: List<AppProfile> get() = all.filter { it.includeInAll }

    /** A profile on the current list; a hidden built-in resolves to null. */
    fun byKey(raw: String?): AppProfile? {
        val key = raw?.trim()?.lowercase() ?: return null
        val profile = builtInByKey(key) ?: return all.firstOrNull { it.key == key }
        return profile.takeIf { it.key !in CustomApps.hidden.value }
    }

    private fun builtInByKey(key: String): AppProfile? {
        return when (key) {
            "bitwalk", "bit" -> BITWALK
            "ahealth", "a-health" -> AHEALTH
            "walkearn", "walk-earn", "walk" -> WALK_EARN
            "hahago", "ha" -> HAHAGO
            "linewalk", "line", "line-walk" -> LINE_WALK
            "linelottery", "lottery", "line-lottery" -> LINE_LOTTERY
            else -> builtIn.firstOrNull { it.key == key }
        }
    }

    /** Resolves a comma separated CLI value; empty or "all" means the default set. */
    fun resolve(raw: String?): List<AppProfile> {
        val value = raw?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (value.isEmpty() || value.equals("all", ignoreCase = true)) return default
        val result = LinkedHashMap<String, AppProfile>()
        for (part in value.split(',')) {
            if (part.isBlank()) continue
            if (part.trim().equals("all", ignoreCase = true)) return default
            val profile = byKey(part) ?: continue
            result[profile.key] = profile
        }
        return result.values.toList()
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent

/** Notification buttons for a running collection (pause / resume / stop). */
class CollectorActionReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {

    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        when (intent.action) {
            CollectorNotification.ACTION_PAUSE -> CollectorController.pause()
            CollectorNotification.ACTION_RESUME -> CollectorController.resume()
            CollectorNotification.ACTION_STOP -> CollectorController.stop()
        }
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.content.Context
import com.rewardadguard.app.RewardAdGuardApp
import com.rewardadguard.app.data.AppSettings
import com.rewardadguard.app.service.RewardAdAccessibilityService
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/**
 * Process-wide owner of the automatic collection run.
 *
 * The run must outlive the Activity (and the debug entry), so it lives here
 * rather than in a ViewModel. There is exactly one job and one
 * [CollectorEnvironment] (owned by the accessibility service), which is what
 * makes "start" idempotent and "two engines on one screen" impossible.
 */
object CollectorController {

    data class State(
        val running: Boolean = false,
        val paused: Boolean = false,
        val pauseReason: String? = null,
        /** Rewards the collector gave up on twice; the user collects them. */
        val manual: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val appName: String? = null,
        val dryRun: Boolean = false,
        val rewards: Int = 0,
        val ads: Int = 0,
        val taps: Int = 0,
        val startedAt: Long = 0L,
        val message: String = "撠??",
        val recent: List<String> = emptyList()
    )

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(State())
    val state: StateFlow<State> = _state.asStateFlow()

    private val recent = ArrayDeque<String>()
    // Read from the UI thread (start/stop) and written from the run's
    // Dispatchers.Default coroutine; make every write visible at once.
    @Volatile
    private var job: Job? = null
    @Volatile
    private var notificationContext: Context? = null

    /**
     * Starts [profiles] in order. [limit] is a [CollectorLimits] value:
     * -1 unlimited, 0 the profile cap, N an explicit cap. Returns an error
     * message, or null when the run was accepted.
     */
    fun start(
        service: RewardAdAccessibilityService,
        profiles: List<AppProfile>,
        limit: Int,
        dryRun: Boolean,
        /** Count what is left instead of collecting (2026-11-15). */
        scan: Boolean = false
    ): String? {
        val running = job
        if (running?.isActive == true) {
            // A scan never holds the screen against a collection the user asked
            // for (2026-11-16): it stops, its unscanned apps go back to the
            // schedule, and the collection starts as soon as it has let go.
            if (currentScan && !scan) {
                yieldScan("collection")
                scope.launch {
                    running.join()
                    start(service, profiles, limit, dryRun, scan = false)
                }
                return null
            }
            return "撌脫??嗅?甇??瑁?"
        }
        val environment = service.collectorRuntime() ?: return "?⊿?蝷????芸停蝺?
        if (profiles.isEmpty()) return "瘝??豢??舀?? App"

        val selected = profiles.toList()
        val scanResults = ArrayList<ScanResult>()
        // Started from a notification button (reset reminder, 2026-11-15) the
        // shade stays down over the screen the run is about to tap: close it.
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
            runCatching {
                service.performGlobalAction(android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_DISMISS_NOTIFICATION_SHADE)
            }
        }
        environment.beginSequence()
        currentScan = scan
        scanYield = null
        scanRemaining = selected.map { it.key }
        recent.clear()
        notificationContext = service
        _state.value = State(
            running = true,
            dryRun = dryRun,
            appName = selected.first().name,
            startedAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            message = if (scan) "皞???" else "皞???",
            recent = emptyList()
        )
        CollectorNotification.update(service, _state.value)
        job = scope.launch {
            // The UI and notification follow the environment, so a pause the
            // collector took by itself (lock screen, finger) shows as paused
            // with its reason instead of "running" (review P1-3).
            val statusWatch = launch {
                environment.status.collect { status -> onEnvironmentStatus(status) }
            }
            try {
                val reasons = CollectorRunPolicy.runSequence(
                    items = selected,
                    stopRequested = { environment.stopRequested },
                    keyguardLocked = { environment.isKeyguardLocked() }
                ) { profile ->
                    if (scan) scanRemaining = selected.dropWhile { it.key != profile.key }.map { it.key }
                    setState {
                        it.copy(
                            appName = profile.name,
                            rewards = 0,
                            ads = 0,
                            taps = 0,
                            startedAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                            message = "?? ${profile.name}"
                        )
                    }
                    val engine = CollectorEngine(
                        service = service,
                        environment = environment,
                        foreground = service::collectorForeground,
                        logger = RewardAdGuardApp.Container.logger,
                        selfClicks = service.collectorSelfClicks(),
                        profile = profile,
                        dryRun = dryRun,
                        rewardLimit = limit,
                        scanOnly = scan
                    )
                    engine.progressListener = { progress ->
                        setState {
                            it.copy(
                                message = progress.message,
                                rewards = progress.rewards,
                                ads = progress.ads,
                                taps = progress.taps
                            )
                        }
                        addRecent(progress.message)
                    }
                    val outcome = engine.run()
                    if (outcome.endReason == "lottery_tickets_low") {
                        leaveLotteryAndStopGuard(service)
                    }
                    setState { it.copy(rewards = outcome.rewards, manual = it.manual + outcome.manual) }
                    addRecent(
                        "${profile.name} 蝯?嚗?{outcome.endReason}嚗?? ${outcome.rewards}?? +
                            "撱?? ${outcome.ads}????${outcome.taps}?暹? ${outcome.timeouts}?? +
                            "撠? ${outcome.redirects}?隤?${outcome.errors}" +
                            if (outcome.unconfirmed > 0) "?蝣箄??亙董 ${outcome.unconfirmed}" else ""
                    )
                    if (environment.state != CollectorState.IDLE) environment.stop()
                    if (scan) {
                        scanResults += ScanResult(
                            profile.key, profile.name, outcome.available, outcome.endReason,
                            repeatable = outcome.repeatable,
                            note = outcome.manual.firstOrNull()
                        )
                    }
                    outcome.endReason
                }
                if (reasons.size < selected.size) addRecent("撌脣?甇ｇ?銝???銝???App")
                val left = _state.value.manual
                setState {
                    it.copy(message = if (left.isEmpty()) "撌脩??? else "撌脩???${left.size} ???菟?閬????)
                }
                if (left.isNotEmpty()) CollectorNotification.showManual(service, left)
                if (scan && scanYield != null) {
                    // Gave the screen back: scan the rest later, when the phone
                    // is unlocked and idle again (the schedule's usual wait).
                    val rest = scanRemaining
                    if (rest.isNotEmpty()) {
                        CollectorScheduler.setPending(
                            service,
                            PendingRun(SCAN_RESUME_ID, System.currentTimeMillis(), rest, scan = true)
                        )
                        CollectorScheduler.setStatus(service, "??撌脰??箇?ｇ????蔭敺??")
                        addRecent("??霈?恍嚗?{if (scanYield == "collection") "???嗅?" else "??雿輻銝?}嚗?蝔??亥???${rest.size} ??App")
                    }
                } else if (scan && scanResults.isNotEmpty()) {
                    RewardReminders.notifyScan(service, scanResults.toList())
                }
                if (scan && scanYield == null) {
                    // A finished scan left the last app (often a reward page
                    // with animations) on screen, keeping the phone busy and
                    // draining the battery. Go to the home screen, unless the
                    // user is in this app (they stopped it from here).
                    if (service.collectorForeground().packageName != service.packageName) {
                        service.performGlobalAction(
                            android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME
                        )
                        addRecent("??摰?嚗歇?獢")
                    }
                }
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                if (t is CancellationException) throw t
                addRecent("?航炊嚗?{t::class.java.simpleName}: ${t.message}")
                setState { it.copy(message = "?航炊嚗?{t.message ?: "?芰"}") }
            } finally {
                statusWatch.cancel()
                job = null
                val resume = scan && scanYield != null
                currentScan = false
                if (resume) service.collectorScheduledRunner()?.kick()
                setState { it.copy(running = false, paused = false, pauseReason = null, appName = null) }
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    /** The running sequence is a scan (count only), not a collection. */
    @Volatile
    private var currentScan = false

    /** Why a scan gave the screen back ("user" / "collection"), null while it runs. */
    @Volatile
    private var scanYield: String? = null

    /** Apps the running scan has not finished, the current one included. */
    @Volatile
    private var scanRemaining: List<String> = emptyList()

    private const val SCAN_RESUME_ID = -999L

    /** Stops a running scan so the phone (or a collection) can have the screen. */
    private fun yieldScan(reason: String) {
        if (!currentScan || scanYield != null) return
        scanYield = reason
        RewardAdAccessibilityService.instance?.collectorRuntime()?.requestStop()
        addRecent(if (reason == "collection") "??霈策?嗅?" else "??雿輻銝哨???霈?恍")
    }

    fun pause() {
        RewardAdAccessibilityService.instance?.collectorRuntime()
            ?.pause(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_REQUESTED)
        addRecent("?怠?")
    }

    fun resume() {
        RewardAdAccessibilityService.instance?.collectorRuntime()?.resume()
        addRecent("蝜潛?")
    }

    fun stop() {
        RewardAdAccessibilityService.instance?.collectorRuntime()?.requestStop()
        setState { it.copy(message = "?迫銝凌?) }
        addRecent("雿輻??瘙?甇?)
    }

    /**
     * LINE ?賣璅?is out of 5-ticket draws (asked 2026-11-21): leave the app
     * for the desktop, then stop the guard so it does not keep watching.
     */
    private suspend fun leaveLotteryAndStopGuard(service: RewardAdAccessibilityService) {
        val left = runCatching {
            if (service.collectorForeground().packageName != service.packageName) {
                service.performGlobalAction(
                    android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME
                )
            } else {
                false
            }
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        addRecent(if (left) "?賣璅巨?訾?頞?5 撘蛛?撌脣??唳??? else "?賣璅巨?訾?頞?5 撘?)
        runCatching {
            RewardAdGuardApp.Container.settingsRepository
                .setPausedUntil(AppSettings.PAUSED_INDEFINITELY)
        }.onSuccess {
            addRecent("撌脣?甇Ｙ??萄?銵?)
        }.onFailure {
            addRecent("?迫?摰?憭望?嚗?{it.message ?: it::class.java.simpleName}")
        }
    }

    private fun onEnvironmentStatus(status: CollectorEnvironment.Status) {
        val paused = status.state == CollectorState.PAUSED
        if (paused && currentScan && status.pauseReason in SCAN_YIELD_REASONS) {
            // A scan is only worth running on a phone nobody is using: a finger,
            // another app or the lock screen ends it instead of pausing it
            // (a paused scan held the screen for 7 minutes on 2026-11-16).
            yieldScan("user")
        }
        val wasPaused = _state.value.paused
        if (paused == wasPaused && status.pauseReason == _state.value.pauseReason) return
        setState {
            it.copy(
                paused = paused,
                pauseReason = status.pauseReason,
                message = when {
                    paused -> pauseMessage(status.pauseReason)
                    wasPaused -> "蝜潛??嗅?"
                    else -> it.message
                }
            )
        }
        if (paused) addRecent(pauseMessage(status.pauseReason))
