                        delay(2_500L)
                        lastProgressAt = activeNow()
                        continue
                    }
                } else if (openStore == null) {
                    openStoreSince = -1L
                }

                if (CollectorRules.isPlayStoreEndCard(snapshot)) {
                    // Only "Skip to Google Play" is left: give an X a few
                    // seconds to appear, then leave instead of waiting two
                    // minutes for nothing (2026-11-14 10:41-10:43).
                    if (playEndCardSince < 0L) {
                        playEndCardSince = activeNow()
                        recorder.event("ad_play_endcard")
                        recorder.shot(frame.bitmap, "${label}_play_endcard")
                    } else if (activeNow() - playEndCardSince >= PLAY_ENDCARD_GRACE_MILLIS) {
                        stuck = true
                        break
                    }
                } else {
                    playEndCardSince = -1L
                }

                val screen = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
                val signature = frame.bitmap?.let { AdStuck.signature(it) }
                val moving = elapsed < AdStuck.MOTION_PROGRESS_MAX_MILLIS && AdStuck.imageMoved(lastSignature, signature)
                if (signature != null) lastSignature = signature
                if (screen != lastScreen || CollectorRules.hasAdCountdown(snapshot) || moving) {
                    // A playing video counts as progress even with no text
                    // changing (2026-11-14: a countdown-less video was called
                    // stuck); a frozen or idle ad still is not.
                    lastProgressAt = activeNow()
                    lastScreen = screen
                }
                if (AdStuck.isStuck(adSeen, elapsed, profile.adMinWatchMillis, activeNow() - lastProgressAt)) {
                    stuck = true
                    break
                }
                if (!adSeen && elapsed >= NO_AD_BREAK_MILLIS) break
            } finally {
                frame.close()
            }
            delay(profile.pollMillis)
        }

        if (closed) {
            delay(1_200L)
            recoverToApp()
            return "ad_closed"
        }
        if (stuck) {
            timeouts++
            recorder.event(
                "ad_stuck",
                message = if (playEndCardSince >= 0L) "only Skip to Google Play left"
                else "no countdown, no control, no change for ${AdStuck.NO_PROGRESS_MILLIS} ms"
            )
            actor.back()
            delay(1_500L)
            recoverToApp()
            return "ad_stuck"
        }
        if (adSeen) {
            timeouts++
            recorder.event("ad_timeout")
            if (profile.lineRules) handleLineLoadFailure()
            actor.back()
            delay(1_500L)
            recoverToApp()
            return "ad_timeout"
        }
        return "no_ad"
    }

    /**
     * Leaves the app where the user starts: its first tab. A run that ended
     * on a sub-page (AHEALTH's 甇亥?, 2026-11-16 13:39) left the user there;
     * [openTab] presses Back out of a sub-page first.
     */
    private suspend fun returnToFirstTab() {
        val first = profile.collectionTabs.firstOrNull() ?: return
        if (profile.tabPaths[first] != null) return
        val snapshot = readPlain("return_home_check")
        if (isWrongPackage(snapshot)) return
        val onSub = profile.altChromeTerms.isNotEmpty() && CollectorRules.onSubPage(snapshot, profile)
        if (!onSub && profile.collectionTabs.size <= 1) return
        recorder.event("return_to_first_tab", fields = mapOf("tab" to first, "fromSubPage" to onSub))
        openTab(first)
        delay(800L)
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- scan

    /**
     * Counts what is left to collect (2026-11-15). Reaching the pages takes
     * the same navigation as a run (startup ads, popups, tab taps, scrolls);
     * the rewards themselves are only counted.
     */
    private suspend fun scanApp() {
        ensureReady()
        dismissPopups()
        if (blockedBy != null) {
            manual += blockedBy!!
            available = -1
            return
        }
        if (profile.lotteryMode) {
            val opened = openLottery() ?: if (goToLotteryHome()) openLottery() else null
            val sheet = opened?.let { LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(it) }
            available = sheet?.let { CollectorRules.lotteryAvailable(it) } ?: 0
            // Not found is not "nothing left" (04:09 reported 0 draws).
            if (sheet == null) scanIncomplete = true
            recorder.event("scan_lottery", fields = mapOf("found" to (sheet != null), "available" to available, "counts" to sheet?.counts))
            publish("${profile.name} ??嚗??$available 甈?)
            return
        }
        val tabs = profile.collectionTabs.ifEmpty { listOf("") }
        for (tab in tabs) {
            if (!awaitRunning()) return
            if (foreground().packageName != profile.packageName) {
                // Another app came up over ours (BITWALK during the AHEALTH
                // scan, 2026-11-16): never look for tabs on its screen.
                recorder.event("wrong_package", fields = mapOf("package" to foreground().packageName))
                recoverToApp()
            }
            if (tab.isNotEmpty() && !openTab(tab)) {
                recorder.event("scan_tab_missing", fields = mapOf("tab" to tab))
                scanIncomplete = true
                continue
            }
            awaitTabSettled(tab)
            dismissPopups()
            val scroll = profile.tabScrolls[tab]
            if (scroll != null && !scroll.horizontal) scrollToTop()
            val pages = ArrayList<List<Target>>()
            while (awaitRunning()) {
                val label = "scan_${tab.ifEmpty { "home" }}_${pages.size}"
                var snapshot = readPlain(label)
                if (isWrongPackage(snapshot)) {
                    recoverToApp()
                    snapshot = readPlain("${label}_recover")
                    if (isWrongPackage(snapshot)) break
                }
                pages += CollectorRules.eligibleRewards(snapshot, profile) { target, screen ->
                    CollectorRules.dropKey(target.text) !in droppedButtons &&
                        (!profile.lineRules || LineWalkRules.candidateAllowed(target, screen))
                }.toList()
                if (scroll == null || pages.size > scroll.pages) break
                if (!scrollPage(scroll, snapshot)) break
                delay(1_200L)
            }
            val count = CollectorRules.scanCount(pages)
            available += count
            recorder.event(
                "scan_tab",
                fields = mapOf("tab" to tab, "available" to count, "labels" to pages.flatten().map { it.text }.distinct())
            )
            publish("${profile.name} ??${if (tab.isEmpty()) "" else "??tab??}嚗?count ??)
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------- lottery

    /** Dry run: read, wait for the app to settle, decide; never touch the screen. */
    private suspend fun dryRunRead() {
        var snapshot = readPlain("dry_home_0")
        var candidate = pickReward(snapshot, emptyMap())
        var attempt = 1
        // Launching returns when the app's package is in front, which can still
        // be a splash or an empty web view (LINE ??郊頞?took >600 ms to render
        // on 2026-11-12). Wait without tapping so the dry run sees the real page.
        while (candidate == null && attempt < DRY_RUN_SETTLE_ATTEMPTS && awaitRunning()) {
            delay(DRY_RUN_SETTLE_WAIT_MILLIS)
            snapshot = readPlain("dry_home_$attempt")
            if (CollectorRules.isUserShade(snapshot.foregroundPackage)) {
                // A dry run never closes the shade the user just pulled down.
                recorder.event("shade_open_wait")
                attempt++
                continue
            }
            if (isWrongPackage(snapshot)) {
                recorder.event("wrong_package", fields = mapOf("package" to snapshot.foregroundPackage))
                recoverToApp()
                snapshot = readPlain("dry_home_${attempt}_recover")
            }
            candidate = pickReward(snapshot, emptyMap())
            attempt++
        }
        if (candidate != null) {
            recorder.console(
                "[DRY-RUN] ${profile.name} would tap '${candidate.text}' " +
                    "@ (${candidate.centerX},${candidate.centerY})"
            )
            recorder.event(
                "dry_run_candidate",
                fields = mapOf(
                    "text" to candidate.text,
                    "x" to candidate.centerX,
                    "y" to candidate.centerY,
                    "source" to candidate.source
                )
            )
        } else {
            recorder.event("no_reward", fields = mapOf("tab" to "dry_home"))
            recorder.console("[DRY-RUN] ${profile.name}: no reward candidate on the launch screen")
        }
        if (profile.lotteryMode) {
            val sheet = LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(snapshot)
            val entry = LineWalkRules.lotteryEntry(snapshot)
            recorder.event(
                "dry_lottery",
                fields = mapOf(
                    "sheet" to (sheet != null),
                    "entry" to (entry != null),
                    "big" to sheet?.big?.text,
                    "free" to sheet?.free?.text,
                    "normal" to sheet?.normal?.text,
                    "counts" to sheet?.counts
                )
            )
        }
        saveCurrentScreen("dry_home")
    }

    /**
     * LINE ?賣璅? BIG (50 撘? ???祥????銝??(5 撘?, never waiting for a
     * cooldown and stopping when the normal draw has fewer than 5 tickets.
     */
    private suspend fun collectLottery() {
        if (dryRun) return
        // LINE may be left on another page (蝎暸 > ?隤踵 on 2026-11-16 17:05,
        // when the run ended "done" without a draw): find the way back first.
        var snapshot = openLottery() ?: reopenLottery() ?: return
        var draws = 0
        val failures = hashMapOf("big" to 0, "free" to 0, "normal" to 0)
        while (awaitRunning() && draws < profile.maxLotteryDraws) {
            if (CollectorLimits.hasUserCap(rewardLimit) && rewards >= rewardLimit) {
                recorder.event("lottery_limit", fields = mapOf("rewards" to rewards))
                break
            }
            val sheet = LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(snapshot)
            if (sheet == null) {
                snapshot = reopenLottery() ?: break
                continue
            }
            val buttons = linkedMapOf("big" to sheet.big, "free" to sheet.free, "normal" to sheet.normal)
            val lowTickets = LineWalkRules.lotteryTicketsLow(sheet)
            for ((kind, count) in sheet.counts) {
                if (count <= 0 || (kind == "normal" && lowTickets)) buttons.remove(kind)
            }
            val kind = LOTTERY_ORDER.firstOrNull {
                buttons[it] != null && (failures[it] ?: 0) < profile.maxLotteryFailures
            }
            if (kind == null) {
                // Two normal draws with no result, and the button still there,
                // is the 2026-11-22 end state: the banner showed 1 ticket, but
                // OCR never read that badge, so counts was empty. Treat it as
                // out of tickets instead of ending "done" with LINE left open.
                val normalFailures = failures["normal"] ?: 0
                if (lowTickets || normalFailures >= profile.maxLotteryFailures) {
                    finishLotteryLow(draws, sheet.counts, normalFailures)
                } else {
                    recorder.event(
                        "lottery_done",
                        fields = mapOf("draws" to draws, "counts" to sheet.counts)
                    )
                    recorder.console("[collector] lottery done draws=$draws counts=${sheet.counts}")
                }
                break
            }
            val target = buttons[kind] ?: break
            if (isWrongPackage(snapshot)) {
                // Never draw on a screen that is not LINE's.
                val pkg = snapshot.foregroundPackage
                if (isUsersApp(pkg)) {
                    if (!yieldToUser(pkg)) break
                } else {
                    recoverToApp()
                }
                snapshot = readPlain("lottery_after_wrong_app")
                continue
            }
            recorder.event(
                "lottery_draw",
                fields = mapOf(
                    "kind" to kind,
                    "text" to target.text,
                    "x" to target.centerX,
                    "y" to target.centerY
                )
            )
            recorder.console("[collector] lottery $kind '${target.text}' @ (${target.centerX},${target.centerY})")
            actor.tap(target.centerX, target.centerY)
            taps++
            draws++

            val result = waitLotteryResult(draws, kind)
            if (result == null) {
                // A BIG or ?祥 button that gives nothing is counting down: one
                // try is enough (22:43, two wasted 26 s tries each). Only the
                // repeatable 5 撘?draw gets a second chance.
                failures[kind] = if (LineWalkRules.isOncePerCooldown(kind)) {
                    profile.maxLotteryFailures
                } else {
                    (failures[kind] ?: 0) + 1
                }
                recorder.event("lottery_no_result", fields = mapOf("kind" to kind, "failures" to failures[kind]))
                // What the screen said when the draw was given up, so the next
                // unrecognised prize or sheet can be diagnosed from the record.
                val seen = readPlain("lottery_fail_screen")
                recorder.event(
                    "lottery_fail_texts",
                    message = seen.boxes.filter { it.source == TextSource.OCR }
                        .joinToString(" | ") { it.text.replace('\n', ' ') }
                        .take(600)
                )
                saveCurrentScreen("lottery_fail")
                val after = readPlain("lottery_after_fail")
                val afterSheet = LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(after)
                if (kind == "normal" &&
                    (LineWalkRules.lotteryTicketsLow(afterSheet) || LineWalkRules.lotteryNotEnoughTickets(seen))
                ) {
                    // The badge was hard to read (or the tap was already made):
                    // the sheet itself says the 5 tickets are not there.
                    finishLotteryLow(draws, afterSheet?.counts ?: emptyMap(), failures["normal"] ?: 0)
                    break
                }
                snapshot = if (afterSheet != null) {
                    after
                } else {
                    reopenLottery() ?: break
                }
                continue
            }

            // BIG and ?祥 are one draw per countdown; after a prize the button
            // stays on screen but does nothing, and two more taps were wasted
            // as "failures" on 2026-11-12. Never wait for the countdown:
            // move on to the next kind at once.
            failures[kind] = if (LineWalkRules.isOncePerCooldown(kind)) profile.maxLotteryFailures else 0
            val prize = result.boxes.firstOrNull {
                LineWalkRules.isPrizeText(it.text)
            }?.text.orEmpty()
            recorder.event("lottery_prize", fields = mapOf("kind" to kind, "prize" to prize))
            rewards++
            publish("?賣璅?$prize嚗歇??$rewards嚗?)
            val close = LineWalkRules.lotteryResultClose(result)
            if (close != null) {
                actor.tap(close.centerX, close.centerY)
            } else {
                // Prize without a ?? button: Back leaves the result sheet.
                actor.back()
            }
            delay(1_500L)
            val after = readPlain("lottery_sheet_after")
            snapshot = if (LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(after) != null) {
                after
            } else {
                openLottery() ?: break
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Fewer than 5 tickets (or two normal draws with no result): LINE cannot
     * draw again. The caller goes home and stops the guard.
     */
    private fun finishLotteryLow(draws: Int, counts: Map<String, Int>, normalFailures: Int) {
        lotteryTicketsLow = true
        val tickets = counts["normal"]
        recorder.event(
            "lottery_tickets_low",
            fields = mapOf(
                "draws" to draws,
                "tickets" to tickets,
                "counts" to counts,
                "normalFailures" to normalFailures
            )
        )
        recorder.console(
            "[collector] lottery tickets low: normal=$tickets draws=$draws failures=$normalFailures"
        )
        val detail = when {
            tickets != null ->
                "銝?砍??$tickets 撘蛛?銝雲 ${LineWalkRules.LOTTERY_NORMAL_TICKETS} 撘蛛?"
            normalFailures >= 2 ->
                "??? $normalFailures 甈⊥?蝯?嚗巨?詨?賭?頞?" +
                    "${LineWalkRules.LOTTERY_NORMAL_TICKETS} 撘蛛?"
            else -> "?賜??訾?頞?${LineWalkRules.LOTTERY_NORMAL_TICKETS} 撘?
        }
        publish("?賣璅?$detail嚗???)
    }

    private suspend fun openLottery(): Snapshot? {
        var snapshot = readPlain("lottery_open_before")
        if (LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(snapshot) != null) return snapshot
        val entry = LineWalkRules.lotteryEntry(snapshot) ?: run {
            recorder.event("lottery_entry_not_found")
            return null
        }
        recorder.event(
            "lottery_open",
            fields = mapOf("x" to entry.centerX, "y" to (entry.centerY - LOTTERY_ENTRY_OFFSET_PX))
        )
        actor.tap(entry.centerX, (entry.centerY - LOTTERY_ENTRY_OFFSET_PX).coerceAtLeast(0))
        taps++
        delay(2_000L)
        snapshot = readPlain("lottery_open")
        repeat(2) { index ->
            if (LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(snapshot) != null) return snapshot
            delay(3_000L)
            snapshot = readPlain("lottery_open_retry${index + 1}")
        }
        return snapshot.takeIf { LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(it) != null }
    }

    /**
     * Back to the lottery sheet after a draw lost it (2026-11-16 15:29: an
     * InMobi ad with no text and a lone X sat over LINE, the entry could not
     * be found, and the run ended "done" at 32 of 50 draws). An ad on screen
     * is closed like any ad; failing that, LINE is opened again once.
     */
    private suspend fun reopenLottery(): Snapshot? {
        // Stopped (or trapped) mid-draw: that is not a lost lottery.
        if (!awaitRunning()) return null
        val now = readPlain("lottery_reopen_check")
        if (CollectorRules.looksLikeAd(now, profile)) {
            recorder.event("lottery_leftover_ad")
            handleAd(assumeAd = true, label = "lottery_leftover")
        }
        openLottery()?.let { return it }
        if (goToLotteryHome()) openLottery()?.let { return it }
        if (cleanRestarts < MAX_CLEAN_RESTARTS && awaitRunning()) {
            restartAppClean("lottery_lost")
            openLottery()?.let { return it }
        }
        if (!awaitRunning()) return null
        lotteryLost = true
        recorder.event("lottery_lost")
        return null
    }

    /** LINE's ?? (bottom bar) and then its 擐? tab, where the lottery entry is. */
    private suspend fun goToLotteryHome(): Boolean {
        val tapped = tapLinePointsTab()
        recorder.event("lottery_go_home_tab")
        val ok = openTab("擐?")
        delay(1_500L)
        return ok || tapped
    }

    /**
     * InMobi's ads are the ones that hang (2026-11-17: 109 of the run's ad
     * frames, one stuck for two minutes before the app was restarted): give
     * them 60 s instead of the profile's 120 s.
     */
    private fun adTimeoutNow(): Long {
        val activity = foreground().activity.orEmpty()
        return if (activity.contains("inmobi", ignoreCase = true)) {
            minOf(profile.adTimeoutMillis, INMOBI_AD_TIMEOUT_MILLIS)
        } else {
            profile.adTimeoutMillis
        }
    }

    /** LINE ??郊頞?s ?? in the bottom bar, where its own tabs and the lottery are. */
    private suspend fun tapLinePointsTab(): Boolean {
        val snapshot = readPlain("line_points_check")
        if (isWrongPackage(snapshot)) return false
        val bottom = (snapshot.height * 0.85).toInt()
        val points = snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull {
            it.bounds.top >= bottom && TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text) == "??"
        } ?: return false
        recorder.event("line_go_points_tab")
        actor.tap(points.bounds.centerX, points.bounds.centerY)
        taps++
        delay(1_800L)
        return true
    }

    /** Watches through ads, SKIP and the draw animation for the prize sheet. */
    private suspend fun waitLotteryResult(draws: Int, kind: String): Snapshot? {
        val start = activeNow()
        var index = 0
        var prizeSeenAt = -1L
        var sheetSince = -1L
        while (awaitRunning() &&
            activeNow() - start < LOTTERY_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MILLIS
        ) {
            delay(2_500L)
            val snapshot = readPlain("lottery_${kind}_${draws}_${index++}")
            val fg = snapshot.foregroundPackage?.trim().orEmpty()
            if (isUsersApp(fg)) {
                // The user opened another app (ours included) mid-draw: its
                // text is not LINE's prize sheet.
                if (!yieldToUser(fg)) return null
                continue
            }
            val onLine = fg.isEmpty() || fg == profile.packageName
            if (onLine && LineWalkRules.lotteryResultClose(snapshot) != null) return snapshot
            if (onLine && LineWalkRules.isLotteryPrize(snapshot)) {
                // The prize is on screen but its ?? is not (yet). Give the
                // button a moment, then take the prize anyway (review P2-8).
                if (prizeSeenAt < 0L) prizeSeenAt = activeNow()
                if (activeNow() - prizeSeenAt >= LOTTERY_PRIZE_CLOSE_WAIT_MILLIS) {
                    recorder.event("lottery_prize_without_close")
                    return snapshot
                }
                continue
            }

            val pkg = snapshot.foregroundPackage?.trim().orEmpty()
            if ((pkg.isNotEmpty() && pkg != profile.packageName) ||
                CollectorRules.looksLikeAd(snapshot, profile)
            ) {
                handleAd(assumeAd = false, label = "lottery_${kind}_$draws")
                continue
            }
            val skip = LineWalkRules.findSkip(snapshot)
            if (skip != null) {
                recorder.event("lottery_skip")
                actor.tap(skip.centerX, skip.centerY)
                continue
            }

            val elapsed = activeNow() - start
            val onSheet = LineWalkRules.lotterySheet(snapshot) != null
            // "Stuck on the sheet" is measured from when the sheet came back,
            // not from the tap: an ad before the draw used to use up the 20 s
            // and the animation still running was called a failure (22:34).
            sheetSince = if (onSheet) (if (sheetSince < 0L) activeNow() else sheetSince) else -1L
            val text = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
            val isResult = LineWalkRules.isPrizeText(snapshot.text) || LineWalkRules.lotteryResultClose(snapshot) != null
            if (!isResult) {
                // A draw can open an in-app Google Play page (momo 鞈潛 on
                // 2026-11-12). It keeps the LINE package, so the foreground
                // check cannot catch it; close it and go back to the sheet.
                val looksStore = LineWalkRules.looksLikeStorePage(snapshot)
                if (looksStore || (elapsed >= LOTTERY_SHEET_STUCK_MILLIS &&
                        !onSheet && !CollectorRules.hasAppChrome(snapshot, profile))
                ) {
                    recorder.event(
                        "lottery_store_page",
                        message = if (looksStore) "store_marker" else "no_chrome_no_sheet"
                    )
                    saveCurrentScreen("lottery_store_$draws")
                    val close = CollectorRules.findCloseTargets(snapshot, profile, emptyList()).firstOrNull()
                    if (close != null) {
                        recorder.event("lottery_store_close", fields = mapOf("source" to close.source))
                        actor.tap(close.centerX, close.centerY)
                    } else {
                        actor.back()
                    }
                    delay(1_500L)
                    continue
                }
            }
            if (onSheet && activeNow() - sheetSince >= LOTTERY_SHEET_STUCK_MILLIS) {
                val text = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
                val cancel = snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull { TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text) == "??" }
                if (cancel != null && "頛銝? in text) {
                    recorder.event("lottery_loading_cancel")
                    actor.tap(
                        (cancel.bounds.left + cancel.bounds.right) / 2,
                        (cancel.bounds.top + cancel.bounds.bottom) / 2
                    )
                    delay(1_500L)
                }
                return null
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    /** LINE's stuck-ad recovery: cancel 頛銝? then Home + relaunch (no force-stop). */
    /**
     * Another app in front that the user opened, not an ad: anything but the
     * store, a browser, or an app that came up right after our own action.
     * The shade is handled elsewhere (the run waits for it).
     */
    private fun isUsersApp(foreground: String?): Boolean {
        val pkg = foreground?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (pkg.isEmpty() || pkg == profile.packageName || CollectorRules.isUserShade(pkg)) return false
        // Our own screen is always the user looking at the run (2026-11-15
        // 03:15: its recent-messages list was read as a lottery prize).
        if (pkg == service.packageName) return true
        // An ad was on screen a moment ago: the app that replaced it is the
        // ad's own redirect (BITWALK 2026-11-17 08:17: ShopBack opened by an
        // ad paused the run as if the user had switched apps).
        if (lastAdFrameAt > 0L && activeNow() - lastAdFrameAt < AD_REDIRECT_GRACE_MILLIS) return false
        return !RedirectJudge.isAdRedirect(pkg, actor.sinceLastActionMillis())
    }

    /**
     * Pauses the run the way ?怠? does - no Back, no relaunch - until the
     * user presses 蝜潛?; then reopens the reward app. False when the run was
     * stopped instead.
     */
    private suspend fun yieldToUser(foreground: String?): Boolean {
        recorder.event("user_switched_app", fields = mapOf("package" to foreground))
        publish("雿迤?其蝙?典隞?App嚗歇?怠?嚗??匱蝥?? ${profile.name}")
        environment.pause(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_LEFT)
        if (!awaitRunning()) return false
        recoverToApp()
        return true
    }

    private suspend fun restartAppClean(why: String) {
        cleanRestarts++
        recorder.event("app_restart_clean", fields = mapOf("count" to cleanRestarts, "why" to why))
        publish("撱???銝?鳴???? ${profile.name}嚗洵 $cleanRestarts 甈∴?")
        actor.home()
        delay(800L)
        actor.launch(profile.packageName, fresh = true)
        actor.waitFor(profile.launchWaitMillis) { foreground().packageName == profile.packageName }
        delay(2_500L)
        ensureReady()
        dismissPopups()
    }

    /** One swipe that brings the next part of the page into view. */
    private suspend fun scrollPage(spec: TabScroll, snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean {
        val w = snapshot.width
        val h = snapshot.height
        return if (spec.horizontal) {
            val y = (h * spec.atY).toInt()
            actor.swipe((w * 0.85).toInt(), y, (w * 0.15).toInt(), y)
        } else {
            // Right of centre: the floating panel sits on the left edge.
            val x = (w * 0.7).toInt()
            actor.swipe(x, (h * 0.72).toInt(), x, (h * 0.32).toInt())
        }
    }

    /** Back to the top of a scrolling page before collecting it. */
    private suspend fun scrollToTop() {
        val w = foregroundSize()
        repeat(SCROLL_TOP_SWIPES) {
            if (!awaitRunning()) return
            val x = (w.first * 0.7).toInt()
            actor.swipe(x, (w.second * 0.3).toInt(), x, (w.second * 0.8).toInt(), 300L)
            delay(350L)
        }
        delay(800L)
    }

    private fun foregroundSize(): Pair<Int, Int> {
        val metrics = service.resources.displayMetrics
        return metrics.widthPixels to metrics.heightPixels
    }

    /**
     * AHEALTH's "2p 撌脤???" sheet offers 2????(an ad) and 摰?. Press 摰?
     * so the next button is not hidden behind it; never the ad offer.
     */
    private suspend fun closeDoneSheet(): Boolean {
        if (profile.doneTerms.isEmpty() || !awaitRunning()) return false
        val snapshot = readPlain("done_check")
        val done = CollectorRules.findDone(snapshot, profile) ?: return false
        val received = CollectorRules.isRewardReceivedSheet(snapshot)
        recorder.event("done_sheet", fields = mapOf("text" to done.text, "received" to received))
        actor.tap(done.bounds.centerX, done.bounds.centerY)
        delay(1_000L)
        return received
    }

    private suspend fun handleLineLoadFailure() {
        val snapshot = readPlain("load_fail")
        val text = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
        if ("頛銝? in text) {
            snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull { TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text) == "??" }?.let { cancel ->
                recorder.event("loading_cancel")
                actor.tap(
                    (cancel.bounds.left + cancel.bounds.right) / 2,
                    (cancel.bounds.top + cancel.bounds.bottom) / 2
                )
                delay(1_500L)
            }
        }
        loadFailures++
        if (loadFailures < 2 || restarts >= 2) return
        restarts++
        loadFailures = 0
        recorder.event("app_restart", fields = mapOf("count" to restarts))
        actor.home()
        delay(1_000L)
        actor.launch(profile.packageName)
        delay(profile.launchWaitMillis)
        ensureReady()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ misc

    private suspend fun readPlain(label: String): Snapshot {
        val fg = foreground()
        recorder.event("capture_begin", fields = mapOf("label" to label))
        val snapshot = reader.read(fg.packageName, fg.activity)
        recorder.event(
            "snapshot",
            fields = mapOf(
                "label" to label,
                "package" to snapshot.foregroundPackage,
                "node" to snapshot.nodeCount(),
                "ocr" to snapshot.ocrCount(),
                "ocrMillis" to snapshot.ocrMillis,
                "ocrError" to snapshot.ocrError,
                "disabled" to snapshot.disabled.size
            )
        )
        return snapshot
    }

    private suspend fun saveCurrentScreen(label: String) {
        val fg = foreground()
        reader.analyze(fg.packageName, fg.activity).use { frame ->
            recorder.shot(frame.bitmap, label)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun awaitRunning(): Boolean {
        if (adTrapped) {
            if (stopCause == null) stopCause = "ad_trapped"
            return false
        }
        if (CollectorRunPolicy.runCapApplies(rewardLimit) && engineStartedAt > 0L &&
            activeNow() - engineStartedAt >= MAX_RUN_MILLIS
        ) {
            recorder.event("run_timeout")
            stopCause = "run_timeout"
            environment.stop()
            return false
        }
        while (environment.state == CollectorState.PAUSED) {
            val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
            activeClock.pauseStarted(now)
            if (pausedSince == 0L) {
                pausedSince = now
                recorder.event("paused", fields = mapOf("reason" to environment.pauseReason))
            }
            // Lets a pause the collector took by itself end once the phone is
            // unlocked and nobody touches it (review P1-3).
            environment.checkInterruptions()
            if (environment.state != CollectorState.PAUSED) break
            if (CollectorRunPolicy.pauseTimesOut(environment.pauseReason) &&
                now - pausedSince >= MAX_PAUSE_MILLIS
            ) {
                // A locked phone or a stray touch must not leave the collector
                // waiting forever on an unattended run; the user can start again.
                recorder.event("paused_too_long")
                stopCause = "paused_too_long"
                environment.stop()
                break
            }
            delay(WAIT_POLL_MILLIS)
        }
        if (pausedSince != 0L) {
            activeClock.pauseEnded(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime())
            recorder.event(
                "resumed",
                fields = mapOf(
                    "pausedMillis" to SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - pausedSince,
                    "state" to environment.state.name
                )
            )
        }
        pausedSince = 0L
        if (environment.state == CollectorState.IDLE) {
            if (stopCause == null) stopCause = "stopped"
            return false
        }
        return true
    }

    /** Running time only: deadlines measured with it ignore pauses (review P1-5). */
    private fun activeNow(): Long = activeClock.activeAt(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime())

    /**
     * The "?? region of an in-ad install card: left 40%, from below
     * "Skip to Google Play" to just above "Install" (PC `_install_card_back`).
     */
    private fun installRegion(snapshot: Snapshot): Box? {
        if (!snapshot.contains("skipto")) return null
        val skip = snapshot.findLine("skipto") ?: return null
        val install = snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull {
            TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text) in INSTALL_LABELS
        }
        val bottom = if (install != null && install.bounds.top > skip.bounds.bottom) {
            install.bounds.top
        } else {
            (snapshot.height * 0.6).toInt()
        }
        if (bottom <= skip.bounds.bottom) return null
        return Box(0, skip.bounds.bottom, (snapshot.width * 0.4).toInt(), bottom)
    }

    private suspend fun recoverMainScreen(snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean {
        if (profile.lineRules && clearLineOverlays(snapshot)) return true
        if (CollectorRules.looksLikeAd(snapshot, profile)) {
            recorder.event("leftover_ad")
            val outcome = handleAd(assumeAd = false, label = "leftover")
            if ((outcome == "ad_timeout" || outcome == "ad_stuck") && cleanRestarts < MAX_CLEAN_RESTARTS) {
                // Back cannot leave this ad. Open the app again with its task
                // cleared: the ad goes with it and collection continues,
                // instead of the app being given up while rewards remain.
                restartAppClean("leftover_$outcome")
                return true
            }
            if (outcome == "ad_timeout" || outcome == "ad_stuck") {
                // The ad already timed out once and Back did not leave it:
                // nothing the run can do will (a playable "WI-FI ?" ad held
                // BITWALK for nine minutes on 2026-11-13). Hand it to the user
                // and let the next app run.
                adTrapped = true
                val line = "${profile.name}嚗誨?瘜???隢??????"
                manual.add(line)
                publish(line)
                recorder.event("ad_trapped", message = line)
                return true
            }
            dismissPopups()
            return true
        }
        if (CollectorRules.isDialog(snapshot, profile) ||
            !CollectorRules.hasAppChrome(snapshot, profile)
        ) {
            recorder.event("recover_main_screen")
            dismissPopups()
            val check = readPlain("recover_check")
            if (!CollectorRules.hasAppChrome(check, profile)) {
                actor.back()
                delay(1_500L)
                recoverToApp()
            }
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun publish(message: String) {
        runCatching { progressListener?.invoke(Progress(message, rewards, ads, taps)) }
    }

    private fun outcome(reason: String): Outcome = Outcome(        app = profile.key,
        endReason = reason,
        rewards = rewards,
        ads = ads,
        taps = taps,
        timeouts = timeouts,
        unconfirmed = unconfirmed,
        manual = manual.toList(),
        redirects = redirects,
        errors = errors,
        runDir = recorder.runDir.absolutePath,
        available = if (scanOnly) available else -1,
        repeatable = scanOnly && profile.repeatableRewards
    )

    companion object {
        private const val READY_ATTEMPTS = 4
        private const val MAX_SWEEPS = 5
        private const val MAX_TAB_RESTARTS = 2
        private const val MAX_DEFERRED_ROUNDS = 3
        private const val AD_REDIRECT_GRACE_MILLIS = 10_000L
        private const val INMOBI_AD_TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 60_000L
        private const val TAB_SEARCH_SCROLLS = 4
        private const val MAX_SUB_PAGE_REOPENS = 2
        private const val SCROLL_TOP_SWIPES = 6
        private const val PLAY_ENDCARD_GRACE_MILLIS = 8_000L
        private const val OPEN_STORE_GRACE_MILLIS = 6_000L
        private const val MAX_OPEN_STORE_TAPS = 2
        // 3 ran out after 30 minutes of BITWALK's stuck MBridge ads (2026-11-16).
        private const val MAX_CLEAN_RESTARTS = 5
        private const val AD_START_WAIT_MILLIS = 20_000L
        private const val AD_START_POLL_MILLIS = 2_000L
        private const val LINE_CONFIRM_READS = 5
        private const val SHADE_WAIT_POLLS = 20
        private const val LAUNCH_ATTEMPTS = 3
        private const val TAB_SETTLE_POLLS = 4
        private const val TAB_SETTLE_MIN_BOXES = 15
        private const val POPUP_ATTEMPTS = 3
        private const val NO_CANDIDATE_RETRIES = 2
        private const val INFO_DIALOG_RETRIES = 1

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService
import android.app.KeyguardManager
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import com.rewardadguard.app.data.EventType
import com.rewardadguard.app.manager.EventLogger
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow

/**
 * The runtime conditions a collection run needs, in one place.
 *
 * Three requirements from the plan meet here:
 *  1. **Keep the screen awake.** A 1x1 fully transparent
 *     `TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY` with `keepScreenOn` does it without the
 *     "display over other apps" permission. It is not touchable, so it cannot
 *     interfere with the ad underneath.
 *  2. **Never fight the lock screen.** `KeyguardManager.isKeyguardLocked` is
 *     checked between wait polls; the collector pauses and logs, and never
 *     attempts an unlock (an accessibility service cannot, and should not).
 *  3. **Yield to a real finger.** The guard already timestamps genuine touches
 *     (`TYPE_TOUCH_INTERACTION_START` / non-self `TYPE_VIEW_CLICKED`), so the
 *     same timestamp drives the collector's pause.
 *
 * The state transitions are deliberately simple and owner-driven: the engine
 * (phase 2) calls [start]/[pause]/[resume]/[stop]; the guard only reads
 * [state] through its own provider.
 */
class CollectorEnvironment(
    private val service: AccessibilityService,
    private val logger: EventLogger,
    private val userInteractionAt: () -> Long,
    private val clock: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() },
    private val keyguardLocked: () -> Boolean = {
        runCatching {
            service.getSystemService(KeyguardManager::class.java)?.isKeyguardLocked == true
        }.getOrDefault(false)
    },
    /**
     * Called once when a run starts, after the state is RUNNING. The service
     * uses it to cancel queued returns: a Back that was already scheduled would
     * otherwise land after the collector took over the screen.
     */
    private val onStarted: () -> Unit = {}
) {

    /** State plus the reason of the current pause, for the UI and notification. */
    data class Status(val state: CollectorState, val pauseReason: String? = null)

    @Volatile
    var state: CollectorState = CollectorState.IDLE
        private set

    /** Why the collector is paused (`keyguard_locked`, `user_interaction`, `user_requested`), else null. */
    @Volatile
    var pauseReason: String? = null
        private set

    /**
     * Set by [requestStop] and kept until [beginSequence]: a stop pressed while
     * a multi-app run is between two apps must still stop the next one, so
     * [start] refuses while it is set (review P0-1 follow-up).
     */
    @Volatile
    var stopRequested: Boolean = false
        private set

    private val _status = MutableStateFlow(Status(CollectorState.IDLE))

    /** Every state change, so the UI shows a pause the collector took by itself. */
    val status: StateFlow<Status> = _status.asStateFlow()

    private val overlayLock = Any()
    private var overlay: View? = null
    private var overlayPending = false
    private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    /** The app the current run works on; set by the engine when it starts. */
    @Volatile
    var targetPackage: String? = null

    /** The active window's package, read when deciding about a pause. */
    private fun foregroundNow(): String? =
        runCatching { service.rootInActiveWindow?.packageName?.toString() }.getOrNull()

    /** Clears a previous stop request; call once before a run of one or more apps. */
    fun beginSequence() {
        synchronized(overlayLock) { stopRequested = false }
    }

    /** Stops the current app and every app after it in the same run. */
    fun requestStop() {
        synchronized(overlayLock) { stopRequested = true }
        stop()
    }

    /** Starts a run: shows the wake overlay and takes the screen from the guard. */
    fun start() {
        synchronized(overlayLock) {
            if (state != CollectorState.IDLE || stopRequested) return
            showOverlayLocked()
            state = CollectorState.RUNNING
            publishLocked()
        }
        runCatching(onStarted)
        log("COLLECTOR_START", "SUCCESS", "collector owns the screen")
    }

    /** Pauses without dropping the wake lock; the guard takes over again. */
    fun pause(reason: String) {
        synchronized(overlayLock) {
            when (CollectorInterruption.pauseTransition(state, pauseReason, reason)) {
                CollectorInterruption.PauseTransition.PAUSE -> {
                    state = CollectorState.PAUSED
                    pauseReason = reason
                }
                // Reaching ?怠? means touching the screen, which already paused
                // the run as user_interaction; that pause ends by itself 5 s
                // later, so the user's ?怠? never held (2026-11-12 21:59). The
                // explicit request now takes over the pause.
                CollectorInterruption.PauseTransition.UPGRADE -> pauseReason = reason
                CollectorInterruption.PauseTransition.IGNORE -> return
            }
            publishLocked()
        }
        log("COLLECTOR_PAUSE", "SUCCESS", "reason=$reason")
    }

    fun resume() {
        synchronized(overlayLock) {
            if (state != CollectorState.PAUSED) return
            showOverlayLocked()
            state = CollectorState.RUNNING
            pauseReason = null
            publishLocked()
        }
        log("COLLECTOR_RESUME", "SUCCESS", "collector owns the screen again")
    }

    /** Ends the run and removes the overlay. */
    fun stop() {
        synchronized(overlayLock) {
            if (state == CollectorState.IDLE) return
            hideOverlayLocked()
            state = CollectorState.IDLE
            pauseReason = null
            publishLocked()
        }
        log("COLLECTOR_STOP", "SUCCESS", "collector released the screen")
    }

    /** Public view of the lock state for the run policy (no app may start while locked). */
    fun isKeyguardLocked(): Boolean = runCatching { keyguardLocked() }.getOrDefault(true)

    /**
     * Pauses when the phone is locked or a real finger touched the screen.
     * Called from [Actor.waitFor] between polls; cheap (two reads).
     */
    @Volatile
    private var lastEventCheckAt = 0L

    /**
     * The service calls this for every accessibility event while the
     * collector runs, and an ad delivers CONTENT_CHANGED in floods. Checking
     * the keyguard more than a few times a second adds binder calls on the
     * main thread for nothing; a real finger still pauses at once through the
     * service's own path.
     */
    fun checkInterruptionsThrottled() {
        val now = clock()
        if (now - lastEventCheckAt < EVENT_CHECK_INTERVAL_MILLIS) return
        lastEventCheckAt = now
        checkInterruptions()
    }

    fun checkInterruptions() {
        when (state) {
            CollectorState.RUNNING -> {
                val reason = CollectorInterruption.reason(
                    keyguardLocked = keyguardLocked(),
                    lastUserInteractionAt = userInteractionAt(),
                    now = clock()
                ) ?: return
                pause(reason)
            }

            CollectorState.PAUSED -> {
                val reason = pauseReason
                val front = foregroundNow()
                // The user went to another app while the run was paused by
                // their finger: they are using the phone. Make the pause a
                // real one (only 蝜潛? ends it) instead of pulling them back
                // to the reward app five seconds later (2026-11-13).
                if (CollectorInterruption.userLeftApp(reason, front, targetPackage)) {
                    synchronized(overlayLock) {
                        if (state == CollectorState.PAUSED) {
                            pauseReason = CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_LEFT
                            publishLocked()
                        }
                    }
                    log("COLLECTOR_PAUSE", "SUCCESS", "reason=${CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_LEFT} front=$front")
                    return
                }
                if (!CollectorInterruption.canAutoResume(
                        pauseReason = reason,
                        keyguardLocked = isKeyguardLocked(),
                        lastUserInteractionAt = userInteractionAt(),
                        now = clock(),
                        targetInFront = targetPackage == null || front == targetPackage
                    )
                ) return
                resume()
                log("COLLECTOR_AUTO_RESUME", "SUCCESS", "reason=$reason cleared")
            }

            CollectorState.IDLE -> Unit
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val EVENT_CHECK_INTERVAL_MILLIS = 300L
    }

    private fun publishLocked() {
        _status.value = Status(state, pauseReason)
    }

    /**
     * Shows the wake overlay on the main thread.
     *
     * A view can only be added from a thread with a Looper. The ?芸??嗅? tab
     * starts runs from CollectorController's Dispatchers.Default scope, so
     * addView failed every time ("Can't create handler inside thread",
     * 2026-11-12 21:09) and the screen timed out and locked mid-run. The adb
     * entry happened to start on the main thread, which hid the bug.
     */
    private fun showOverlayLocked() {
        if (overlay != null || overlayPending) return
        if (Looper.myLooper() == Looper.getMainLooper()) {
            addOverlayNow()
        } else {
            overlayPending = true
            mainHandler.post {
                synchronized(overlayLock) {
                    overlayPending = false
                    // The run may have ended before the main thread got here.
                    if (state != CollectorState.IDLE && overlay == null) addOverlayNow()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun addOverlayNow() {
        val manager = runCatching { service.getSystemService(WindowManager::class.java) }.getOrNull() ?: return
        val view = View(service).apply { keepScreenOn = true }
        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            1,
            1,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL,
            PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            x = 0
            y = 0
        }
        runCatching { manager.addView(view, params) }
            .onSuccess {
                overlay = view
                log("OVERLAY", "SUCCESS", "keepScreenOn overlay shown")
            }
            .onFailure {
                log("OVERLAY", "FAILED", "keepScreenOn overlay rejected: ${it.message}")
            }
    }

    private fun hideOverlayLocked() {
        val view = overlay ?: return
        overlay = null
        val remove = {
            runCatching { service.getSystemService(WindowManager::class.java)?.removeView(view) }
            Unit
        }
        if (Looper.myLooper() == Looper.getMainLooper()) remove() else mainHandler.post(remove)
    }

    private fun log(action: String, result: String, message: String) {
        logger.log(
            eventType = EventType.COLLECTOR,
            sessionId = null,
            detectionMethod = "CollectorEnvironment",
            action = action,
            result = result,
            message = message
        )
    }
}

/**
 * Decides whether the collector must pause itself.
 *
 * Both triggers are hard requirements from the plan: the phone cannot be
 * unlocked by an accessibility service, and fighting a real finger for the
 * screen is how the PC script and the guard used to click at the same time.
 * Extracted as a pure function so both thresholds have tests.
 */
object CollectorInterruption {

    /** Same grace as the guard's own `INTERACTION_GRACE_MILLIS`. */
    const val USER_INTERACTION_GRACE_MILLIS = 1_200L

    /**
     * A reason string when the collector must pause, otherwise null.
     *
     * @param keyguardLocked `KeyguardManager.isKeyguardLocked()`.
     * @param lastUserInteractionAt last real-finger event, 0 when none.
     */
    fun reason(keyguardLocked: Boolean, lastUserInteractionAt: Long, now: Long): String? = when {
        keyguardLocked -> REASON_KEYGUARD
        lastUserInteractionAt > 0 && now - lastUserInteractionAt < USER_INTERACTION_GRACE_MILLIS ->
            REASON_USER_INTERACTION
        else -> null
    }

    const val REASON_KEYGUARD = "keyguard_locked"
    const val REASON_USER_INTERACTION = "user_interaction"
    const val REASON_USER_REQUESTED = "user_requested"

    /** The user switched to another app during a finger pause; like a ?怠? press. */
    const val REASON_USER_LEFT = "user_left_app"

    /**
     * A finger pause during which the user opened another app (not the
     * status-bar shade, not an unknown window) becomes a manual pause.
     */
    fun userLeftApp(pauseReason: String?, foreground: String?, target: String?): Boolean {
        if (pauseReason != REASON_USER_INTERACTION || target == null) return false
        val front = foreground?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (front.isEmpty() || front == target || front == "com.android.systemui") return false
        return true
    }

    enum class PauseTransition { PAUSE, UPGRADE, IGNORE }

    /**
     * What a pause request does in the current state: a running collector
     * pauses; an automatic pause becomes the user's own pause when the user
     * asks for one (so it no longer resumes by itself); anything else is
     * ignored.
     */
    fun pauseTransition(state: CollectorState, currentReason: String?, requested: String): PauseTransition =
        when {
            state == CollectorState.RUNNING -> PauseTransition.PAUSE
            state == CollectorState.PAUSED &&
                (requested == REASON_USER_REQUESTED || requested == REASON_USER_LEFT) &&
                currentReason != REASON_USER_REQUESTED && currentReason != REASON_USER_LEFT -> PauseTransition.UPGRADE
            else -> PauseTransition.IGNORE
        }

    /** Quiet time after the last real touch before an automatic pause ends. */
    const val AUTO_RESUME_IDLE_MILLIS = 5_000L

    /**
     * Whether a pause the collector took by itself may end (review P1-3).
     *
     * Only the automatic reasons qualify: a pause the user asked for ends only
     * when the user presses 蝜潛?. The phone must be unlocked and nobody may
     * have touched it for [AUTO_RESUME_IDLE_MILLIS].
     */
    fun canAutoResume(
        pauseReason: String?,
        keyguardLocked: Boolean,
        lastUserInteractionAt: Long,
        now: Long,
        targetInFront: Boolean = true
    ): Boolean {
        if (pauseReason != REASON_KEYGUARD && pauseReason != REASON_USER_INTERACTION) return false
        if (keyguardLocked) return false
        // Only resume where the run left off: with another app (or the home
        // screen) in front the user is doing something else.
        if (!targetInFront) return false
        return lastUserInteractionAt <= 0L || now - lastUserInteractionAt >= AUTO_RESUME_IDLE_MILLIS
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * How many reward iterations a run may attempt.
 *
 * Three values are needed because three callers mean different things by "no
 * number": the UI's 銝? switch, the CLI default, and an explicit user cap.
 * Keeping the mapping in one tested place stops the engine and the UI from
 * disagreeing about what 0 means.
 */
object CollectorLimits {

    /** No user cap; the engine still stops on no candidate, timeout and 60 min. */
    const val UNLIMITED = -1

    /** Use the app profile's own safety cap (pc-collector's `max_rewards`). */
    const val PROFILE_DEFAULT = 0

    fun iterations(rewardLimit: Int, profileMax: Int): Int = when {
        rewardLimit < 0 -> Int.MAX_VALUE
        rewardLimit > 0 -> rewardLimit
        else -> profileMax
    }

    /**
     * True when the user typed an N. The cap is per app: in ?券 every app
     * collects up to N (each engine counts from zero), which the UI now says
     * ("瘥?App ?嗆遛 N ??). Unlimited and the profile default have no user cap.
     */
    fun hasUserCap(rewardLimit: Int): Boolean = rewardLimit > 0
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import com.rewardadguard.app.R

/**
 * Persistent notification for a running collection (phase 5).
 *
 * It carries pause/resume/stop so the user never has to reopen the app while a
 * run is driving the phone. The actions are broadcasts to
 * [CollectorActionReceiver]; the controller owns the state, so the buttons do
 * not duplicate any logic.
 */
object CollectorNotification {

    const val CHANNEL_ID = "collector_run"
    const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 4201

    const val ACTION_PAUSE = "com.rewardadguard.app.collector.PAUSE"
    const val ACTION_RESUME = "com.rewardadguard.app.collector.RESUME"
    const val ACTION_STOP = "com.rewardadguard.app.collector.STOP"

    fun update(context: Context, state: CollectorController.State) {
        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java) ?: return
        if (!state.running) {
            manager.cancel(NOTIFICATION_ID)
            return
        }
        ensureChannel(manager, context)

        val title = state.appName?.let { "?芸??嗅?嚗?it" }
            ?: context.getString(R.string.collector_title)
        val text = state.message +
            if (state.rewards > 0) "嚗歇??${state.rewards}嚗? else ""

        val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_notify_sync)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText(text)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
            .setCategory(NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_PROGRESS)
            .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_LOW)

        if (state.paused) {
            builder.addAction(0, context.getString(R.string.collector_resume), broadcast(context, ACTION_RESUME, 1))
        } else {
            builder.addAction(0, context.getString(R.string.collector_pause), broadcast(context, ACTION_PAUSE, 2))
        }
        builder.addAction(0, context.getString(R.string.collector_stop), broadcast(context, ACTION_STOP, 3))

        runCatching { manager.notify(NOTIFICATION_ID, builder.build()) }
    }

    /**
     * After a run: the rewards whose ad could not be closed twice. A separate
     * notification, because the ongoing one disappears when the run ends.
     */
    fun showManual(context: Context, lines: List<String>) {
        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java) ?: return
        ensureChannel(manager, context)
        val text = lines.joinToString("\n")
        val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_notify_more)
            .setContentTitle("${lines.size} ???菟?閬????)
            .setContentText(lines.first())
            .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText(text))
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_DEFAULT)
        runCatching { manager.notify(MANUAL_NOTIFICATION_ID, builder.build()) }
    }

    const val MANUAL_NOTIFICATION_ID = 4202

    fun cancel(context: Context) {
        context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)?.cancel(NOTIFICATION_ID)
    }

    private fun broadcast(context: Context, action: String, requestCode: Int): PendingIntent {
        val intent = Intent(context, CollectorActionReceiver::class.java).setAction(action)
        return PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
            context,
            requestCode,
            intent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )
    }

    private fun ensureChannel(manager: NotificationManager, context: Context) {
        if (manager.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID) != null) return
        manager.createNotificationChannel(
            NotificationChannel(
                CHANNEL_ID,
                context.getString(R.string.collector_channel_name),
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            ).apply {
                description = context.getString(R.string.collector_notification_channel_description)
                setShowBadge(false)
            }
        )
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import com.rewardadguard.app.detector.AdActivityClassifier

/** What the phone says is in front, sampled right before a screenshot. */
data class Foreground(val packageName: String?, val activity: String?)

/** A rectangle the collector has decided it may tap, and why. */
data class Target(val text: String, val bounds: Box, val score: Int, val source: String) {
    val centerX: Int get() = bounds.centerX
    val centerY: Int get() = bounds.centerY
}

/**
 * The decision half of pc-collector's `apps/base.py`, kept free of Android and
 * of side effects so every rule can be replayed against the 33 recorded
 * screens.
 *
 * The engine calls these; nothing here taps, waits or reads the phone. That
 * split is what makes "would the collector click the store?" answerable in a
 * unit test instead of during a rewarded-ad run.
 */
object CollectorRules {

    val STATUS_TERMS = listOf(
        "皞?銝?, "頝銝活", "??", "??", "撠?", "?拚?", "撌脩???, "撠??",
        "瘣餃???", "隞撌?, "隞予?隞?, "???, "?予?Ｗ儔", "銝活?賜?"
    )

    /** Text that is never a reward target because it leads to a store page. */
    val UNSAFE_REWARD_TEXT = listOf(

        "install", "more info", "moreinfo", "download"

        "nextad", "watchnext", "銝??誨??, "銝??誨??, "銝??典誨??, "閫??銝??,
        "閫??銝??, "蝜潛?閫??, "??銝??, "??銝??, "??銝?誨??, "??銝?誨??,

    private val SYSTEM_PACKAGES = setOf(
        "com.android.systemui", "android", "com.android.intentresolver",
        "com.google.android.permissioncontroller", "com.android.permissioncontroller",
        "com.android.settings", "com.google.android.packageinstaller", "com.android.packageinstaller",
        "com.miui.home", "com.mi.android.globallauncher", "com.miui.securitycenter",
        "com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher",
        "com.android.launcher", "com.android.launcher3", "com.sec.android.app.launcher",
        "com.huawei.android.launcher", "com.oppo.launcher", "com.bbk.launcher2",
