package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.content.Context
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow

/**
 * An app the user added to the collector (2026-11-15). It has no hand-written
 * profile: [toProfile] gives it the generic rules (tap the user's reward
 * words, avoid theirs plus the usual dangerous ones, no tab bar to look for).
 * Whether a given app can be collected this way depends on its screens.
 */
data class CustomApp(
    val id: Long,
    val name: String,
    val packageName: String,
    val rewardTerms: List<String>,
    val avoidTerms: List<String> = emptyList()
) {
    val key: String get() = "custom_$id"

    fun toProfile(): AppProfile = AppProfile(
        key = key,
        name = name,
        packageName = packageName,
        rewardTerms = rewardTerms,
        avoidTerms = (avoidTerms + GENERIC_AVOID).distinct(),
        // No tab bar known: every screen of the package counts as the app's own.
        chromeTerms = emptyList(),
        adMinWatchMillis = 20_000L,
        adTimeoutMillis = 120_000L,
        maxRewards = 30,
        maxRepeatPerTarget = 5,
        launchWaitMillis = 8_000L
    )

    companion object {
        /** Words never tapped in an unknown app: payments, installs, leaving. */
        val GENERIC_AVOID = listOf(
            "撌脤???, "撌脣???, "?予", "?", "鞈潸眺", "隞狡", "?脣?, "閮", "摰?", "銝?",
            "??", "??", "餈?", "?餃", "?芷", "?澈", "?隢?, "??", "閮剖?"
        )

        /** Suggested reward words for a new app. */
        val DEFAULT_REWARD = listOf("??", "?誨??, "閫?誨??, "蝪賢", "?祥??")
    }
}

/**
 * The collector's editable app list: built-in profiles the user hid and apps
 * the user added. Kept in SharedPreferences and mirrored in memory so
 * [CollectorProfiles] can read it from any thread without disk access.
 */
object CustomApps {

    private const val PREFS = "collector_apps"
    private const val KEY_HIDDEN = "hidden"
    private const val KEY_CUSTOM = "custom"

    private val _hidden = MutableStateFlow<Set<String>>(emptySet())
    val hidden: StateFlow<Set<String>> = _hidden.asStateFlow()

    private val _custom = MutableStateFlow<List<CustomApp>>(emptyList())
    val custom: StateFlow<List<CustomApp>> = _custom.asStateFlow()

    private fun prefs(context: Context) =
        context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    /** Called once from Application.onCreate. */
    fun load(context: Context) {
        val p = prefs(context)
        _hidden.value = p.getString(KEY_HIDDEN, "").orEmpty().split(",").filter { it.isNotBlank() }.toSet()
        _custom.value = decode(p.getString(KEY_CUSTOM, null))
    }

    /** JVM tests only: set the list without SharedPreferences. */
    internal fun setForTest(hidden: Set<String>, custom: List<CustomApp>) {
        _hidden.value = hidden
        _custom.value = custom
    }

    fun setHidden(context: Context, key: String, hide: Boolean) {
        val next = if (hide) _hidden.value + key else _hidden.value - key
        prefs(context).edit().putString(KEY_HIDDEN, next.joinToString(",")).apply()
        _hidden.value = next
    }

    fun upsert(context: Context, app: CustomApp) {
        saveCustom(context, _custom.value.filterNot { it.id == app.id } + app)
    }

    fun remove(context: Context, id: Long) {
        saveCustom(context, _custom.value.filterNot { it.id == id })
    }

    private fun saveCustom(context: Context, list: List<CustomApp>) {
        prefs(context).edit().putString(KEY_CUSTOM, encode(list)).apply()
        _custom.value = list
    }

    // ---- storage: one app per line, "id|name|package|reward;reward|avoid;avoid" ----

    /** Strips the separators from user input so a line always splits back. */
    fun clean(text: String): String = text.replace("|", " ").replace(";", " ").replace("\n", " ").trim()

    fun encode(list: List<CustomApp>): String = list.joinToString("\n") { app ->
        listOf(
            app.id.toString(),
            clean(app.name),
            clean(app.packageName),
            app.rewardTerms.map(::clean).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.joinToString(";"),
            app.avoidTerms.map(::clean).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.joinToString(";")
        ).joinToString("|")
    }

    fun decode(raw: String?): List<CustomApp> = raw.orEmpty().lines().mapNotNull { line ->
        val parts = line.split("|")
        if (parts.size != 5) return@mapNotNull null
        val id = parts[0].toLongOrNull() ?: return@mapNotNull null
        val pkg = parts[2].trim().ifEmpty { return@mapNotNull null }
        val reward = parts[3].split(";").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        if (reward.isEmpty()) return@mapNotNull null
        CustomApp(id, parts[1].trim().ifEmpty { pkg }, pkg, reward, parts[4].split(";").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() })
    }

    /** "??, ?誨??蝪賢" -> [??, ?誨?? 蝪賢]. */
    fun splitTerms(text: String): List<String> =
        text.split(',', '嚗?, '??, '\n').map { clean(it) }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.distinct()
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import java.io.File
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.ZoneId

/**
 * One line of the home page's daily summary (asked by the user, 2026-11-15):
 * "[2026/11/15] BITWALK 撌脫蝛?23 ???蛛?撠? 2 ???萄??嗅?".
 *
 * [collected] sums every real (not dry) run of that app that day. What is
 * still waiting is only known as far as the collector knows it: [manual] is
 * what the day's last run left for the user, and [finished] is false when
 * that run did not end with "done" (stopped, paused too long, ...), so more
 * may be waiting than [manual] says.
 */
data class DailyAppSummary(
    val day: LocalDate,
    val appKey: String,
    val appName: String,
    val collected: Int,
    val manual: Int,
    val finished: Boolean,
    /** "HH:mm" of the day's last scan when it came after the last collection. */
    val scannedAt: String? = null,
    /** That scan saw a repeatable ad button: [manual] is not a count. */
    val repeatable: Boolean = false
) {
    fun text(): String {
        val date = "%04d/%02d/%02d".format(day.year, day.monthValue, day.dayOfMonth)
        val rest = when {
            scannedAt != null && !finished -> "$scannedAt ???芸???
            scannedAt != null && repeatable && manual > 0 -> "??撱????舀嚗?scannedAt ??嚗活?訾???"
            scannedAt != null && manual > 0 -> "撠? $manual ???萄??嗅?嚗?scannedAt ??嚗?
            scannedAt != null -> "撌脣?冽摰?$scannedAt ??嚗?
            !finished && manual > 0 -> "撠? $manual ???萄??嗅?嚗?銝活?芾?摰?
            !finished -> "銝活?芾?摰??航???"
            manual > 0 -> "撠? $manual ???萄??嗅?"
            else -> "撌脣?冽摰?
        }
        return "[$date] $appName 撌脫蝛?$collected ???蛛?$rest"
    }
}

/** One run's summary.json, reduced to what the daily summary needs. */
data class RunSummaryRow(
    val appKey: String,
    val appName: String,
    val startedAt: Long,
    val rewards: Int,
    val manual: Int,
    val endReason: String,
    val dryRun: Boolean,
    val scan: Boolean = false,
    val available: Int = -1,
    val repeatable: Boolean = false
)

object DailyRewardSummary {

    /** Groups runs per day and app; newest day first, apps in run order. */
    fun summarize(runs: List<RunSummaryRow>, zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()): List<DailyAppSummary> {
        val real = runs.filter { !it.dryRun && it.endReason != "not_started" }.sortedBy { it.startedAt }
        val groups = LinkedHashMap<Pair<LocalDate, String>, MutableList<RunSummaryRow>>()
        for (run in real) {
            val day = Instant.ofEpochMilli(run.startedAt).atZone(zone).toLocalDate()
            groups.getOrPut(day to run.appKey) { mutableListOf() }.add(run)
        }
        return groups.map { (key, list) ->
            val last = list.last()
            val collects = list.filter { !it.scan }
            // A scan after the last collection knows best what is left.
            val scanned = last.scan
            val time = java.time.Instant.ofEpochMilli(last.startedAt).atZone(zone).toLocalTime()
            DailyAppSummary(
                day = key.first,
                appKey = key.second,
                appName = last.appName,
                collected = collects.sumOf { it.rewards },
                manual = if (scanned) last.available.coerceAtLeast(0) else last.manual,
                finished = last.endReason == "done",
                scannedAt = if (scanned) "%02d:%02d".format(time.hour, time.minute) else null,
                repeatable = scanned && last.repeatable
            )
        }.sortedWith(compareByDescending<DailyAppSummary> { it.day })
    }

    fun parse(json: String): RunSummaryRow? {
        val map = runCatching { MiniJson.parse(json) }.getOrNull() as? Map<*, *> ?: return null
        val key = map["app"] as? String ?: return null
        return RunSummaryRow(
            appKey = key,
            appName = map["name"] as? String ?: key,
            startedAt = (map["startedAt"] as? Number)?.toLong() ?: return null,
            rewards = (map["rewards"] as? Number)?.toInt() ?: 0,
            manual = (map["manual"] as? Number)?.toInt() ?: 0,
            endReason = map["endReason"] as? String ?: "",
            dryRun = map["dryRun"] == true,
            scan = map["scan"] == true,
            available = (map["available"] as? Number)?.toInt() ?: -1,
            repeatable = map["repeatable"] == true
        )
    }

    /** Reads the runs of the last [days] days from `files/collector_runs`. */
    fun load(filesDir: File, days: Long = 2, zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()): List<DailyAppSummary> {
        val since = LocalDate.now(zone).minusDays(days - 1)
        val dirs = File(filesDir, "collector_runs").listFiles { f -> f.isDirectory } ?: return emptyList()
        val rows = dirs.mapNotNull { dir ->
            val file = File(dir, "summary.json")
            if (!file.isFile) null else parse(runCatching { file.readText() }.getOrDefault(""))
        }.filter { !Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.startedAt).atZone(zone).toLocalDate().isBefore(since) }
        return summarize(rows, zone)
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService
import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.util.DisplayMetrics
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewConfiguration
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import kotlin.math.abs

/**
 * The floating ?怠?/蝜潛? and ?迫 buttons shown while a run is active (asked by
 * the user, 2026-11-13), so the run can be controlled from inside the reward
 * app without pulling the notification shade down.
 *
 * It is a TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY (no extra permission). It starts on the
 * left edge, a little above mid-height, and the user can drag it anywhere
 * (2026-11-15): a press that moves past the touch slop drags the whole panel,
 * a press that does not is a button tap. The last position is remembered for
 * the next run. Its screen box is published in [bounds] wherever it is, so the
 * collector never taps it and OCR never reads its labels as content.
 */
class FloatingControls(private val service: AccessibilityService) {

    private val main = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val prefs = service.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private var panel: DragPanel? = null
    private var statusDot: View? = null
    private var statusText: TextView? = null
    private var pauseButton: TextView? = null

    /** Shows, updates or hides the panel for [state]; safe from any thread. */
    fun render(state: CollectorController.State) {
        main.post {
            runCatching { renderNow(state) }
                .onFailure { android.util.Log.e(TAG, "floating panel render failed", it) }
        }
    }

    private fun renderNow(state: CollectorController.State) {
        if (!state.running) {
            hideNow()
        } else {
            showNow()
            applyState(state)
        }
    }

    fun hide() {
        main.post { hideNow() }
    }

    private fun applyState(state: CollectorController.State) {
        val paused = state.paused
        (statusDot?.background as? GradientDrawable)?.setColor(if (paused) AMBER else GREEN)
        statusText?.text = if (paused) "撌脫?? else "?園? ${state.rewards}"
        pauseButton?.apply {
            text = if (paused) "??蝜潛?" else "?? ?怠?"
            background = pill(if (paused) GREEN_DARK else BUTTON_GREY)
        }
    }

    private fun showNow() {
        if (panel != null) return
        val manager = service.getSystemService(WindowManager::class.java) ?: run {
            android.util.Log.w(TAG, "no WindowManager for the floating panel")
            return
        }
        val layout = DragPanel(service).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                cornerRadius = dp(16f)
                setColor(0xE6202124.toInt())
                setStroke(dp(1f).toInt(), 0x33FFFFFF)
            }
            val pad = dp(6f).toInt()
            setPadding(pad, dp(4f).toInt(), pad, pad)
        }

        // Grip: shows the panel can be dragged (any part of it can).
        val grip = TextView(service).apply {
            text = "??????
            setTextColor(0x99FFFFFF.toInt())
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 9f)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        }
        layout.addView(grip, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT))

        val statusRow = LinearLayout(service).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(0, dp(2f).toInt(), 0, dp(5f).toInt())
        }
        val dot = View(service).apply {
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                setColor(GREEN)
            }
        }
        val dotSize = dp(8f).toInt()
        statusRow.addView(dot, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dotSize, dotSize).apply { marginEnd = dp(5f).toInt() })
        val status = TextView(service).apply {
            setTextColor(0xFFE8EAED.toInt())
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 11f)
        }
        statusRow.addView(status)
        layout.addView(statusRow)

        val pause = button("?? ?怠?", BUTTON_GREY) {
            if (CollectorController.state.value.paused) CollectorController.resume() else CollectorController.pause()
        }
        val stop = button("???迫", RED_DARK) { CollectorController.stop() }
        fun buttonParams(top: Int) =
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
                .apply { topMargin = top }
        layout.addView(pause, buttonParams(0))
        layout.addView(stop, buttonParams(dp(6f).toInt()))

        val (screenW, screenH) = screenSize(manager)
        val lp = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            // The spot of the last drag, else the left edge a little above
            // mid-height (where the old fixed panel sat).
            x = prefs.getInt(KEY_X, 0)
            y = prefs.getInt(KEY_Y, (screenH * 0.42).toInt())
        }
        layout.onDrag = { dx, dy ->
            lp.x = (lp.x + dx).coerceIn(0, (screenW - layout.width).coerceAtLeast(0))
            lp.y = (lp.y + dy).coerceIn(0, (screenH - layout.height).coerceAtLeast(0))
            runCatching { manager.updateViewLayout(layout, lp) }
        }
        layout.onDragEnd = {
            prefs.edit().putInt(KEY_X, lp.x).putInt(KEY_Y, lp.y).apply()
            layout.post { publishBounds(layout) }
        }

        val added = runCatching { manager.addView(layout, lp) }
            .onFailure { android.util.Log.w(TAG, "floating panel not shown", it) }
            .isSuccess
        if (!added) return
        android.util.Log.i(TAG, "floating panel shown at ${lp.x},${lp.y}")
        panel = layout
        statusDot = dot
        statusText = status
        pauseButton = pause
        layout.addOnLayoutChangeListener { view, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ ->
            // A spot saved in the other orientation could leave the panel
            // half off screen: pull it back in.
            val maxX = (screenW - view.width).coerceAtLeast(0)
            val maxY = (screenH - view.height).coerceAtLeast(0)
            if (lp.x > maxX || lp.y > maxY) {
                lp.x = lp.x.coerceAtMost(maxX)
                lp.y = lp.y.coerceAtMost(maxY)
                runCatching { manager.updateViewLayout(view, lp) }
            }
            view.post { publishBounds(view) }
        }
    }

    private fun publishBounds(view: View) {
        if (view !== panel) return
        val at = IntArray(2)
        view.getLocationOnScreen(at)
        bounds = Box(at[0], at[1], at[0] + view.width, at[1] + view.height)
    }

    private fun hideNow() {
        val view = panel ?: return
        panel = null
        statusDot = null
        statusText = null
        pauseButton = null
        bounds = null
        runCatching { service.getSystemService(WindowManager::class.java)?.removeView(view) }
    }

    private fun button(label: String, color: Int, onTap: () -> Unit): TextView = TextView(service).apply {
        text = label
        setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF.toInt())
        setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 13f)
        typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        val h = dp(10f).toInt()
        val v = dp(9f).toInt()
        setPadding(h, v, h, v)
        minWidth = dp(72f).toInt()
        background = pill(color)
        isClickable = true
        setOnClickListener {
            // A tap on our own panel is the user commanding the run, not a
            // finger on the reward app: the service ignores clicks from this
            // package, and the click itself acts right away.
            onTap()
        }
    }

    private fun pill(color: Int) = GradientDrawable().apply {
        cornerRadius = dp(10f)
        setColor(color)
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun screenSize(manager: WindowManager): Pair<Int, Int> =
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            val b = manager.maximumWindowMetrics.bounds
            b.width() to b.height()
        } else {
            val m = DisplayMetrics()
            manager.defaultDisplay.getRealMetrics(m)
            m.widthPixels to m.heightPixels
        }

    private fun dp(value: Float): Float =
        TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, value, service.resources.displayMetrics)

    /**
     * The panel's root. A short press reaches the buttons (a tap); once the
     * finger moves past the touch slop the panel takes the gesture over, so it
     * can be dragged by any part of it, buttons included.
     */
    private class DragPanel(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {
        var onDrag: ((Int, Int) -> Unit)? = null
        var onDragEnd: (() -> Unit)? = null

        private val slop = ViewConfiguration.get(context).scaledTouchSlop
        private var downX = 0f
        private var downY = 0f
        private var lastX = 0f
        private var lastY = 0f
        private var dragging = false

        private fun press(ev: MotionEvent) {
            downX = ev.rawX; downY = ev.rawY
            lastX = ev.rawX; lastY = ev.rawY
            dragging = false
        }

        private fun pastSlop(ev: MotionEvent) =
            abs(ev.rawX - downX) > slop || abs(ev.rawY - downY) > slop

        override fun onInterceptTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
            when (ev.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> press(ev)
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> if (!dragging && pastSlop(ev)) dragging = true
            }
            return dragging
        }

        @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
        override fun onTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
            when (ev.actionMasked) {
                // A press on the panel's own background (grip, status line).
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> press(ev)
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    if (!dragging && pastSlop(ev)) dragging = true
                    if (dragging) {
                        val dx = (ev.rawX - lastX).toInt()
                        val dy = (ev.rawY - lastY).toInt()
                        if (dx != 0 || dy != 0) {
                            onDrag?.invoke(dx, dy)
                            lastX += dx; lastY += dy
                        }
                    }
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    if (dragging) onDragEnd?.invoke()
                    dragging = false
                }
            }
            return true
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "FloatingControls"
        private const val PREFS = "floating_controls"
        private const val KEY_X = "x"
        private const val KEY_Y = "y"

        private const val GREEN = 0xFF34A853.toInt()
        private const val AMBER = 0xFFFBBC04.toInt()
        private const val GREEN_DARK = 0xFF1E8E3E.toInt()
        private const val RED_DARK = 0xFFC5221F.toInt()
        private const val BUTTON_GREY = 0xFF3C4043.toInt()

        /** The panel's box on screen while shown, else null. */
        @Volatile
        var bounds: Box? = null
            internal set

        /** True when (x, y) would land on the panel (with a small margin). */
        fun covers(x: Int, y: Int, margin: Int = 24): Boolean {
            val box = bounds ?: return false
            return x in (box.left - margin)..(box.right + margin) && y in (box.top - margin)..(box.bottom + margin)
        }

        /** Drops text read off the panel itself ("?怠?", "?迫", "?園? 3"). */
        fun withoutPanel(boxes: List<TextBox>): List<TextBox> {
            val box = bounds ?: return boxes
            return boxes.filterNot { box.containsPoint(it.bounds.centerX, it.bounds.centerY) }
        }
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * LINE ??郊頞?specific rules, ported from `apps/linewalk.py`.
 *
 * Separated from [CollectorRules] because LINE is the only app with a reward
 * *choice sheet* (蝝/?桅???), a stand-up challenge and a lottery. Putting
 * these in the shared rules would make every other app pay for them and would
 * hide the one rule that matters most: a "?脣??馳" banner on the right side,
 * next to an AD / Sponsored label, is an ad banner and must never be tapped.
 */
object LineWalkRules {

    data class ChoiceSheet(val bonus: Target?, val normal: Target?, val cancel: Target?)

    data class LotterySheet(
        val big: Target?,
        val free: Target?,
        val normal: Target?,
        val cooldowns: Map<String, String>,
        val counts: Map<String, Int>
    )

    private val AMOUNT = Regex("(\\d+)?脣?$")
    private val BANNER_MARKERS = listOf("ad", "sponsored", "sponsoredby", "???")
    private const val BANNER_DISTANCE_PX = 300

    /**
     * LINE's ?隢末??promotion ("?擃??10000 ?馳 / ??賢?脣??馳! /
     * ?隢末??). Nothing on it may be tapped - its button sends invitations -
     * so it is left with Back (2026-11-13 15:02).
     */
    fun isInvitePromo(snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean {
        val text = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
        return "?隢末?? in text && ("??? in text || "鋡恍?隢?憟賢?" in text || "?隢遙?? in text)
    }

    fun isChallenge(snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean =
        snapshot.boxes.any { TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text).contains("蝒??") }

    fun challengeFinished(snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean {
        val text = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
        return "finish" in text || "銝活?? in text
    }

    /** The "?脣??馳" button of a challenge, which only works after FINISH. */
    fun challengeButton(snapshot: Snapshot): Target? {
        val box = snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull {
            TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text).contains("?脣??馳") &&
                (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2 > snapshot.height * 0.6
        } ?: return null
        return Target(box.text, box.bounds, 100, "challenge_claim")
    }

    /**
     * The coin counter at the top left ("510"), used to verify that an ad
     * actually paid. Returns null when it is not readable.
     */
    fun coinBalance(snapshot: Snapshot): Int? {
        for (box in snapshot.boxes) {
            if (box.bounds.top >= 260) continue
            if (box.bounds.left <= 150 || box.bounds.left >= 500) continue
            val digits = box.text.filter { it.isDigit() }
            if (digits.isNotEmpty()) return digits.toIntOrNull()
        }
        return null
    }

    /**
     * The real reward buttons are wide and centred. The adjoe banner that also
     * says "?脣??馳!!" sits right of centre next to an AD/Sponsored label, and a
     * grey challenge button is not tappable until FINISH.
     */
    fun candidateAllowed(candidate: Target, snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean {
        // "56 % ?脣??馳" is the home meter still filling up, not a reward
        // button; tapping it did nothing three times in a row (2026-11-12).
        if (candidate.text.contains('%') || candidate.text.contains('嚗?)) return false
        val cx = candidate.centerX
        if (cx < snapshot.width * 0.25 || cx > snapshot.width * 0.75) return false
        if (isChallenge(snapshot)) return false
        for (box in snapshot.boxes) {
            val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(box.text)
            if (BANNER_MARKERS.none { value == it || value.startsWith(it) }) continue
            val cy = (box.bounds.top + box.bounds.bottom) / 2
            if (kotlin.math.abs(cy - candidate.centerY) <= BANNER_DISTANCE_PX) return false
        }
        return true
    }

    /** Parses the bottom sheet shown after "?脣??馳/蟡典". */
    fun choiceSheet(snapshot: Snapshot): ChoiceSheet? {
        val amounts = ArrayList<TextBox>()
        var bonusLabel: TextBox? = null
        var skipLabel: TextBox? = null
        var cancel: TextBox? = null
        for (box in snapshot.boxes) {
            val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(box.text)
            when {
                value == "蝝" -> bonusLabel = box
                value.contains("頝喲?撱??") -> skipLabel = box
                value == "??" -> cancel = box
            }
            val amount = AMOUNT.find(value)
            if (amount != null && value.length <= 10 &&
                (box.bounds.top + box.bounds.bottom) / 2 > snapshot.height * 0.4
            ) {
                amounts.add(box)
            }
        }
        if (amounts.isEmpty() || (bonusLabel == null && skipLabel == null && cancel == null)) return null

        fun below(label: TextBox?, limit: Double): TextBox? {
            if (label == null) return null
            val hits = amounts.filter {
                val cy = (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2
                cy >= label.bounds.top - 20 && cy <= label.bounds.bottom + limit
            }
            return hits.minByOrNull { (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2 }
        }

        val skip = below(skipLabel, snapshot.height * 0.06)
        var bonus = below(bonusLabel, snapshot.height * 0.08)
        if (bonus === skip) bonus = null
        val others = amounts.filter { it !== skip && it !== bonus }
        val normal = others.maxByOrNull { (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2 }

        return ChoiceSheet(
            bonus = bonus?.let { Target(it.text, it.bounds, 100, "choice_bonus") },
            normal = normal?.let { Target(it.text, it.bounds, 100, "choice_normal") },
            cancel = cancel?.let { Target(it.text, it.bounds, 100, "choice_cancel") }
        )
    }

    /** Markers that prove a tab really switched (PC `TAB_MARKERS`). */
    fun onTab(snapshot: Snapshot, tab: String): Boolean {
        val text = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
        if (tab == "??" && "隞予?郊?? in text) return false
        val markers = when (tab) {
            "擐?" -> listOf("?漲x3", "?脣??馳")
            "甇交" -> listOf("隞予?郊??)
            "??" -> listOf("?脣?蟡典")
            else -> emptyList()
        }
        return markers.isEmpty() || markers.any { TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it) in text }
    }

    /**
     * Draw buttons on the open ?賣璅?sheet, plus cooldowns and remaining
     * counts. The BIG button is the left ticket button, the normal one right.
     */
    fun lotterySheet(snapshot: Snapshot): LotterySheet? {
        val title = snapshot.boxes.any {
            TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text) == "?賣璅? &&
                (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2 < snapshot.height * 0.2
        }
        val controls = snapshot.boxes.any {
            val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text)
            value.endsWith("??甈?) || value.startsWith("?儔??")
        }
        if (!title || !controls) return null

        var big: TextBox? = null
        var free: TextBox? = null
        var normal: TextBox? = null
        for (box in snapshot.boxes) {
            val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(box.text)
            if (value.contains("?祥??甈?)) {
                free = box
                continue
            }
            if (!value.endsWith("??甈?)) continue
            val cx = (box.bounds.left + box.bounds.right) / 2
            if (cx < snapshot.width / 2) {
                if (big == null) big = box
            } else if (normal == null) {
                normal = box
            }
        }

        val cooldowns = HashMap<String, String>()
        val time = Regex("\\d{1,2}\\s*:\\s*\\d{2}\\s*:\\s*\\d{2}")
        for (box in snapshot.boxes) {
            val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(box.text)
            if (!value.startsWith("?儔??")) continue
            val kind = if ((box.bounds.left + box.bounds.right) / 2 < snapshot.width / 2) "big" else "free"
            val match = time.find(box.text)
            cooldowns.putIfAbsent(kind, match?.value?.replace(" ", "") ?: "")
        }

        fun target(box: TextBox?, source: String): Target? =
            box?.let { Target(it.text, it.bounds, 100, source) }

        val buttons = LotterySheet(
            big = target(big, "lottery_big"),
            free = target(free, "lottery_free"),
            normal = target(normal, "lottery_normal"),
            cooldowns = cooldowns,
            counts = emptyMap()
        )
        return buttons.copy(counts = lotteryCounts(snapshot, buttons))
    }

    /** Remaining tickets, read from the red badge above the ticket buttons. */
    private fun lotteryCounts(snapshot: Snapshot, sheet: LotterySheet): Map<String, Int> {
        val counts = HashMap<String, Int>()
        for ((kind, target) in listOf("big" to sheet.big, "normal" to sheet.normal)) {
            if (target == null) continue
            val badge = snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull {
                val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text)
                if (value.toIntOrNull() == null) return@firstOrNull false
                val cx = (it.bounds.left + it.bounds.right) / 2
                val cy = (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2
                cy in (target.centerY - 220)..(target.centerY - 40) &&
                    cx in (target.centerX + 60)..(target.centerX + 320)
            }
            badge?.let { counts[kind] = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text).toInt() }
        }
        // The 2026-11-22 screen kept the normal button at "5撘菜1甈? while the
        // only ticket balance was the blue badge in the banner's top-right
        // corner ("1"). Nothing sits above that button there, so read the
        // banner badge as the normal balance when no per-button badge exists.
        if (counts["normal"] == null) {
            lotteryBannerTickets(snapshot)?.let { counts["normal"] = it }
        }
        return counts
    }

    /** The blue ticket counter at the top-right of the ?賣璅?banner. */
    private fun lotteryBannerTickets(snapshot: Snapshot): Int? =
        snapshot.boxes
            .filter {
                val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text)
                if (value.length !in 1..4 || value.toIntOrNull() == null) return@filter false
                val cx = (it.bounds.left + it.bounds.right) / 2
                val cy = (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2
                cx > snapshot.width * 0.65 &&
                    cy in (snapshot.height * 0.055).toInt()..(snapshot.height * 0.16).toInt()
            }
            .minByOrNull { (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2 }
            ?.let { TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text).toIntOrNull() }

    /**
     * An in-app store page a draw opened (momo 鞈潛 in LINE's own browser on
     * 2026-11-12). Only unambiguous markers count: "銝?" or "??" alone show
     * up on ordinary LINE screens ("???"), and treating those as a store
     * page pressed Back or an X on the lottery itself (review P2-7).
     */
    fun looksLikeStorePage(snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean {
        val text = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
        if (text.isEmpty()) return false
        // Never while the lottery sheet itself is up: its banner ad shows
        // "Google Play" and "摰?" (2026-11-12 20:01), and calling that a store
        // page pressed Back and left LINE.
        if (lotterySheet(snapshot) != null) return false
        return ("install" in text && "moreinfo" in text) ||
            "playstore" in text || "momo鞈潛" in text
    }

    /**
     * The prize text of a draw ("20??撟?葉??!"), with or without the
     * ?? button. A prize counts as a reward even when its close button is
     * missing; waiting 240 s and calling it a failure lost the prize (P2-8).
     */
    fun isLotteryPrize(snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean =
        lotterySheet(snapshot) == null &&
            snapshot.boxes.any { isPrizeText(it.text) }

    /** The "XX??撟?葉??嚗???" result sheet. */
    fun lotteryResultClose(snapshot: Snapshot): Target? {
        if (snapshot.boxes.none { isPrizeText(it.text) }) return null
        val close = snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull { TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text) in CLOSE_LABELS } ?: return null
        return Target(close.text, close.bounds, 100, "lottery_close")
    }

    private const val SKIP_MAX_LEN = 8

    /**
     * "50 ??撟?葉??嚗?: OCR has read ??as ??and can read ??as 憟?or the
     * simplified 憟? a prize the reader could not match was waited out and
     * called a failure (2026-11-12 23:22).
     */
    private val PRIZE_MARKERS = listOf("銝剔?", "銝剖布", "銝剖?", "??", "憟砍?", "憟?", "?馳銝?)
    private val CLOSE_LABELS = setOf("??", "?喲", "??)

    fun isPrizeText(text: String): Boolean {
        val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(text)
        return PRIZE_MARKERS.any { it in value }
    }

    /** BIG (50 撘? and ?祥 draw once and then count down; 銝??5 撘?repeats. */
    fun isOncePerCooldown(kind: String): Boolean = kind == "big" || kind == "free"

    const val LOTTERY_NORMAL_TICKETS = 5

    /**
     * The normal draw needs [LOTTERY_NORMAL_TICKETS] tickets. A badge below
     * that means no draw is possible, even though LINE still shows the button
     * (2026-11-21: 4 tickets were tapped twice and waited out).
     */
    fun lotteryTicketsLow(sheet: LotterySheet?): Boolean =
        sheet?.counts?.get("normal")?.let { it < LOTTERY_NORMAL_TICKETS } == true

    /** LINE's own "not enough tickets" message after a draw was refused. */
    fun lotteryNotEnoughTickets(snapshot: Snapshot): Boolean {
        val text = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(snapshot.text)
        return NOT_ENOUGH_TICKETS.any { it in text }
    }

    private val NOT_ENOUGH_TICKETS = listOf("蟡典銝雲", "?賜??訾?頞?, "隞?馳銝雲", "暺銝雲", "?⊥??賜?")

    fun lotteryEntry(snapshot: Snapshot): Target? {
        val box = snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull {
            TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text) == "?賣璅? &&
                (it.bounds.top + it.bounds.bottom) / 2 < snapshot.height * 0.8
        } ?: return null
        return Target(box.text, box.bounds, 100, "lottery_entry")
    }

    fun findSkip(snapshot: Snapshot): Target? {
        // The draw animation's button reads "SKIP ?閏"; OCR keeps the glyphs
        // ("skip>i", "skipi"), and the exact match missed it (2026-11-12
        // 22:34). A short label starting with "skip" counts; "Skip to Google
        // Play" is far longer and never does.
        val box = snapshot.boxes.firstOrNull {
            val value = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(it.text)
            value.startsWith("skip") && value.length <= SKIP_MAX_LEN
        } ?: return null
        return Target(box.text, box.bounds, 100, "skip")
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * A very small JSON reader, only used to load pc-collector's recorded OCR
 * fixtures.
 *
 * Why not `org.json`: the fixtures are read from JVM unit tests, where the
 * Android stub classes are intentionally replaced by defaults. Kotlin has no
 * JSON parser in its standard library either, and pulling a serialization
 * library into the production APK just to read test data would be wrong. This
 * parser lives in `main` so the same code can read a fixture that a bug report
 * attaches to the app later on.
 *
 * Supported grammar is deliberately the whole of JSON (objects, arrays,
 * strings with escapes, numbers, booleans, null); only the value type mapping
 * is simplified: objects become [Map], arrays [List], integral numbers [Long],
 * everything else [Double].
 */
internal object MiniJson {

    fun parse(text: String): Any? {
        val parser = Parser(text)
        val value = parser.readValue()
        parser.skipWhitespace()
        if (!parser.atEnd()) throw IllegalArgumentException("unexpected trailing data at ${parser.position()}")
        return value
    }

    private class Parser(private val text: String) {

        private var index = 0

        fun position(): Int = index

        fun atEnd(): Boolean = index >= text.length

        fun skipWhitespace() {
            while (index < text.length && text[index].isWhitespace()) index++
        }

        fun readValue(): Any? {
            skipWhitespace()
            if (atEnd()) throw IllegalArgumentException("unexpected end of JSON")
            return when (val ch = text[index]) {
                '{' -> readObject()
                '[' -> readArray()
                '"' -> readString()
                't' -> readLiteral("true", true)
                'f' -> readLiteral("false", false)
                'n' -> readLiteral("null", null)
                else -> {
                    if (ch == '-' || ch.isDigit()) readNumber()
                    else throw IllegalArgumentException("unexpected character '$ch' at $index")
                }
            }
        }

        private fun readObject(): Map<String, Any?> {
            expect('{')
            val result = LinkedHashMap<String, Any?>()
            skipWhitespace()
            if (peek() == '}') {
                index++
                return result
            }
            while (true) {
                skipWhitespace()
                val key = readString()
                skipWhitespace()
                expect(':')
                result[key] = readValue()
                skipWhitespace()
                when (peek()) {
                    ',' -> index++
                    '}' -> {
                        index++
                        return result
                    }
                    else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("expected ',' or '}' at $index")
                }
            }
        }

        private fun readArray(): List<Any?> {
            expect('[')
            val result = ArrayList<Any?>()
            skipWhitespace()
            if (peek() == ']') {
                index++
                return result
            }
            while (true) {
                result.add(readValue())
                skipWhitespace()
                when (peek()) {
                    ',' -> index++
                    ']' -> {
                        index++
                        return result
                    }
                    else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("expected ',' or ']' at $index")
                }
            }
        }

        private fun readString(): String {
            expect('"')
            val builder = StringBuilder()
            while (true) {
                if (atEnd()) throw IllegalArgumentException("unterminated string")
                val ch = text[index++]
                when (ch) {
                    '"' -> return builder.toString()
                    '\\' -> {
                        if (atEnd()) throw IllegalArgumentException("unterminated escape")
                        when (val escaped = text[index++]) {
                            '"', '\\', '/' -> builder.append(escaped)
                            'b' -> builder.append('\b')
                            'f' -> builder.append('\u000C')
                            'n' -> builder.append('\n')
                            'r' -> builder.append('\r')
                            't' -> builder.append('\t')
                            'u' -> {
                                if (index + 4 > text.length) {
                                    throw IllegalArgumentException("truncated \\u escape")
                                }
                                val hex = text.substring(index, index + 4)
                                builder.append(hex.toInt(16).toChar())
                                index += 4
                            }
                            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("invalid escape '\\$escaped'")
                        }
                    }
                    else -> builder.append(ch)
                }
            }
        }

        private fun readNumber(): Number {
            val start = index
            if (peek() == '-') index++
            while (!atEnd() && text[index].isDigit()) index++
            var isFloating = false
            if (!atEnd() && text[index] == '.') {
                isFloating = true
                index++
                while (!atEnd() && text[index].isDigit()) index++
            }
            if (!atEnd() && (text[index] == 'e' || text[index] == 'E')) {
                isFloating = true
                index++
                if (!atEnd() && (text[index] == '+' || text[index] == '-')) index++
                while (!atEnd() && text[index].isDigit()) index++
            }
            val raw = text.substring(start, index)
            return if (isFloating) raw.toDouble() else raw.toLong()
        }

        private fun <T> readLiteral(literal: String, value: T): T {
            if (!text.startsWith(literal, index)) {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("invalid literal at $index")
            }
            index += literal.length
            return value
        }

        private fun peek(): Char {
            if (atEnd()) throw IllegalArgumentException("unexpected end of JSON")
            return text[index]
        }

        private fun expect(expected: Char) {
            if (peek() != expected) {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("expected '$expected' at $index")
            }
            index++
        }
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.os.SystemClock
import java.io.File
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * OCR calibration mode (2026-11-16). ML Kit misreads Traditional Chinese now
 * and then (蝳桃??-> ???/ 瞉抒?? where the PC script's Windows OCR
 * (zh-Hant-TW) reads it right. With this switched on, every OCR'd screenshot
 * is kept with what ML Kit read, so `TOOLS/ocr_calibrate.py` on the PC can
 * read the same images with Windows OCR and list ML Kit's look-alike
 * mistakes for [OcrCorrections].
 *
 * Files: `files/ocr_calibration/<yyyyMMdd>/<HHmmss_SSS>_<package>.jpg` and a
 * `.tsv` beside it, one line per text box: left, top, right, bottom, text.
 * At most [DAILY_LIMIT] a day, one per [MIN_GAP_MILLIS], kept [KEEP_DAYS] days.
 */
object OcrCalibration {

    private const val PREFS = "collector_debug"
    private const val KEY_ENABLED = "ocr_calibration"
    const val DIR = "ocr_calibration"
    const val DAILY_LIMIT = 150
    private const val MIN_GAP_MILLIS = 3_000L
    private const val KEEP_DAYS = 3
    private const val JPEG_QUALITY = 85

    @Volatile
    private var enabledCache: Boolean? = null
    private var lastSavedAt = 0L

    fun isEnabled(context: Context): Boolean =
        enabledCache ?: context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getBoolean(KEY_ENABLED, false).also { enabledCache = it }

    fun setEnabled(context: Context, enabled: Boolean) {
        context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().putBoolean(KEY_ENABLED, enabled).apply()
        enabledCache = enabled
    }

    /** Images kept today (for the UI). */
    fun todayCount(context: Context): Int =
        dayDir(context, Date()).listFiles { f -> f.name.endsWith(".jpg") }?.size ?: 0

    /** Keeps [bitmap] and ML Kit's [boxes]; cheap no-op when switched off. */
    @Synchronized
    fun maybeSave(context: Context, bitmap: Bitmap, boxes: List<TextBox>, packageName: String?) {
        if (!isEnabled(context) || boxes.isEmpty()) return
        val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        if (lastSavedAt != 0L && now - lastSavedAt < MIN_GAP_MILLIS) return
        val date = Date()
        val dir = dayDir(context, date)
        if (!dir.isDirectory && !dir.mkdirs()) return
        if ((dir.listFiles { f -> f.name.endsWith(".jpg") }?.size ?: 0) >= DAILY_LIMIT) return
        lastSavedAt = now
        val stem = SimpleDateFormat("HHmmss_SSS", Locale.US).format(date) + "_" +
            (packageName ?: "unknown").replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9._]"), "_")
        runCatching {
            File(dir, "$stem.jpg").outputStream().use { bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, JPEG_QUALITY, it) }
            File(dir, "$stem.tsv").writeText(
                boxes.joinToString("\n") { b ->
                    "${b.bounds.left}\t${b.bounds.top}\t${b.bounds.right}\t${b.bounds.bottom}\t" +
                        b.text.replace('\t', ' ').replace('\n', ' ')
                },
                Charsets.UTF_8
            )
        }
        prune(context)
    }

    private fun dayDir(context: Context, date: Date): File =
        File(File(context.filesDir, DIR), SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd", Locale.US).format(date))

    private fun prune(context: Context) {
        val root = File(context.filesDir, DIR)
        val days = root.listFiles { f -> f.isDirectory }?.sortedByDescending { it.name } ?: return
        days.drop(KEEP_DAYS).forEach { it.deleteRecursively() }
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Phrase fixes for ML Kit's Traditional Chinese misreads (2026-11-16), from
 * `assets/ocr_corrections.tsv` (wrong<TAB>right). Applied to OCR text only;
 * node text is exact. Phrases rather than characters: ??is right in ?? and
 * wrong only in ??? New pairs come from `TOOLS/ocr_calibrate.py`, which
 * compares calibration captures with Windows OCR (zh-Hant-TW).
 */
object OcrCorrections {

    const val ASSET = "ocr_corrections.tsv"

    @Volatile
    private var pairs: List<Pair<String, String>>? = null

    fun load(context: Context): List<Pair<String, String>> = pairs ?: synchronized(this) {
        pairs ?: runCatching {
            context.assets.open(ASSET).bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { parse(it.readText()) }
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList()).also { pairs = it }
    }

    fun parse(text: String): List<Pair<String, String>> = text.lines()
        .map { it.trim() }
        .filter { it.isNotEmpty() && !it.startsWith("#") }
        .mapNotNull { line ->
            val parts = line.split('\t')
            val wrong = parts.getOrNull(0)?.trim().orEmpty()
            val right = parts.getOrNull(1)?.trim().orEmpty()
            if (wrong.isEmpty() || right.isEmpty() || wrong == right) null else wrong to right
        }
        // Longest first, so a longer phrase wins over a shorter one inside it.
        .sortedByDescending { it.first.length }

    fun apply(text: String, pairs: List<Pair<String, String>>): String {
        var value = text
        for ((wrong, right) in pairs) {
            if (wrong in value) value = value.replace(wrong, right)
        }
        return value
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * Whether another app in front is an ad's redirect or the user using the phone.
 *
 * Only the first is the run's business (asked by the user, 2026-11-13: "?嗡?
 * APP銝隤文?箏?瘚?). At 17:47 the user swiped to Twitter during a BITWALK run;
 * a gesture makes no click event, so nothing paused the run, Twitter was taken
 * for a redirect, Back was pressed on it and BITWALK was relaunched over it.
 *
 * A redirect is what an ad does: the store or a browser, or any app that comes
 * up within a few seconds of the collector's own tap or Back. Anything else is
 * the user's, and the run steps aside.
 */
object RedirectJudge {

    /** An app opening this soon after our own action is that action's result. */
    const val OWN_ACTION_WINDOW_MILLIS = 8_000L

    private val STORE_OR_BROWSER = setOf(
        "com.android.vending",
        "com.android.chrome", "com.chrome.beta",
        "com.mi.globalbrowser", "com.android.browser",
        "org.mozilla.firefox", "com.microsoft.emmx", "com.opera.browser",
        "com.sec.android.app.sbrowser", "com.brave.browser", "com.duckduckgo.mobile.android"
    )

    fun isAdRedirect(foreground: String?, sinceOwnActionMillis: Long): Boolean {
        val pkg = foreground?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (pkg.isEmpty()) return true // unknown: keep the old, careful handling
        if (pkg in STORE_OR_BROWSER) return true
        return sinceOwnActionMillis in 0..OWN_ACTION_WINDOW_MILLIS
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

/**
 * Evidence that a reward was actually credited, not just that an ad ended.
 *
 * An ad closing and the reward arriving are different events: the ad can be
 * skipped, interrupted, or closed before the server pays (review 2026-11-12,
 * P1). A reward counts only with one of two proofs on screen:
 *  1. the app's own reward dialog ("?函敺?BTC!", "?剖?", ...), or
 *  2. the app's balance going up (BITWALK's mBTC).
 */
object RewardConfirmation {

    /** The app's reward dialog is on screen. */
    fun hasRewardDialog(snapshot: Snapshot, profile: AppProfile): Boolean =
        CollectorRules.dialogAnchor(snapshot, profile) != null

    /** The balance the profile can read, or null when it is not on screen. */
    fun balance(snapshot: Snapshot, profile: AppProfile): Double? {
        val pattern = profile.balancePattern ?: return null
        for (box in snapshot.boxes) {
            val match = pattern.find(box.text) ?: continue
            val raw = match.groupValues[1]
                .replace(" ", "")
                .replace('繚', '.')
                .replace('嚗?, '.')
            raw.toDoubleOrNull()?.let { return it }
        }
        return null
    }

    /** True when [after] proves a reward compared with [before]. */
    fun confirmed(before: Snapshot, after: Snapshot, profile: AppProfile): Boolean {
        if (hasRewardDialog(after, profile)) return true
        val was = balance(before, profile) ?: return false
        val now = balance(after, profile) ?: return false
        return now > was
    }
}

/**
 * Fixed-time "rewards have reset" reminders (asked by the user, 2026-11-15).
 *
 * Each entry is a daily time and the apps whose rewards reset then (most
 * reset at midnight). When it fires, one notification names those apps, with
 * a ???嗅? button that starts a run of exactly them (the user unlocked the
 * phone to press it, so the run may start at once).
 *
 * Detecting the reset from each app's screen was considered and set aside
 * for now: the run records keep only tapped texts, so every app's countdown
 * wording would first have to be studied on the phone.
 *
 * Shares [ScheduleEntry] and [ScheduleMath] with the run schedules; it has its
 * own entries, alarm and notification so the two never interfere.
 */
object RewardReminders {

    private const val TAG = "RewardReminders"
    private const val PREFS = "collector_reminders"
    private const val KEY_ENTRIES = "entries"
    const val ACTION_ALARM = "com.rewardadguard.app.collector.REMINDER_ALARM"
    const val ACTION_COLLECT = "com.rewardadguard.app.collector.REMINDER_COLLECT"
    private const val EXTRA_ID = "entry_id"
    private const val EXTRA_APPS = "apps"

    const val CHANNEL_ID = "collector_reminder"
    const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 4204
    const val SCAN_NOTIFICATION_ID = 4205

    private val _entries = MutableStateFlow<List<ScheduleEntry>>(emptyList())
    val entries: StateFlow<List<ScheduleEntry>> = _entries.asStateFlow()

    @Volatile
    private var loaded = false

    private fun prefs(context: Context) =
        context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun load(context: Context) {
        if (loaded) return
        synchronized(this) {
            if (loaded) return
            _entries.value = ScheduleMath.decode(prefs(context).getString(KEY_ENTRIES, null))
            loaded = true
        }
    }

    fun upsert(context: Context, entry: ScheduleEntry) {
        load(context)
        save(context, _entries.value.filterNot { it.id == entry.id } + entry)
    }

    fun remove(context: Context, id: Long) {
        load(context)
        save(context, _entries.value.filterNot { it.id == id })
    }

    private fun save(context: Context, entries: List<ScheduleEntry>) {
        val sorted = ScheduleMath.decode(ScheduleMath.encode(entries))
        prefs(context).edit().putString(KEY_ENTRIES, ScheduleMath.encode(sorted)).apply()
        _entries.value = sorted
        reschedule(context)
    }

    /** Sets (or cancels) the single alarm for the earliest enabled reminder. */
    fun reschedule(context: Context) {
        load(context)
        val alarms = context.getSystemService(AlarmManager::class.java) ?: return
        val intent = Intent(context, ReminderAlarmReceiver::class.java).setAction(ACTION_ALARM)
        val next = ScheduleMath.nextDue(_entries.value, System.currentTimeMillis())
        if (next == null) {
            alarms.cancel(PendingIntent.getBroadcast(context, 0, intent, PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE))
            return
        }
        val (entry, at) = next
        intent.putExtra(EXTRA_ID, entry.id)
        val operation = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
            context, 0, intent, PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )
        runCatching {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.S || alarms.canScheduleExactAlarms()) {
                alarms.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, at, operation)
            } else {
                alarms.setAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, at, operation)
            }
        }.onFailure { Log.w(TAG, "reminder alarm not set", it) }
    }

    internal fun onAlarm(context: Context, entryId: Long) {
        load(context)
        val entry = _entries.value.firstOrNull { it.id == entryId && it.enabled }
        if (entry != null) notifyReset(context, entry)
        reschedule(context)
    }

    private fun ensureChannel(manager: NotificationManager) {
        if (manager.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID) != null) return
        manager.createNotificationChannel(
            NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, "???", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT).apply {
                description = "??蔭????????
            }
        )
    }

    /** The reminder itself; public for the debug harness. */
    fun notifyReset(context: Context, entry: ScheduleEntry) {
        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java) ?: return
        ensureChannel(manager)
        val apps = ScheduleMath.appsLabel(entry.appKeys)
        val open = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            context, 1,
            Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )
        val collect = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
            context, 2,
            Intent(context, ReminderAlarmReceiver::class.java)
                .setAction(ACTION_COLLECT)
                .putExtra(EXTRA_APPS, entry.appKeys.joinToString(",")),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )
        val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_popup_reminder)
            .setContentTitle("?撌脤?蝵殷?${entry.timeText}嚗?)
            .setContentText("?臭誑?嗅?鈭?$apps")
            .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText("?臭誑?嗅?鈭?$apps"))
            .setContentIntent(open)
            .addAction(0, "???嗅?", collect)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
        runCatching { manager.notify(NOTIFICATION_ID, builder.build()) }
    }

    /**
     * The result of a scan run (2026-11-15): what each app still offers, with
     * ???嗅? for the apps that have something left.
     */
    fun notifyScan(context: Context, results: List<ScanResult>) {
        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java) ?: return
        ensureChannel(manager)
        // A repeatable ad button counts as "something left", not as a number.
        val total = results.filter { !it.repeatable }.sumOf { it.available.coerceAtLeast(0) }
        val ads = results.any { it.repeatable && it.available > 0 }
        val lines = results.joinToString("\n") { it.text() }
        val open = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            context, 3,
            Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )
        val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_search)
            .setContentTitle(
                when {
                    total > 0 && ads -> "??摰?嚗???$total ???蛛?撱???敺??
                    total > 0 -> "??摰?嚗???$total ???萄??嗅?"
                    ads -> "??摰?嚗?撱???敺??
                    else -> "??摰?嚗????嗅?????
                }
            )
            .setContentText(lines.lineSequence().first())
            .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText(lines))
            .setContentIntent(open)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
        val pendingKeys = results.filter { it.available > 0 }.map { it.appKey }
        if (pendingKeys.isNotEmpty()) {
            val collect = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                context, 4,
                Intent(context, ReminderAlarmReceiver::class.java)
                    .setAction(ACTION_COLLECT)
                    .putExtra(EXTRA_APPS, pendingKeys.joinToString(",")),
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
            )
            builder.addAction(0, "???嗅?", collect)
        }
        runCatching { manager.notify(SCAN_NOTIFICATION_ID, builder.build()) }
    }

    /** The notification's ???嗅?: runs the reminder's apps now. */
    internal fun collectNow(context: Context, appsCsv: String?) {
        context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)?.apply {
            cancel(NOTIFICATION_ID)
            cancel(SCAN_NOTIFICATION_ID)
        }
        val profiles = appsCsv.orEmpty().split(",").mapNotNull { CollectorProfiles.byKey(it) }.distinct()
        val service = RewardAdAccessibilityService.instance
        val error = if (service == null) {
            "?⊿?蝷????芸停蝺?
        } else {
            CollectorController.start(service, profiles, CollectorLimits.UNLIMITED, dryRun = false)
        }
        if (error != null) {
            android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, "?⊥????嗅?嚗?error", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    internal fun entryId(intent: Intent) = intent.getLongExtra(EXTRA_ID, -1L)
    internal fun apps(intent: Intent): String? = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_APPS)
}

/** The reminder's alarm and its notification button. */
class ReminderAlarmReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {
    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        val app = context.applicationContext
        when (intent.action) {
            RewardReminders.ACTION_ALARM -> RewardReminders.onAlarm(app, RewardReminders.entryId(intent))
            RewardReminders.ACTION_COLLECT -> RewardReminders.collectNow(app, RewardReminders.apps(intent))
        }
    }
}

/** What a scan found in one app. [available] is -1 when the scan could not count. */
data class ScanResult(
    val appKey: String,
    val appName: String,
    val available: Int,
    val endReason: String,
    /** One button that pays per ad, again and again: the count is not how many are left. */
    val repeatable: Boolean = false,
    /** What the user must do themselves (a blocker screen such as AHEALTH's sleep mode). */
    val note: String? = null
) {
    fun text(): String = when {
        endReason == "blocked_screen" && note != null -> note
        repeatable && available > 0 -> "$appName嚗?撱????舀嚗????甈⊥銝?嚗?
        endReason != "done" && available <= 0 -> "$appName嚗??嚗?endReason嚗?
        endReason != "done" -> "$appName嚗撠?$available ???芣?摰?"
        available > 0 -> "$appName嚗???$available ??
        else -> "$appName嚗歇?嗅?"
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import com.rewardadguard.app.BuildConfig
import java.io.BufferedWriter
import java.io.Closeable
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.FileWriter
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * One collection run's on-phone record, in the layout the master prompt
 * requires: `collector_runs/run_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS/{events.jsonl,summary.json,
 * console.log,shots/}`.
 *
 * It is written by the collector itself, not by adb, because the whole point of
 * this phase is a run that survives without a PC. The files are pulled with
 * `run-as` afterwards and uploaded to the private test-log repository.
 */
class RunRecorder(
    context: Context,
    private val profile: AppProfile,
    private val dryRun: Boolean,
    private val version: String = BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME
) : Closeable {

    private val timestamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date())
    private val startedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val runDir: File = File(context.filesDir, "collector_runs/run_$timestamp")
    private val shotsDir = File(runDir, "shots")
    private val eventsFile = File(runDir, "events.jsonl")
    private val consoleFile = File(runDir, "console.log")

    private val eventWriter: BufferedWriter
    private val consoleWriter: BufferedWriter
    private var shotCount = 0
    private var closed = false

    init {
        runDir.mkdirs()
        shotsDir.mkdirs()
        eventWriter = BufferedWriter(FileWriter(eventsFile, true))
        consoleWriter = BufferedWriter(FileWriter(consoleFile, true))
        console("[collector] ${profile.name} start dryRun=$dryRun dir=${runDir.absolutePath}")
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun console(line: String) {
        if (closed) return
        runCatching {
            consoleWriter.write("${clock()} $line")
            consoleWriter.newLine()
            consoleWriter.flush()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun event(action: String, message: String? = null, fields: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()) {
        if (closed) return
        val record = LinkedHashMap<String, Any?>()
        record["t"] = System.currentTimeMillis()
        record["action"] = action
        record["app"] = profile.key
        if (!message.isNullOrBlank()) record["message"] = message
        record.putAll(fields)
        runCatching {
            eventWriter.write(toJson(record))
            eventWriter.newLine()
            eventWriter.flush()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Saves a screenshot. The engine decides the policy (first/last success,
     * every failure); this method only writes.
     */
    @Synchronized
    fun shot(bitmap: Bitmap?, label: String): Boolean {
        if (closed || bitmap == null || bitmap.isRecycled) return false
        val safe = label.replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]"), "_").take(60)
        val file = File(shotsDir, "%04d_%s.png".format(shotCount++, safe))
        val ok = runCatching {
            FileOutputStream(file).use { out ->
                bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, out)
            }
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (ok) event("shot", message = file.name)
        return ok
    }

    /** Writes `summary.json` and closes the writers. Safe to call once. */
    @Synchronized
    fun finish(endReason: String, stats: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()) {
        if (closed) return
        val endedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val summary = LinkedHashMap<String, Any?>()
        summary["app"] = profile.key
        summary["name"] = profile.name
        summary["package"] = profile.packageName
        summary["dryRun"] = dryRun
        summary["startedAt"] = startedAt
        summary["endedAt"] = endedAt
        summary["durationMillis"] = endedAt - startedAt
        summary["endReason"] = endReason
        summary["shots"] = shotCount
        summary["version"] = version
        summary["commit"] = BuildConfig.GIT_HASH
        summary.putAll(stats)
        runCatching {
            File(runDir, "summary.json").writeText(toJson(summary, pretty = true), Charsets.UTF_8)
        }
        console("[collector] end reason=$endReason stats=${stats.entries.joinToString { "${it.key}=${it.value}" }}")
        close()
    }

    override fun close() {
        if (closed) return
        closed = true
        runCatching { eventWriter.flush() }
        runCatching { consoleWriter.flush() }
        runCatching { eventWriter.close() }
        runCatching { consoleWriter.close() }
    }

    private fun clock(): String =
        SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.US).format(Date())

    private fun toJson(map: Map<String, Any?>, pretty: Boolean = false): String {
        val indent = if (pretty) "  " else ""
        val separator = if (pretty) ",\n" else ","
        val body = map.entries.joinToString(separator) { (key, value) ->
            "$indent${quote(key)}:${if (pretty) " " else ""}${valueJson(value, pretty)}"
        }
        return if (pretty) "{\n$body\n}\n" else "{$body}"
    }

    private fun valueJson(value: Any?, pretty: Boolean): String = when (value) {
        null -> "null"
        // JSON has no NaN/Infinity; writing them made the whole line unparsable.
        is Double -> if (value.isFinite()) value.toString() else "null"
        is Float -> if (value.isFinite()) value.toString() else "null"
        is Boolean, is Int, is Long -> value.toString()
        is Map<*, *> -> toJson(value.entries.associate { it.key.toString() to it.value }, pretty)
        is Iterable<*> -> value.joinToString(",", "[", "]") { valueJson(it, pretty) }
        else -> quote(value.toString())
    }

    private fun quote(value: String): String {
        val builder = StringBuilder(value.length + 2)
        builder.append('"')
        for (ch in value) {
            when (ch) {
                '"' -> builder.append("\\\"")
                '\\' -> builder.append("\\\\")
                '\n' -> builder.append("\\n")
                '\r' -> builder.append("\\r")
                '\t' -> builder.append("\\t")
                else -> if (ch < ' ') builder.append("\\u%04x".format(ch.code)) else builder.append(ch)
            }
        }
        builder.append('"')
        return builder.toString()
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import android.app.KeyguardManager
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.PowerManager
import android.util.Log
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import com.rewardadguard.app.service.RewardAdAccessibilityService
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/**
 * Starts a due schedule (2026-11-15) once the phone allows it, following
 * [ScheduleMath.decide]: wait while locked, wait until nobody used the phone
 * for three minutes, skip after the grace period.
 *
 * While it waits on an unlocked phone it keeps the screen lit (a 1x1
 * keep-screen-on overlay), otherwise the screen would time out long before
 * the three idle minutes and the run could never start. While waiting it
 * also asks the service for click/scroll events ([onWaitingChanged]), the
 * only signal of "someone is using the phone" an accessibility service gets.
 */
class ScheduledRunner(
    private val service: RewardAdAccessibilityService,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    /** Last real tap, scroll or app switch by the user (0 when none). */
    private val userActivityAt: () -> Long,
    /** Turns the extra click/scroll events on while a run waits. */
    private val onWaitingChanged: (Boolean) -> Unit
) {
    private val main = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var job: Job? = null
    private var wakeView: View? = null
    private var unlockedAt = 0L
    private var wasUsable = false
    private var waiting = false
    /** The pending scan had to wait for a collection run. */
    private var scanWaitedForRun = false

    /** Checks the pending run now (alarm fired, service connected). */
    fun kick() {
        if (job?.isActive == true) return
        CollectorScheduler.load(service)
        if (CollectorScheduler.pending.value == null) return
        scanWaitedForRun = false
        job = scope.launch {
            try {
                loop()
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                Log.w(TAG, "scheduled run loop failed", t)
            } finally {
                setWaiting(false)
                keepScreenOn(false)
            }
        }
    }

    fun stop() {
        job?.cancel()
        job = null
    }

    private suspend fun loop() {
        while (scope.isActive) {
            val pending = CollectorScheduler.pending.value ?: return
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
            val locked = service.getSystemService(KeyguardManager::class.java)?.isKeyguardLocked ?: true
            val screenOn = service.getSystemService(PowerManager::class.java)?.isInteractive ?: false
            val usable = !locked && screenOn
            if (usable && !wasUsable) unlockedAt = now
            wasUsable = usable
            val idleSince = maxOf(userActivityAt(), unlockedAt)
            val decision = ScheduleMath.decide(
                pending = pending,
                now = now,
                locked = locked,
                screenOn = screenOn,
                collectorRunning = CollectorController.state.value.running,
                idleSince = idleSince
            )
            if (pending.scan && decision == ScheduleMath.Decision.WAIT_BUSY) scanWaitedForRun = true
            if (pending.scan && scanWaitedForRun && decision != ScheduleMath.Decision.WAIT_BUSY) {
                // A scan that queued behind a collection: right after a run
                // it only re-reads what was just collected, and it looked like
                // the run moving on to other apps (2026-11-16 08:34).
                scanWaitedForRun = false
                CollectorScheduler.clearPending(service, null)
                return
            }
            setWaiting(decision == ScheduleMath.Decision.WAIT_IDLE)
            keepScreenOn(decision == ScheduleMath.Decision.WAIT_IDLE)
            when (decision) {
                ScheduleMath.Decision.EXPIRED -> {
                    CollectorScheduler.clearPending(
                        service,
                        if (pending.scan) "????撌脩????銝?湔??圾?蒂?蔭" else "??撌脩??3 撠??扳?璈瘝?閫??銝阡?蝵?
                    )
                    return
                }
                ScheduleMath.Decision.WAIT_BUSY -> CollectorScheduler.setStatus(service, "?虫?頛芣?脰?銝哨?蝯?敺?憪?)
                ScheduleMath.Decision.WAIT_UNLOCK -> CollectorScheduler.setStatus(service, "蝑?閫????")
                ScheduleMath.Decision.WAIT_IDLE -> {
                    val left = ScheduleMath.idleRemaining(pending, now, idleSince)
                    val text = "???蔭 ${formatLeft(left)} 敺?憪?蝣唳?璈??閮?嚗?
                    CollectorScheduler.setStatus(service, text)
                }
                ScheduleMath.Decision.START -> {
                    start(pending)
                    return
                }
            }
            delay(POLL_MILLIS)
        }
    }

    private fun start(pending: PendingRun) {
        val profiles = pending.appKeys.mapNotNull { CollectorProfiles.byKey(it) }.distinct()
        keepScreenOn(false)
        setWaiting(false)
        val error = CollectorController.start(service, profiles, CollectorLimits.UNLIMITED, dryRun = false, scan = pending.scan)
        if (error == null) {
            CollectorScheduler.clearPending(service, null)
        } else {
            CollectorScheduler.clearPending(service, "???⊥???嚗?error")
        }
    }

    private fun setWaiting(value: Boolean) {
        if (waiting == value) return
        waiting = value
        main.post { onWaitingChanged(value) }
    }

    private fun keepScreenOn(on: Boolean) {
        main.post {
            val manager = service.getSystemService(WindowManager::class.java) ?: return@post
            if (on && wakeView == null) {
                val view = View(service)
                val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
                    1, 1,
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY,
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
                        WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE or
                        WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON,
                    PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
                ).apply { gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START }
                if (runCatching { manager.addView(view, params) }.isSuccess) wakeView = view
            } else if (!on) {
                wakeView?.let { runCatching { manager.removeView(it) } }
                wakeView = null
            }
        }
    }

    private fun formatLeft(millis: Long): String {
        val s = (millis + 999) / 1000
        return "%d:%02d".format(s / 60, s % 60)
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "ScheduledRunner"
        private const val POLL_MILLIS = 5_000L
    }
}
