package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import java.io.File
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class OcrCorrectionsTest {

    private val asset: String by lazy {
        listOf(File("src/main/assets/ocr_corrections.tsv"), File("app/src/main/assets/ocr_corrections.tsv"))
            .first { it.isFile }.readText()
    }

    @Test
    fun shippedTableFixesTheGiftCardMisreads() {
        val pairs = OcrCorrections.parse(asset)
        assertEquals("蝡??蝳桃??, OcrCorrections.apply("蝡?????, pairs))
        assertEquals("蝡??蝳桃??, OcrCorrections.apply("蝡??瞉抒??, pairs))
        // A correct ??elsewhere is left alone.

    }

        val pairs = OcrCorrections.parse("# c\n\nab\tcd\nonly\nx\tx\nabc\tzzz")
        assertEquals(listOf("abc" to "zzz", "ab" to "cd"), pairs)
    }

FILE: app\src\test\java\com\rewardadguard\app\collector\OcrFixtureLoadTest.kt
==============================================================================
package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

/**
 * Every recorded pc-collector screen must load into a [Snapshot].
 *
 * These 33 `*.ocr.json` files are the whole regression corpus for the per-app
 * rules (integration plan 禮3). Proving they load with the right text and pixel
 * coordinates is what lets phase 2 test BitWalk decisions on the JVM instead of
 * spending a rewarded ad per attempt.
 */
class OcrFixtureLoadTest {

    private fun fixtureDirectory(): File {
        val url = requireNotNull(javaClass.classLoader?.getResource("collector-fixtures")) {
            "collector-fixtures is missing from test resources"
        }
        return File(url.toURI())
    }

    private fun fixtures(): List<File> {
        val files = fixtureDirectory().listFiles { file -> file.name.endsWith(".ocr.json") }
            ?.sortedBy { it.name }
            .orEmpty()
        assertTrue("expected the recorded OCR corpus, found ${files.size} files", files.size >= 30)
        return files
    }

    @Test
    fun everyFixtureLoadsWithTextAndCoordinates() {
        val files = fixtures()
        for (file in files) {
            val snapshot = OcrJson.parse(file.readText(), capturedAt = 123L)
            assertTrue("${file.name}: width", snapshot.width > 0)
            assertTrue("${file.name}: height", snapshot.height > 0)
            assertEquals(123L, snapshot.capturedAt)
            // `line_ad_topleft_x` is an ad made only of artwork - it exists to
            // prove corner matching, so an empty OCR result is correct there.
            if (file.name != "line_ad_topleft_x.ocr.json") {
                assertTrue("${file.name}: no text boxes", snapshot.boxes.isNotEmpty())
            }
            assertTrue("${file.name}: wrong source", snapshot.boxes.all { it.source == TextSource.OCR })
            for (box in snapshot.boxes) {
                assertTrue(
                    "${file.name}: negative origin ${box.bounds}",
                    box.bounds.left >= 0 && box.bounds.top >= 0
                )
                assertTrue(
                    "${file.name}: outside ${snapshot.width}x${snapshot.height}: ${box.bounds}",
                    box.bounds.right <= snapshot.width && box.bounds.bottom <= snapshot.height
                )
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun bitwalkHomeFixtureCarriesTheRewardText() {
        val file = File(fixtureDirectory(), "app_bitwalk_get_stamp.ocr.json")
        assertTrue("fixture missing", file.isFile)
        val snapshot = OcrJson.parse(file.readText())

        assertEquals(1220, snapshot.width)
        assertEquals(2712, snapshot.height)
        assertTrue(snapshot.contains("?臬???49 ?蝡?))
        assertTrue(snapshot.contains("?嗥?撱??敶梁?"))
        assertTrue(snapshot.contains("甇亥?"))

        val reward = snapshot.findLine("??????49 ????蝡?)
        assertNotNull(reward)
        assertEquals(Box(418, 1436, 802, 1481), reward!!.bounds)

        // The clock line proves line-level coordinates survive the JSON round trip.
        val clock = snapshot.findLine("13 : 16")
        assertNotNull(clock)
        assertEquals(Box(83, 38, 375, 71), clock!!.bounds)
    }

    @Test
    fun matchesUseScoreThenArea() {
        val file = File(fixtureDirectory(), "app_bitwalk_get_stamp.ocr.json")
        val snapshot = OcrJson.parse(file.readText())
        val matches = snapshot.matches(listOf("?啁?"))
        assertTrue(matches.size >= 2)
        // A label that *starts* with the term (70) outranks one that merely
        // contains it (50), exactly like pc-collector's best_terms_match.
        assertTrue(matches.first().text.startsWith("??蝡???蝵?))
        assertTrue(matches.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) -> a.score >= b.score })
        assertEquals(matches.size, matches.distinctBy { it.bounds to it.text }.size)
    }
}

FILE: app\src\test\java\com\rewardadguard\app\collector\OcrFuzzyAvoidTest.kt
==============================================================================
package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class OcrFuzzyAvoidTest {

    private fun n(s: String) = TextMatch.normalizeLoose(s)
    private val rewards = listOf("?嗥?撱??敶梁?", "??", "蝪賢").map(::n)

    @Test
    fun oneMisreadCharacterIsStillAvoided() {
        assertTrue(TextMatch.fuzzyAvoidHit(n("蝡??瞉抒??), n("蝳桃??), rewards))
        assertTrue(TextMatch.fuzzyAvoidHit(n("蝡?????), n("蝳桃??), rewards))
    }

    @Test
    fun aRewardOverlappingTheWindowIsNotVetoed() {
        // 撌脤???vs ?舫???differ by one character, but ?舫???is the reward.
        assertFalse(TextMatch.fuzzyAvoidHit(n("?舫???), n("撌脤???), rewards))
        assertFalse(TextMatch.fuzzyAvoidHit(n("?嗥?撱??敶梁?嚗敺???BTC"), n("2????), rewards))
    }

    @Test
    fun shortTermsAndTwoMisreadsAreNotFuzzy() {
        assertFalse(TextMatch.fuzzyAvoidHit(n("??"), n("??"), rewards))
        assertFalse(TextMatch.fuzzyAvoidHit(n("蝡???儒??), n("蝳桃??), rewards))
        // A digit is not a misread Han character (AHEALTH ?? 10 暺 vs ????.
        assertFalse(TextMatch.fuzzyAvoidHit(n("??10暺"), n("????), listOf(n("??"))))
    }

    private fun snap(text: String, source: TextSource) = Snapshot(
        width = 1220, height = 2712, capturedAt = 0L,
        foregroundPackage = "jp.paddleinc.walk", foregroundActivity = null,
        boxes = listOf(TextBox(text, Box(400, 2200, 820, 2290), source))
    )

    @Test
    fun onlyOcrTextIsMatchedFuzzily() {
        val p = CollectorProfiles.BITWALK
        assertEquals(0, snap("蝡??瞉抒??, TextSource.OCR).matches(p.rewardTerms, listOf("蝳桃??), p.exactTerms).size)
        assertEquals(1, snap("蝡??瞉抒??, TextSource.NODE).matches(p.rewardTerms, listOf("蝳桃??), p.exactTerms).size)
    }
}

FILE: app\src\test\java\com\rewardadguard\app\collector\RecordRetentionAndTelegramTest.kt

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

/** 2026-11-13: records kept five days; each finished run goes to Telegram once. */
class RecordRetentionAndTelegramTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private val day = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L

    @Test
    fun recordsAreKeptFiveDaysThenExpire() {
        val now = 100 * day
        assertFalse(RunRetention.isExpired(now - 4 * day, now))
        assertFalse(RunRetention.isExpired(now - 5 * day, now))
        assertTrue(RunRetention.isExpired(now - 5 * day - 1, now))
        assertFalse("unknown time is never deleted", RunRetention.isExpired(0L, now))
    }

    private fun run(root: File, name: String, finished: Boolean, sent: Boolean = false): File {
        val dir = File(root, name).apply { mkdirs() }
        File(dir, "console.log").writeText("x")
        if (finished) File(dir, "summary.json").writeText("{}")
        if (sent) File(dir, TelegramReporter.SENT_MARK).writeText("1")
        return dir
    }

    @Test
    fun onlyFinishedUnsentRunsArePendingOldestFirst() {
        val root = tmp.newFolder("collector_runs")
        run(root, "run_20261113_001000", finished = true)
        run(root, "run_20261113_000900", finished = true, sent = true)
        run(root, "run_20261113_001100", finished = false) // still running
        run(root, "run_20261113_000800", finished = true)
        File(root, "notes.txt").writeText("not a run")
        assertEquals(
            listOf("run_20261113_000800", "run_20261113_001000"),
            TelegramReporter.pendingRuns(root).map { it.name }
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun runsFromBeforeTheRetryWindowAreNeverSent() {
        val root = tmp.newFolder("old")
        val old = run(root, "run_20261112_132037", finished = true)
        File(old, "summary.json").setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis() - 7 * 60 * 60 * 1000L)
        run(root, "run_20261113_014915", finished = true)
        assertEquals(listOf("run_20261113_014915"), TelegramReporter.pendingRuns(root).map { it.name })
    }

    @Test
    fun aBacklogIsCappedToTheNewestRuns() {
        val root = tmp.newFolder("runs")
        for (i in 10..19) run(root, "run_20261113_00${i}00", finished = true)
        val pending = TelegramReporter.pendingRuns(root, limit = 3).map { it.name }
        assertEquals(listOf("run_20261113_001700", "run_20261113_001800", "run_20261113_001900"), pending)
    }

    @Test
    fun manyScreenshotsKeepTheFirstAndLastOnes() {
        val dir = tmp.newFolder("shots")
        val shots = (0 until 40).map { File(dir, "%04d_x.png".format(it)).apply { writeText("p") } }
        val picked = TelegramReporter.pickShots(shots, max = 6).map { it.name }
        assertEquals(listOf("0000_x.png", "0001_x.png", "0002_x.png", "0037_x.png", "0038_x.png", "0039_x.png"), picked)
        assertEquals(3, TelegramReporter.pickShots(shots.take(3), max = 6).size)
    }

    @Test
    fun theCaptionSummarisesTheRun() {
        val dir = run(tmp.newFolder("r"), "run_20261113_002140", finished = true)
        File(dir, "summary.json").writeText(
            """
            {
              "app": "linewalk",
              "name": "LINE ??郊頞?,
              "endReason": "done",
              "rewards": 2,
              "errors": 0,
              "manual": 1,
              "commit": "1b2dab6"
            }
            """.trimIndent()
        )
        val caption = TelegramReporter.caption(dir)
        assertTrue(caption, caption.contains("LINE ??郊頞?))
        assertTrue(caption, caption.contains("? 2"))
        assertTrue(caption, caption.contains("??? 1"))
        assertTrue(caption, caption.contains("run_20261113_002140"))
        assertTrue(caption, caption.contains("1b2dab6"))
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

/**
 * Review 2026-11-12:
 *  P0 - never act on a screen that is not positively the target app;
 *  P1 - an ended ad is not a reward without proof.
 */
class SafetyAndRewardProofTest {

    private val line = "com.linecorp.LGWKTW"

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- P0

    @Test
    fun aTapNeedsTheTargetAppInFront() {
        assertEquals(ActionGate.Decision.ALLOW, ActionGate.decide(ActionGate.Action.TAP, line, line))
        assertEquals(
            ActionGate.Decision.DENY,
            ActionGate.decide(ActionGate.Action.TAP, "com.gimmatek.hahago.aha", line)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun anUnknownForegroundIsNeverTappedOrBackedOutOf() {
        for (fg in listOf(null, "", "  ")) {
            assertEquals(ActionGate.Decision.UNKNOWN, ActionGate.decide(ActionGate.Action.TAP, fg, line))
            assertEquals(ActionGate.Decision.UNKNOWN, ActionGate.decide(ActionGate.Action.BACK, fg, line))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun backMayLeaveAKnownForeignAppAndHomeOrLaunchAreAlwaysSafe() {
        assertEquals(
            ActionGate.Decision.ALLOW,
            ActionGate.decide(ActionGate.Action.BACK, "com.android.vending", line)
        )
        assertEquals(ActionGate.Decision.ALLOW, ActionGate.decide(ActionGate.Action.HOME, null, line))
        assertEquals(ActionGate.Decision.ALLOW, ActionGate.decide(ActionGate.Action.LAUNCH, null, line))
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- P1

    private fun fixture(name: String): Snapshot {
        val url = requireNotNull(javaClass.classLoader?.getResource("collector-fixtures/$name"))
        return OcrJson.parse(File(url.toURI()).readText())
    }

    private fun bitwalk(vararg lines: String): Snapshot = Snapshot(
        width = 1080,
        height = 2400,
        capturedAt = 0L,
        foregroundPackage = "jp.paddleinc.walk",
        foregroundActivity = null,
        boxes = lines.mapIndexed { i, text ->
            TextBox(text, Box(100, 200 + i * 100, 900, 260 + i * 100), TextSource.OCR)
        }
    )

    @Test
    fun bitwalksRewardDialogIsProof() {
        val dialog = fixture("app_bitwalk_reward_dialog.ocr.json")
        assertTrue(RewardConfirmation.hasRewardDialog(dialog, CollectorProfiles.BITWALK))
    }

    @Test
    fun theMbtcBalanceIsReadWithOcrsDot() {
        val p = CollectorProfiles.BITWALK
        assertEquals(0.000269, RewardConfirmation.balance(bitwalk("0 繚 000269 mBTC"), p)!!, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(0.000312, RewardConfirmation.balance(bitwalk("0.000312 mBTC"), p)!!, 1e-12)
        assertNull("steps are not a balance", RewardConfirmation.balance(bitwalk("204 , 528"), p))
    }

    @Test
    fun aRisingBalanceIsProofAndAnUnchangedOneIsNot() {
        val p = CollectorProfiles.BITWALK
        val before = bitwalk("0 繚 000269 mBTC", "甇亥?", "鞈箏?")
        assertTrue(RewardConfirmation.confirmed(before, bitwalk("0 繚 000281 mBTC", "甇亥?", "鞈箏?"), p))
        assertFalse(RewardConfirmation.confirmed(before, bitwalk("0 繚 000269 mBTC", "甇亥?", "鞈箏?"), p))
        assertFalse("no balance on screen, no proof", RewardConfirmation.confirmed(before, bitwalk("甇亥?", "鞈箏?"), p))
    }

    @Test
    fun appsWithoutABalanceNeedTheirDialog() {
        val p = CollectorProfiles.HAHAGO
        val plain = bitwalk("擐?", "365")
        assertNull(RewardConfirmation.balance(plain, p))
        assertFalse(RewardConfirmation.confirmed(plain, plain, p))
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import java.time.ZoneId
import java.time.ZonedDateTime
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class ScanTest {

    private val zone = ZoneId.of("Asia/Taipei")
    private fun at(day: Int, h: Int, m: Int = 0) = ZonedDateTime.of(2026, 11, day, h, m, 0, 0, zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()

    @Test
    fun intervalBecomesWholeHours() {
        val c = ScanConfig(ScanConfig.MODE_INTERVAL, 6, listOf("bitwalk"))
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 6, 12, 18), c.entries().map { it.hour })
        assertEquals(6 * 3_600_000L, ScanConfig(ScanConfig.MODE_INTERVAL, 1).graceMillis() * 6)
        assertEquals(ScheduleMath.GRACE_MILLIS, c.graceMillis())
        assertEquals(emptyList<ScheduleEntry>(), ScanConfig().entries())
    }

    @Test
    fun fixedTimesAndNextDue() {
        val c = ScanConfig(ScanConfig.MODE_FIXED, 3, listOf("hahago"), listOf(9 to 30, 21 to 0))
        val next = ScheduleMath.nextDue(c.entries(), at(15, 12), zone)!!
        assertEquals(at(15, 21), next.second)
        assertEquals(listOf("hahago"), next.first.appKeys)
    }

    @Test
    fun configRoundTrip() {
        val c = ScanConfig(ScanConfig.MODE_FIXED, 4, listOf("bitwalk", "custom_9"), listOf(21 to 0, 9 to 5))
        assertEquals(c.copy(times = listOf(9 to 5, 21 to 0)), ScanConfig.decode(ScanConfig.encode(c)))
        assertEquals(ScanConfig(), ScanConfig.decode("junk"))
    }

    @Test
    fun pendingScanRoundTripAndOldFormat() {
        val p = PendingRun(-1003, at(15, 3), listOf("bitwalk"), scan = true, graceMillis = 3_600_000L)
        assertEquals(p, ScheduleMath.decodePending(ScheduleMath.encodePending(p)))
        assertEquals(PendingRun(1, 5, listOf("a")), ScheduleMath.decodePending("1|5|a"))
    }

    @Test
    fun scanExpiresAtItsOwnGrace() {
        val p = PendingRun(-1003, at(15, 3), listOf("bitwalk"), scan = true, graceMillis = 3_600_000L)
        assertEquals(ScheduleMath.Decision.EXPIRED, ScheduleMath.decide(p, at(15, 4, 1), true, false, false, 0))
        assertEquals(ScheduleMath.Decision.WAIT_UNLOCK, ScheduleMath.decide(p, at(15, 3, 59), true, false, false, 0))
    }

    private fun t(text: String, x: Int = 100) = Target(text, Box(x, 500, x + 100, 560), 100, "ocr")

    @Test
    fun scanCount_neverDoubleCountsOverlappingPages() {
        val pages = listOf(
            listOf(t("??"), t("??", 400), t("?誨??)),
            listOf(t("??", 50), t("??", 300), t("??", 600)),
            emptyList()
        )
        assertEquals(4, CollectorRules.scanCount(pages))
    }

    @Test
    fun summary_scanAfterCollectionSetsWhatIsLeft() {
        val rows = listOf(
            RunSummaryRow("bitwalk", "BITWALK", at(15, 8), 10, 0, "done", false),
            RunSummaryRow("bitwalk", "BITWALK", at(15, 12), 0, 0, "done", false, scan = true, available = 4)
        )
        val s = DailyRewardSummary.summarize(rows, zone).single()
        assertEquals("[2026/11/15] BITWALK 撌脫蝛?10 ???蛛?撠? 4 ???萄??嗅?嚗?2:00 ??嚗?, s.text())
    }

    @Test
    fun scanResultText() {
        assertEquals("BITWALK嚗???3 ??, ScanResult("bitwalk", "BITWALK", 3, "done").text())
        assertEquals("HAHAGO嚗歇?嗅?", ScanResult("hahago", "HAHAGO", 0, "done").text())
        assertEquals("LINE嚗??嚗topped嚗?, ScanResult("linewalk", "LINE", 0, "stopped").text())
    }

    @Test
    fun lotteryBadgesAreTickets() {
        val sheet = LineWalkRules.LotterySheet(
            big = t("50撘?), free = t("?祥??甈?), normal = t("5撘?),
            cooldowns = emptyMap(), counts = mapOf("big" to 24, "normal" to 240)
        )
        assertEquals(49, CollectorRules.lotteryAvailable(sheet))
        assertEquals(48, CollectorRules.lotteryAvailable(sheet.copy(cooldowns = mapOf("free" to "01:00:00"))))
    }

    @Test
    fun repeatableAndBlockedTexts() {
        assertEquals("BITWALK嚗?撱????舀嚗????甈⊥銝?嚗?, ScanResult("bitwalk", "BITWALK", 1, "done", repeatable = true).text())
        val note = "AHEALTH ?∠?璅∪?銝哨?隢?????????
        assertEquals(note, ScanResult("ahealth", "AHEALTH", -1, "blocked_screen", note = note).text())
        assertEquals("BITWALK嚗歇?嗅?", ScanResult("bitwalk", "BITWALK", 0, "done", repeatable = true).text())
    }

    @Test
    fun ahealthSleepScreenIsABlocker() {
        assertEquals(true, CollectorProfiles.AHEALTH.blockerScreens.keys.any { "?∠?璅∪?" in it })
        assertEquals(true, CollectorProfiles.BITWALK.repeatableRewards)
    }

    @Test
    fun summary_repeatableScan() {
        val rows = listOf(RunSummaryRow("bitwalk", "BITWALK", at(15, 9), 0, 0, "done", false, scan = true, available = 1, repeatable = true))
        assertEquals("[2026/11/15] BITWALK 撌脫蝛?0 ???蛛???撱????舀嚗?9:00 ??嚗活?訾???",
            DailyRewardSummary.summarize(rows, zone).single().text())
    }

    @Test
    fun bitwalkAvoidsOcrVariantsOfTheGiftCardBanner() {
        val avoid = CollectorProfiles.BITWALK.avoidTerms
        listOf("蝡?????, "蝡??瞉抒??, "蝡??蝳桃??).forEach { text ->

    }

    }

FILE: app\src\test\java\com\rewardadguard\app\collector\SkipBarGlyphTest.kt
==============================================================================
package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.File
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream
import java.util.zip.Inflater

/**
 * 2026-11-13 14:54: an InMobi ad in BITWALK ended in landscape with only a
 * bare "?閏" at the top right. Neither the X nor the circled ">>" template
 * matched it, so the run called the ad stuck again and again.
 *
 * Fixtures are the top-right corner of real screenshots stored as gzipped
 * gray bytes (the JVM test runtime has no image decoder): screen width and
 * height, the crop's origin and size, then the pixels.
 */
class SkipBarGlyphTest {

    private fun resource(path: String): File =
        File(requireNotNull(javaClass.classLoader?.getResource(path)) { "missing $path" }.toURI())

    /** Rebuilds the full screen: mid-gray everywhere, the real corner pasted in. */
    private fun screen(path: String): GrayImage =
        DataInputStream(GZIPInputStream(resource(path).inputStream())).use { input ->
            val width = input.readInt()
            val height = input.readInt()
            val left = input.readInt()
            val top = input.readInt()
            val cropWidth = input.readInt()
            val cropHeight = input.readInt()
            val crop = ByteArray(cropWidth * cropHeight)
            input.readFully(crop)
            val image = GrayImage.filled(width, height, 128)
            for (y in 0 until cropHeight) {
                for (x in 0 until cropWidth) {
                    image.pixels[(top + y) * width + (left + x)] = crop[y * cropWidth + x]
                }
            }
            image
        }

    /** The app's asset, decoded from its PNG (8-bit gray, as written by the build tooling). */
    private val skipTemplate: GlyphTemplate by lazy {
        val asset = listOf(
            File("src/main/assets/templates/skip_bar.png"),
            File("app/src/main/assets/templates/skip_bar.png")
        ).first { it.isFile }
        GlyphTemplate("next", decodeGrayPng(asset.readBytes()))
    }

    @Test
    fun theBareSkipIconIsFoundTopRight() {
        val hits = CornerGlyphMatcher(listOf(skipTemplate)).find(screen("glyph-fixtures/inmobi_skip_landscape.gray.gz"))
        val hit = hits.firstOrNull { it.kind == "next" }
        assertTrue("hits=$hits", hit != null)
        // The icon's centre is at about (2540, 92) on the 2712x1220 screen.
        assertTrue("$hit", kotlin.math.abs(hit!!.bounds.centerX - 2540) < 30)
        assertTrue("$hit", kotlin.math.abs(hit.bounds.centerY - 92) < 30)
    }

    private fun template(name: String): GlyphTemplate {
        val asset = listOf(
            File("src/main/assets/templates/$name"),
            File("app/src/main/assets/templates/$name")
        ).first { it.isFile }
        return GlyphTemplate(
            if (name.contains("close")) "close" else "next",
            decodeGrayPng(asset.readBytes()),
            fromScreenTop = name in setOf("chevron_circle.png", "thin_chevron.png", "thin_close.png")
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun mintegralsThinChevronIsFoundTopRight() {
        // 2026-11-16 11:28: a bare ">" at about (1132, 88), level with the
        // status bar; the ad waited for it until it timed out.
        val hits = CornerGlyphMatcher(listOf(template("thin_chevron.png")))
            .find(screen("glyph-fixtures/mintegral_thin_chevron_portrait.gray.gz"))
        val hit = hits.firstOrNull { it.kind == "next" }
        assertTrue("hits=$hits", hit != null)
        assertTrue("$hit", kotlin.math.abs(hit!!.bounds.centerX - 1132) < 30)

    /** Minimal PNG reader for 8-bit grayscale, non-interlaced images. */
    private fun decodeGrayPng(bytes: ByteArray): GrayImage {
        var pos = 8
        var width = 0
        var height = 0
        val idat = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
        fun int(at: Int) = ((bytes[at].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24) or ((bytes[at + 1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or
            ((bytes[at + 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (bytes[at + 3].toInt() and 0xFF)
        while (pos < bytes.size) {
            val length = int(pos)
            val type = String(bytes, pos + 4, 4, Charsets.US_ASCII)
            val data = pos + 8
            when (type) {
                "IHDR" -> {
                    width = int(data)
                    height = int(data + 4)
                    check(bytes[data + 8].toInt() == 8 && bytes[data + 9].toInt() == 0) { "expected 8-bit gray" }
                }
                "IDAT" -> idat.write(bytes, data, length)
                "IEND" -> break
            }
            pos = data + length + 4
        }
        val inflater = Inflater().apply { setInput(idat.toByteArray()) }
        val raw = ByteArray((width + 1) * height)
        var read = 0
        while (read < raw.size) read += inflater.inflate(raw, read, raw.size - read)
        val out = ByteArray(width * height)
        val prev = IntArray(width)
        for (y in 0 until height) {
            val filter = raw[y * (width + 1)].toInt()
            for (x in 0 until width) {
                val v = raw[y * (width + 1) + 1 + x].toInt() and 0xFF
                val a = if (x > 0) out[y * width + x - 1].toInt() and 0xFF else 0
                val b = prev[x]
                val c = if (x > 0) prev[x - 1] else 0
                val value = when (filter) {
                    0 -> v
                    1 -> v + a
                    2 -> v + b
                    3 -> v + (a + b) / 2
                    4 -> {
                        val p = a + b - c
                        val pa = kotlin.math.abs(p - a)
                        val pb = kotlin.math.abs(p - b)
                        val pc = kotlin.math.abs(p - c)
                        v + if (pa <= pb && pa <= pc) a else if (pb <= pc) b else c
                    }
                    else -> error("filter $filter")
                } and 0xFF
                out[y * width + x] = value.toByte()
            }
            for (x in 0 until width) prev[x] = out[y * width + x].toInt() and 0xFF
        }
        return GrayImage(width, height, out)
    }

    fun inmobisOutlinedCloseIsFoundTopLeft() {

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * The keyword rules are the part of pc-collector worth carrying over: they were
 * tuned against 33 recorded screens. These tests pin the two behaviours that
 * matter when the source of text changes from Windows OCR to a node tree.
 */
class TextMatchTest {

    @Test
    fun windowsOcrCjkSpacingIsIgnored() {
        assertEquals("??", TextMatch.normalize("????))
        assertEquals("?嗥?撱??敶梁?", TextMatch.normalize("????撱???敶???))
        // Punctuation survives normalisation but not the loose form.
        assertEquals("?嗉絲,?脣?5??, TextMatch.normalize("??韏?, ??敺?5 ??))
        assertEquals("?嗉絲?脣?5??, TextMatch.normalizeLoose("??韏?, ??敺?5 ??))
    }

    @Test
    fun fullWidthAndCaseAreFolded() {
        assertEquals("abc123", TextMatch.normalize("嚗∴慰嚗?嚗?嚗?))
        assertEquals("skipad", TextMatch.normalizeLoose("Skip Ad!"))
        assertEquals(100, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("嚗?憔嚗荔撲嚗?, listOf("close")))
    }

    @Test
    fun closeLabelMatchesDespiteSpacesAndPunctuation() {
        assertEquals(100, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("????, listOf("??")))
        assertEquals(100, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("???誨??, listOf("??撱??")))
    }

    @Test
    fun scoringMatchesPcCollector() {
        assertEquals(100, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("?嗥?撱??敶梁?", listOf("?嗥?撱??敶梁?")))
        assertEquals(70, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("?嗥?撱??敶梁?", listOf("?嗥?")))
        assertEquals(50, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("隞?嗥?撱??敶梁?", listOf("?嗥?")))
        assertEquals(0, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("瘥蝪賢", listOf("?嗥?")))
    }

    @Test
    fun avoidVetoesAWholeLabel() {
        assertEquals(
            0,
            TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("蝡銝?", listOf("銝?"), avoid = listOf("銝?"))
        )
        assertEquals(
            0,
            TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("蝡銝?", listOf("銝?"), avoid = listOf("蝡銝?"))
        )
        assertEquals(
            100,
            TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("銝?", listOf("銝?"), avoid = listOf("摰?"))
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun exactTermsOnlyCountAsWholeLabels() {
        // A lone "x" must not match "x5" or every label containing that letter;
        // that is how pc-collector stopped clicking ad artwork.
        assertEquals(0, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("x5", listOf("x"), exactTerms = listOf("x")))
        assertEquals(100, TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("x", listOf("x"), exactTerms = listOf("x")))
        assertEquals(
            50,
            TextMatch.bestTermsMatch("x close", listOf("close"), exactTerms = listOf("x"))
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun snapshotFindSkipsAvoidedBoxes() {
        val snapshot = Snapshot(
            width = 1220,
            height = 2712,
            capturedAt = 0L,
            foregroundPackage = "com.bitwalk",
            foregroundActivity = null,
            boxes = listOf(
                TextBox("蝡銝?", Box(0, 0, 100, 50), TextSource.NODE),
                TextBox("?嗥?撱??敶梁?", Box(0, 100, 300, 150), TextSource.NODE)
            )
        )
        val match = snapshot.find(listOf("銝?", "?嗥?撱??敶梁?"), avoid = listOf("銝?"))
        assertTrue(match != null)
        assertEquals("?嗥?撱??敶梁?", match!!.text)
        assertFalse(snapshot.matches(listOf("銝?"), avoid = listOf("銝?")).isNotEmpty())
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.collector

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * 2026-11-13: a finger on the phone paused the run, the user opened another
 * app, and five seconds later the run pulled them back to the reward app.
 */
class UserLeftAppTest {

    private val bitwalk = "jp.paddleinc.walk"
    private val now = 1_000_000L

    @Test
    fun openingAnotherAppDuringAFingerPauseMakesItAManualPause() {
        assertTrue(CollectorInterruption.userLeftApp(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_INTERACTION, "com.facebook.katana", bitwalk))
        assertTrue(CollectorInterruption.userLeftApp(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_INTERACTION, "com.miui.home", bitwalk))
    }

    @Test
    fun stayingInTheRewardAppOrPullingTheShadeIsNotLeaving() {
        assertFalse(CollectorInterruption.userLeftApp(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_INTERACTION, bitwalk, bitwalk))
        assertFalse(CollectorInterruption.userLeftApp(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_INTERACTION, "com.android.systemui", bitwalk))
        assertFalse(CollectorInterruption.userLeftApp(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_INTERACTION, null, bitwalk))
        assertFalse("a lock pause is handled by unlocking", CollectorInterruption.userLeftApp(CollectorInterruption.REASON_KEYGUARD, "com.facebook.katana", bitwalk))
    }

    @Test
    fun anAutomaticPauseOnlyResumesWithTheRewardAppInFront() {
        assertTrue(CollectorInterruption.canAutoResume(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_INTERACTION, false, now - 6_000, now, targetInFront = true))
        assertFalse(CollectorInterruption.canAutoResume(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_INTERACTION, false, now - 6_000, now, targetInFront = false))
        assertFalse(CollectorInterruption.canAutoResume(CollectorInterruption.REASON_KEYGUARD, false, 0L, now, targetInFront = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun aLeftAppPauseNeverResumesOrTimesOutByItself() {
        assertFalse(CollectorInterruption.canAutoResume(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_LEFT, false, 0L, now, targetInFront = true))
        assertFalse(CollectorRunPolicy.pauseTimesOut(CollectorInterruption.REASON_USER_LEFT))
    }
}

FILE: app\src\test\java\com\rewardadguard\app\controller\ReturnControllerAsyncTest.kt

package com.rewardadguard.app.controller

import android.app.Application
import android.os.Looper
import com.rewardadguard.app.data.AppSettings
import com.rewardadguard.app.manager.EventLogger
import com.rewardadguard.app.session.SessionManager
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
import org.robolectric.Shadows
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
import java.time.Duration

/**
 * ISS-01 regression: the scheduled return must not hold the main looper.
 *
 * The old [ReturnController.scheduleReturn] ran the whole attempt synchronously
 * and `Thread.sleep`d on the main looper between the BACK press and the
 * verification probe. These tests drive the main looper by hand and assert that
 * the probe is a *separate, deferred* step: it runs only after the settle
 * interval, never inline while the looper is held.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [34])
class ReturnControllerAsyncTest {

    private val source = "com.example.reward"
    private val destination = "com.external.ad"

    private fun newController(
        onBack: () -> Unit = {},
        launch: (String) -> Boolean = { false }
    ): ReturnController {
        val app = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication() as Application
        val logger = EventLogger(app, { AppSettings() })
        val sessionManager = SessionManager(logger)
        return ReturnController(
            logger = logger,
            sessionManager = sessionManager,
            backAction = { onBack(); true },
            launchSourceAction = launch
        )
    }

    private fun idle(millis: Long) =
        Shadows.shadowOf(Looper.getMainLooper()).idleFor(Duration.ofMillis(millis))

    @Test
    fun `the BACK press is deferred and the probe runs only after the settle interval`() {
        var backs = 0
        var foreground: String? = destination
        val controller = newController(onBack = { backs++ })
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { foreground }

        var result: ReturnController.ReturnResult? = null
        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, AppSettings(), delayMillis = 0L) { result = it }

        // Nothing has run on the caller's thread.
        assertEquals(0, backs)

        // Only the BACK press runs; the probe is still pending.
        idle(100)
        assertEquals(1, backs)
        assertNull("the verification must be deferred, not run inline", result)

        // The reward app came back before the probe fires.
        foreground = source
        idle(500)

        assertEquals("exactly one BACK", 1, backs)
        assertNotNull(result)
        assertTrue(result!!.success)
        assertEquals("GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK", result!!.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a second BACK is sent only when the source is still not in front`() {
        var backs = 0
        val controller = newController(onBack = { backs++ })
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { destination } // never returns

        var result: ReturnController.ReturnResult? = null
        val settings = AppSettings(maxReturnAttempts = 2, autoLaunchRewardApp = false)
        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, settings, delayMillis = 0L) { result = it }

        idle(5_000)

        assertEquals("two attempts then stop", 2, backs)
        assertNotNull(result)
        assertFalse(result!!.success)
        assertEquals(2, result!!.attempts)
    }

    @Test
    fun `the source being back before the first probe needs no BACK at all`() {
        var backs = 0
        val controller = newController(onBack = { backs++ })
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { source } // already back

        var result: ReturnController.ReturnResult? = null
        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, AppSettings(), delayMillis = 0L) { result = it }

        idle(5_000)

        // Field report 2026-10-30: a Back press on an already-returned reward
        // app closes it, so the very first press is skipped too.
        assertEquals("no BACK when the source is already in front", 0, backs)
        assertNotNull(result)
        assertTrue(result!!.success)
        assertEquals("ALREADY_IN_SOURCE", result!!.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `the source returning before the scheduled delay suppresses the BACK`() {
        var backs = 0
        var foreground: String? = destination
        val controller = newController(onBack = { backs++ })
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { foreground }

        var result: ReturnController.ReturnResult? = null
        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, AppSettings(), delayMillis = 120L) { result = it }

        // The ad closes on its own inside the 120 ms scheduling delay.
        foreground = source
        idle(5_000)

        assertEquals("a queued BACK must not fire once the source is back", 0, backs)
        assertNotNull(result)
        assertTrue(result!!.success)
        assertEquals("ALREADY_IN_SOURCE", result!!.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `already in front neither presses BACK nor relaunches the app`() {
        var backs = 0
        var launches = 0
        val controller = newController(
            onBack = { backs++ },
            launch = { launches++; true }
        )
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { source }

        var result: ReturnController.ReturnResult? = null
        val settings = AppSettings(maxReturnAttempts = 2, autoLaunchRewardApp = true)
        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, settings, delayMillis = 0L) { result = it }

        idle(5_000)

        assertEquals(0, backs)
        assertEquals("an app already in front must not be relaunched", 0, launches)
        assertNotNull(result)
        assertTrue(result!!.success)
        assertEquals("ALREADY_IN_SOURCE", result!!.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a slow return is confirmed by polling without a second BACK`() {
        var backs = 0
        var foreground: String? = destination
        val controller = newController(onBack = { backs++ })
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { foreground }

        var result: ReturnController.ReturnResult? = null
        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, AppSettings(), delayMillis = 0L) { result = it }

        // Four probes over ~1.8 s: a cold-starting destination is not in front
        // yet, but Back must not be pressed again on the wrong screen.
        idle(1_800)
        assertEquals("no second BACK while the destination is still starting", 1, backs)
        assertNull(result)

        foreground = source
        idle(1_000)

        assertEquals("exactly one BACK", 1, backs)
        assertNotNull(result)
        assertTrue(result!!.success)
        assertEquals("GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK", result!!.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `cancelPending stops a queued return before it presses BACK`() {
        var backs = 0
        val controller = newController(onBack = { backs++ })
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { destination }

        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, AppSettings(), delayMillis = 1_000L)
        controller.cancelPending()
        idle(5_000)

        assertEquals("a cancelled return must not press BACK", 0, backs)
    }

    /** Review 2026-11-02: the service logs a success only while a return is pending. */
    @Test
    fun `a return counts as pending from scheduling until it is cancelled`() {
        val controller = newController(onBack = { })
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { destination }
        assertEquals(false, controller.hasPendingReturn)

        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, AppSettings(), delayMillis = 1_000L)
        assertEquals("pending during the delay before the first BACK", true, controller.hasPendingReturn)

        controller.cancelPending()
        assertEquals(false, controller.hasPendingReturn)
    }

    @Test
    fun `switching to another app stops the return without pressing BACK`() {
        var backs = 0
        var launches = 0
        val controller = newController(
            onBack = { backs++ },
            launch = { launches++; true }
        )
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { "com.example.unrelated" }

        var result: ReturnController.ReturnResult? = null
        val settings = AppSettings(maxReturnAttempts = 2, autoLaunchRewardApp = true)
        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, settings, delayMillis = 0L) { result = it }
        idle(5_000)

        assertEquals("BACK must never land in another app", 0, backs)
        assertEquals("the reward app must not be pulled over another app", 0, launches)
        assertNotNull(result)
        assertFalse(result!!.success)
        assertEquals("FOREGROUND_CHANGED", result!!.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `an unknown foreground presses no BACK and relaunches nothing`() {
        var backs = 0
        var launches = 0
        val controller = newController(
            onBack = { backs++ },
            launch = { launches++; true }
        )
        controller.foregroundPackageProvider = { null }

        var result: ReturnController.ReturnResult? = null
        val settings = AppSettings(maxReturnAttempts = 2, autoLaunchRewardApp = true)
        controller.scheduleReturn(destination, source, settings, delayMillis = 0L) { result = it }
        idle(5_000)

        assertEquals(0, backs)
        assertEquals(0, launches)
        assertNotNull(result)
        assertFalse(result!!.success)
        assertEquals("FOREGROUND_UNKNOWN", result!!.method)
    }
}

FILE: app\src\test\java\com\rewardadguard\app\detector\AdActionDetectorTest.kt

package com.rewardadguard.app.detector

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * The `[close]` / `[>>]` / `[->]` detector must be *exact*: only a whole label
 * spelled as one of the tokens may be clicked. Every test that asserts "no
 * match" is a normal app's text that must never be automated.
 */
class AdActionDetectorTest {

    private fun node(
        text: String? = null,
        description: String? = null,
        left: Int = 900,
        top: Int = 120,
        right: Int = 980,
        bottom: Int = 200,
        visible: Boolean = true
    ) = NodeSnapshot(
        text = text,
        contentDescription = description,
        viewIdResourceName = null,
        className = "android.widget.TextView",
        clickable = false,
        left = left,
        top = top,
        right = right,
        bottom = bottom,
        visible = visible
    )

    @Test
    fun `the close label is recognised case-insensitively`() {
        assertEquals(AdActionKind.CLOSE, AdActionDetector.classify("[close]"))
        assertEquals(AdActionKind.CLOSE, AdActionDetector.classify("[CLOSE]"))
        assertEquals(AdActionKind.CLOSE, AdActionDetector.classify("  [Close]  "))
    }

    @Test
    fun `both next-step labels are recognised`() {
        assertEquals(AdActionKind.NEXT, AdActionDetector.classify("[>>]"))
        assertEquals(AdActionKind.NEXT, AdActionDetector.classify("[->]"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `ordinary text is never a control`() {
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify("Close"))
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify("close"))
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify(">>"))
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify("->"))
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify("Tap [close] to dismiss"))
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify("[close] (3s)"))
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify("Google Play >>"))
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify("click [->] next"))
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.classify(null))
    }

    @Test
    fun `close wins over next when the screen shows both`() {
        val candidates = listOf(
            node(text = "[>>]"),
            node(text = "[close]", left = 20, top = 20, right = 90, bottom = 90)
        )
        val match = AdActionDetector.bestMatch(candidates, 1080, 2400)
        assertEquals(AdActionKind.CLOSE, match?.kind)
        assertEquals("[close]", match?.token)
    }

    @Test
    fun `next-step label is matched when it is the only control`() {
        val match = AdActionDetector.bestMatch(listOf(node(text = "[->]")), 1080, 2400)
        assertEquals(AdActionKind.NEXT, match?.kind)
        assertEquals("[->]", match?.token)
    }

    @Test
    fun `the smallest labelled node is chosen over its container`() {
        val container = node(text = "[>>]", left = 800, top = 100, right = 1000, bottom = 300)
        val leaf = node(text = "[>>]", left = 900, top = 180, right = 960, bottom = 220)
        val match = AdActionDetector.bestMatch(listOf(container, leaf), 1080, 2400)
        assertEquals(180, match?.node?.top)
        assertEquals(40, match?.node?.height)
    }

    @Test
    fun `content description is accepted when the text is absent`() {
        val match = AdActionDetector.bestMatch(listOf(node(description = "[close]")), 1080, 2400)
        assertEquals(AdActionKind.CLOSE, match?.kind)
    }

    @Test
    fun `invisible and zero-sized nodes are rejected`() {
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.bestMatch(listOf(node(text = "[close]", visible = false)), 1080, 2400))
        assertNull(
            AdActionDetector.bestMatch(
                listOf(node(text = "[close]", left = 10, top = 10, right = 10, bottom = 10)),
                1080,
                2400
            )
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `a full-screen labelled container is never clicked`() {
        val fullScreen = node(text = "[>>]", left = 0, top = 0, right = 1080, bottom = 2400)
        assertNull(AdActionDetector.bestMatch(listOf(fullScreen), 1080, 2400))
    }

    @Test
    fun `isLabelled agrees with the detector`() {
        assertTrue(AdActionDetector.isLabelled(node(text = "[close]"), AdActionKind.CLOSE))
        assertTrue(AdActionDetector.isLabelled(node(text = "[->]"), AdActionKind.NEXT))
        assertTrue(!AdActionDetector.isLabelled(node(text = "[->]"), AdActionKind.CLOSE))
    }

    @Test
    fun `a button-sized target under the label is a safe tap target`() {
        assertTrue(AdActionDetector.isSafeTapTarget(120, 120, true, 1220, 2712))
    }

    /** Review 2026-11-02: a full-screen clickable ancestor is the ad itself. */
    @Test
    fun `a page-sized clickable ancestor is never tapped`() {
        assertTrue(!AdActionDetector.isSafeTapTarget(1220, 2712, true, 1220, 2712))
        val sixth = 1220 * 2712 / 6
        assertTrue(!AdActionDetector.isSafeTapTarget(1220, sixth / 1220 + 2, true, 1220, 2712))
    }

    @Test
    fun `a target that does not cover the label is not tapped`() {
        assertTrue(!AdActionDetector.isSafeTapTarget(120, 120, false, 1220, 2712))
    }

    @Test
    fun `an empty target is not tapped`() {
        assertTrue(!AdActionDetector.isSafeTapTarget(0, 120, true, 1220, 2712))
    }
}

/**

FILE: app\src\test\java\com\rewardadguard\app\detector\CloseButtonDetectorTest.kt

package com.rewardadguard.app.detector

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Tests for the ad [X] heuristic (spec sections 24-27).
 *
 * [CloseButtonDetector] works on plain [NodeSnapshot] values, so no device and
 * no instrumentation are required.
 */
class CloseButtonDetectorTest {

    private fun node(
        text: String? = null,
        desc: String? = null,
        viewId: String? = null,
        className: String? = "android.widget.ImageView",
        clickable: Boolean = true,
        left: Int = 940,
        top: Int = 60,
        right: Int = 1020,
        bottom: Int = 140,
        visible: Boolean = true
    ) = NodeSnapshot(
        text = text,
        contentDescription = desc,
        viewIdResourceName = viewId,
        className = className,
        clickable = clickable,
        left = left,
        top = top,
        right = right,
        bottom = bottom,
        visible = visible
    )

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ geometry

    @Test
    fun `node dimensions and area are derived from bounds`() {
        val n = node(left = 10, top = 20, right = 110, bottom = 70)
        assertEquals(100, n.width)
        assertEquals(50, n.height)
        assertEquals(5000, n.area)
    }

    @Test
    fun `inverted bounds never produce a negative area`() {
        val n = node(left = 200, top = 200, right = 100, bottom = 100)
        assertEquals(0, n.width)
        assertEquals(0, n.height)
        assertEquals(0, n.area)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ matching

    @Test
    fun `corner glyph x is matched`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "x"), 1080, 2400)
        assertTrue("expected the corner X to match, got ${match.method}", match.matched)
        assertTrue(match.score >= CloseButtonDetector.MATCH_THRESHOLD)
    }

    @Test
    fun `multiplication sign glyph is matched`() {
        assertTrue(CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "\u00D7"), 1080, 2400).matched)
    }

    @Test
    fun `localized close labels are matched`() {
        assertTrue(CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "??"), 1080, 2400).matched)
        assertTrue(CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "頝喲?"), 1080, 2400).matched)
    }

    @Test
    fun `english close keyword is matched`() {
        assertTrue(CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "Close"), 1080, 2400).matched)
        assertTrue(CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "Skip Ad"), 1080, 2400).matched)
    }

    @Test
    fun `content description alone is enough`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(
            node(desc = "Close ad", className = "android.widget.ImageButton"),
            1080,
            2400
        )
        assertTrue(match.matched)
        assertEquals("DESCRIPTION_KEYWORD", match.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `close button view id contributes to the score`() {
        val withId = CloseButtonDetector.score(
            node(viewId = "com.example.ad:id/iv_close"),
            1080,
            2400
        )
        val withoutId = CloseButtonDetector.score(node(), 1080, 2400)
        assertTrue(withId.score > withoutId.score)
    }

    @Test
    fun `invisible node is rejected`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "x", visible = false), 1080, 2400)
        assertFalse(match.matched)
        assertEquals("INVISIBLE", match.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `zero sized node is rejected`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "x", left = 5, right = 5), 1080, 2400)
        assertFalse(match.matched)
        assertEquals("ZERO_BOUNDS", match.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `unrelated text in the middle of the screen is rejected`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(
            node(text = "Watch this video to earn coins", left = 300, top = 1100, right = 780, bottom = 1250),
            1080,
            2400
        )
        assertFalse(match.matched)
        assertTrue(match.method.startsWith("REJECTED_SCORE_"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `full screen clickable close call to action is not the X`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(
            node(text = "Close", left = 0, top = 0, right = 1080, bottom = 2400),
            1080,
            2400
        )
        assertFalse("a full-screen CTA must not be treated as the X", match.matched)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ store CTA

    @Test
    fun `a store call to action is rejected even in the close corner`() {
        // The field regression (2026-10-16): a Moloco "Google Play >>" button in
        // the top-right corner scored like an X, the guard tapped it, and the
        // tap opened the store - the guard created the redirect it must prevent.
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(
            node(text = "Google Play >>", left = 880, top = 60, right = 1020, bottom = 150),
            1080,
            2400
        )
        assertFalse("a store CTA must never be the X", match.matched)
        assertEquals("REJECTED_CTA", match.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a localized download CTA is rejected`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "蝡銝?"), 1080, 2400)
        assertFalse(match.matched)
        assertEquals("REJECTED_CTA", match.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a store CTA view id is rejected`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(
            node(viewId = "com.moloco:id/cta_install"),
            1080,
            2400
        )
        assertFalse(match.matched)
        assertEquals("REJECTED_CTA", match.method)
    }

    @Test
    fun `rejecting a CTA does not hide the real close control beside it`() {
        val cta = node(text = "Install", left = 760, top = 60, right = 1020, bottom = 130)
        val x = node(text = "x", left = 1010, top = 20, right = 1060, bottom = 70)
        val best = CloseButtonDetector.bestMatch(listOf(cta, x), 1080, 2400)
        assertNotNull(best)
        assertEquals(x, best!!.node)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ expansion

    @Test
    fun `scale one keeps the original bounds untouched`() {
        val n = node(left = 900, top = 50, right = 1000, bottom = 150)
        val bounds = CloseButtonDetector.expandedBounds(n, 1f)
        assertEquals(900, bounds[0])
        assertEquals(50, bounds[1])
        assertEquals(1000, bounds[2])
        assertEquals(150, bounds[3])
    }

    @Test
    fun `expansion grows around the centre and keeps the node inside`() {
        val n = node(left = 940, top = 60, right = 1020, bottom = 140)
        val bounds = CloseButtonDetector.expandedBounds(n, 3f)

        assertTrue("expanded left must move outwards", bounds[0] <= n.left)
        assertTrue("expanded top must move outwards", bounds[1] <= n.top)
        assertTrue("expanded right must move outwards", bounds[2] >= n.right)
        assertTrue("expanded bottom must move outwards", bounds[3] >= n.bottom)
        assertTrue(bounds[2] - bounds[0] >= n.width)
        assertTrue(bounds[3] - bounds[1] >= n.height)
        // 80x80 node scaled 3x -> 240x240 box centred on (980, 100); the top is
        // pushed back to y=0 so the visible height is 220, not 240.
        assertEquals(240, bounds[2] - bounds[0])
        assertEquals(220, bounds[3] - bounds[1])
        assertEquals(0, bounds[1])
        assertEquals(980, (bounds[0] + bounds[2]) / 2)
        assertEquals(860, bounds[0])
        assertEquals(1100, bounds[2])
        assertEquals(220, bounds[3])
        assertEquals(80, n.height)
    }

    @Test
    fun `expansion is centred on the original node`() {
        val n = node(left = 100, top = 200, right = 200, bottom = 300)
        val bounds = CloseButtonDetector.expandedBounds(n, 3f)
        assertEquals((n.left + n.right) / 2, (bounds[0] + bounds[2]) / 2)
        assertEquals((n.top + n.bottom) / 2, (bounds[1] + bounds[3]) / 2)
    }

    @Test
    fun `expansion never leaves the screen on the top left`() {
        val n = node(left = 0, top = 0, right = 40, bottom = 40)
        val bounds = CloseButtonDetector.expandedBounds(n, 5f)
        assertTrue(bounds[0] >= 0)
        assertTrue(bounds[1] >= 0)
    }

    @Test
    fun `expansion scale is clamped to the supported range`() {
        val n = node(left = 100, top = 100, right = 200, bottom = 200)
        val clampedHigh = CloseButtonDetector.expandedBounds(n, 99f)
        val atFive = CloseButtonDetector.expandedBounds(n, 5f)
        assertTrue(clampedHigh.contentEquals(atFive))

        val clampedLow = CloseButtonDetector.expandedBounds(n, 0.1f)
        assertEquals(n.left, clampedLow[0])
        assertEquals(n.right, clampedLow[2])
    }

    @Test
    fun `a matched result carries the suggested click target`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(node(text = "X"), 1080, 2400)
        assertNotNull(match.suggestedExpandedBounds)
        // 80x80 at (940,60)-(1020,140) scaled 3x, clamped to the top edge.
        assertEquals("240x220", match.boundsLabel())
    }

    @Test
    fun `an unmatched result carries no click target`() {
        val match = CloseButtonDetector.score(
            node(text = "Earn coins", left = 300, top = 1100, right = 780, bottom = 1250),
            1080,
            2400
        )
        assertNull(match.suggestedExpandedBounds)
        assertEquals("-", match.boundsLabel())
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ best match

    @Test
    fun `best match picks the highest scoring candidate`() {
        val weak = node(
            viewId = "com.example.ad:id/btn_close",
            className = "android.widget.Button",
            left = 400, top = 800, right = 700, bottom = 900
        )
        val strong = node(text = "x")
        val best = CloseButtonDetector.bestMatch(listOf(weak, strong), 1080, 2400)
        assertNotNull(best)
        assertEquals(strong, best!!.node)
    }

    @Test
    fun `best match returns null when nothing looks like a close control`() {
        val a = node(text = "Earn 100 coins", left = 200, top = 900, right = 880, bottom = 1000)
        val b = node(text = "Watch", left = 200, top = 1100, right = 880, bottom = 1200)
        assertNull(CloseButtonDetector.bestMatch(listOf(a, b), 1080, 2400))
    }

    @Test
    fun `best match on an empty tree returns null`() {
        assertNull(CloseButtonDetector.bestMatch(emptyList(), 1080, 2400))
    }

    @Test
    fun `bounds label reports the label for the expanded bounds`() {
        val n = node(left = 100, top = 100, right = 200, bottom = 200)
        val b = CloseButtonDetector.expandedBounds(n, 3f)
        val match = CloseMatch(true, 60, "SYMBOL_TEXT", n, b)
        assertEquals("${b[2] - b[0]}x${b[3] - b[1]}", match.boundsLabel())
    }

    // ------------------------- assist target shape (BitWalk test 2026-11-02)

    private fun target(left: Int, top: Int, right: Int, bottom: Int) =
        CloseButtonDetector.isPlausibleAssistTarget(node(left = left, top = top, right = right, bottom = bottom), 1220, 2712)

    @Test
    fun `every X that closed an ad on 2026-11-02 is a plausible target`() {
        assertTrue("InMobi", target(1068, 120, 1173, 210))
        assertTrue("InMobi small", target(1101, 150, 1140, 180))
        assertTrue("InMobi desc", target(1104, 144, 1149, 186))
        assertTrue("Moloco X", target(1092, 66, 1191, 165))
        assertTrue("Vungle", target(1104, 180, 1161, 234))
        assertTrue("Unity", target(993, 171, 1167, 348))
        assertTrue("top-left X", target(51, 120, 126, 192))
    }

    @Test
    fun `every match that opened the store on 2026-11-02 is rejected`() {
        assertFalse("Moloco Google Play >>", target(810, 66, 1191, 165))
        assertFalse("Unity text block", target(51, 171, 351, 255))
        assertFalse("Fyber call to action", target(1038, 171, 1161, 243))
        assertFalse("InMobi mid-screen", target(72, 1230, 144, 1305))
    }

    @Test
    fun `a node partly off screen is rejected`() {
        assertFalse(target(-43, 289, 67, 354))
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.detector

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Tests for the classification data model (spec section 21).
 *
 * [PackageClassifier] itself needs an Android [android.content.Context] to ask
 * the PackageManager about installed apps, so the parts that can be verified on
 * a plain JVM are the [DestinationKind] semantics it returns. The mapping
 * itself is exercised on device by TOOLS/device_test_checklist.ps1.
 */
class PackageClassifierTest {

    @Test
    fun `self is never external`() {
        assertFalse(DestinationKind.SELF.isExternal)
    }

    @Test
    fun `unknown is never reported as external`() {
        assertFalse(DestinationKind.UNKNOWN.isExternal)
    }

    @Test
    fun `every real destination class counts as external`() {
        val external = listOf(
            DestinationKind.BROWSER,
            DestinationKind.STORE,
            DestinationKind.GAME,
            DestinationKind.DEEP_LINK,
            DestinationKind.EXTERNAL_APP
        )
        for (kind in external) {
            assertTrue("$kind should be external", kind.isExternal)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `only self and unknown are internal`() {
        assertEquals(
            listOf(DestinationKind.SELF, DestinationKind.UNKNOWN),
            DestinationKind.entries.filter { !it.isExternal }
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `every destination kind is distinct`() {
        val kinds = DestinationKind.entries
        assertEquals(kinds.size, kinds.toSet().size)
        assertEquals(7, kinds.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun `name lookup round trips for the service`() {
        for (kind in DestinationKind.entries) {
            assertEquals(kind, DestinationKind.valueOf(kind.name))
        }
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.detector

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Field report 2026-10-30: `miui.systemui.plugin` (HyperOS dynamic island) and
 * the intent resolver must never count as the foreground app.
 */
class SystemOverlayPackagesTest {

    @Test
    fun `the dynamic island is an overlay`() {
        assertTrue(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("miui.systemui.plugin"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `the intent resolver is an overlay`() {
        assertTrue(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("com.android.intentresolver"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `system ui stays an overlay`() {
        assertTrue(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("com.android.systemui"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `ordinary apps are not overlays`() {
        assertFalse(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("com.shopee.tw"))
        assertFalse(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("com.android.chrome"))
        assertFalse(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("jp.paddleinc.walk"))
        assertFalse(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("com.tracerofficial"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `packages merely containing plugin or resolver are not overlays`() {
        // The list is explicit on purpose: a substring rule would swallow real
        // apps whose package name happens to contain these words.
        assertFalse(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("com.example.plugin"))
        assertFalse(SystemOverlayPackages.isOverlay("com.example.resolver"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `system surfaces include the overlays and the installer dialogs`() {
        for (pkg in listOf(
            "miui.systemui.plugin",
            "com.android.intentresolver",
            "com.android.systemui",
            "com.android.settings",
            "com.android.packageinstaller"
        )) {
            assertTrue("$pkg should be a system surface", SystemOverlayPackages.isSystemSurface(pkg))
        }
        assertFalse(SystemOverlayPackages.isSystemSurface("com.shopee.tw"))
    }

    /** 2026-11-04: the guard closed Google search / Assistant summoned by the user. */
    @Test
    fun `Google search, Assistant, Gemini and Lens are user summoned`() {
        listOf(
            "com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox",
            "com.google.android.apps.googleassistant",
            "com.google.android.apps.bard",
            "com.google.ar.lens"
        ).forEach { org.junit.Assert.assertTrue(it, SystemOverlayPackages.isUserSummoned(it)) }
    }

    @Test
    fun `ad destinations are not user summoned`() {
        listOf("com.android.chrome", "com.android.vending", "com.shopee.tw")
            .forEach { org.junit.Assert.assertFalse(it, SystemOverlayPackages.isUserSummoned(it)) }
    }
}

package com.rewardadguard.app.guard

import com.rewardadguard.app.data.AppSettings
import com.rewardadguard.app.data.AssistAction
import com.rewardadguard.app.detector.AdActionKind
import com.rewardadguard.app.detector.AdActionMatch
import com.rewardadguard.app.detector.NodeSnapshot
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * The policy that decides whether a `[close]` / `[>>]` / `[->]` click may run.
 *
 * The most important cases are the negative ones: a non-reward app, an unknown
 * foreground and a foreground app that is not the reward app that owns the ad
 * must all be refused.
 */
class AdActionGuardTest {

    private val source = "com.example.reward"
    private val other = "com.example.other"
    private val guard = AdActionGuard(logger = null, sessionManager = null)

    private fun node(left: Int = 900, top: Int = 120) = NodeSnapshot(
        text = "[>>]",
        contentDescription = null,
        viewIdResourceName = null,
        className = "android.widget.TextView",
        clickable = true,
        left = left,
        top = top,
        right = left + 80,
        bottom = top + 80
    )

    private fun match(kind: AdActionKind = AdActionKind.NEXT, left: Int = 900, top: Int = 120) =
        AdActionMatch(kind, node(left, top), "TEXT_TOKEN_${kind.name}")

    private fun decide(
        match: AdActionMatch = match(),
        settings: AppSettings = AppSettings(),
        monitored: Boolean = true,
        rootMatches: Boolean = true,
        foreground: String? = source,
        expected: String? = source,
        userInteracting: Boolean = false,
        now: Long = 10_000L
    ) = guard.decide(
        match = match,
        settings = settings,
        adWindowMonitored = monitored,
        rootPackageMatches = rootMatches,
        foregroundPackage = foreground,
        expectedPackage = expected,
        userInteracting = userInteracting,
        now = now
    )

    @Test
    fun `an action in the monitored reward app is allowed`() {
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.ALLOW, decide())
    }

    @Test
    fun `a non-reward app is never automated`() {
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.NOT_AD_WINDOW, decide(monitored = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun `an unknown foreground is refused`() {
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.FOREGROUND_UNKNOWN, decide(foreground = null))
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.FOREGROUND_UNKNOWN, decide(foreground = "  "))
    }

    @Test
    fun `another app in front is refused`() {
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.FOREGROUND_MISMATCH, decide(foreground = other))
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.FOREGROUND_MISMATCH, decide(expected = null))
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.FOREGROUND_MISMATCH, decide(rootMatches = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun `settings can disable all ad-page automation`() {
        assertEquals(
            AdActionDecision.DISABLED,
            decide(settings = AppSettings(closeButtonAssistance = false))
        )
        assertEquals(
            AdActionDecision.ACTION_NONE,
            decide(settings = AppSettings(assistAction = AssistAction.NONE))
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `a touch on the screen suppresses the action`() {
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.USER_INTERACTING, decide(userInteracting = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun `a second action within the throttle window is refused`() {
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.ALLOW, decide(now = 10_000L))
        guard.onDispatched(match(), source, now = 10_000L)
        assertEquals(
            AdActionDecision.THROTTLED,
            decide(match(kind = AdActionKind.CLOSE, left = 10, top = 10), now = 10_400L)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `the same control is not clicked twice`() {
        guard.onDispatched(match(), source, now = 10_000L)
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.REPEATED, decide(now = 11_000L))
        assertEquals("still suppressed much later", AdActionDecision.REPEATED, decide(now = 60_000L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `a cleared screen allows the same control again`() {
        guard.onDispatched(match(), source, now = 10_000L)
        guard.onScreenCleared()
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.ALLOW, decide(now = 11_000L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `a different control is allowed after the throttle window`() {
        guard.onDispatched(match(), source, now = 10_000L)
        assertEquals(
            AdActionDecision.ALLOW,
            decide(match(kind = AdActionKind.CLOSE, left = 10, top = 10), now = 11_000L)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `next-step clicks are capped per ad`() {
        var now = 10_000L
        repeat(AdActionGuard.MAX_NEXT_STEPS_PER_AD) { i ->
            val m = match(left = 100 + i, top = 100 + i)
            assertEquals(AdActionDecision.ALLOW, decide(match = m, now = now))
            guard.onDispatched(m, source, now = now)
            now += AdActionGuard.THROTTLE_MILLIS
        }
        assertEquals(
            AdActionDecision.NEXT_CAP,
            decide(match = match(left = 999, top = 999), now = now)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `reset restores the cap and the throttle`() {
        guard.onDispatched(match(), source, now = 10_000L)
        guard.reset()
        assertEquals(0, guard.nextSteps)
        assertEquals(AdActionDecision.ALLOW, decide(now = 10_100L))
    }

    /** Review 2026-11-02: detect-only wrote one row per scan (about two a second). */
    @Test
    fun `a detect-only skip is logged once per control and interval`() {
        val m = match()
        assertTrue(guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.ACTION_NONE, m, now = 1_000L))
        assertFalse(guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.ACTION_NONE, m, now = 1_500L))
        assertFalse(guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.ACTION_NONE, m, now = 9_000L))
        assertTrue(
            guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.ACTION_NONE, m, now = 1_000L + AdActionGuard.DELIBERATE_LOG_INTERVAL_MILLIS)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `a different control is logged even inside the interval`() {
        assertTrue(guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.ACTION_NONE, match(left = 900), now = 1_000L))
        assertTrue(guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.ACTION_NONE, match(left = 100), now = 1_100L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `safety rejections are always logged`() {
        val m = match()
        assertTrue(guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.FOREGROUND_MISMATCH, m, now = 1_000L))
        assertTrue(guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.FOREGROUND_MISMATCH, m, now = 1_100L))
        assertFalse(guard.shouldLogSkip(AdActionDecision.THROTTLED, m, now = 1_200L))
    }
}
