#Requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Density-check helper: prints the generated launcher PNG as ASCII art.

.DESCRIPTION
    Verification aid for TOOLS/make_launcher_icons.ps1. Rendering a vector mark
    to a bitmap can go wrong in ways a build cannot catch - wrong coordinates,
    artwork outside the safe zone, a shape that collapses at 48px - so this prints
    a coarse character map of the pixels so the silhouette can be eyeballed in a
    terminal.

    Legend:  W = white pixel, N = navy pixel, . = other
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string] $Png = (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'iconpreview\mipmap-xxxhdpi\ic_launcher.png'),
    [int] $Steps = 32
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

if (-not (Test-Path $Png)) {
    throw "Not found: $Png. Run TOOLS/make_launcher_icons.ps1 first."
}

$bmp = [System.Drawing.Bitmap]::FromFile((Resolve-Path $Png).Path)
try {
    $w = $bmp.Width
    $h = $bmp.Height
    Write-Host ("{0}  {1}x{1}px  (step = {2}px)" -f (Split-Path $Png -Leaf), $w, [math]::Floor($w / $Steps)) -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ''

    $step = $w / [double]$Steps
    for ($r = 0; $r -lt $Steps; $r++) {
        $line = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        for ($c = 0; $c -lt $Steps; $c++) {
            # Sample the centre of each cell.
            $x = [int][math]::Min($w - 1, [math]::Floor(($c + 0.5) * $step))
            $y = [int][math]::Min($h - 1, [math]::Floor(($r + 0.5) * $step))
            $px = $bmp.GetPixel($x, $y)
            if ($px.R -gt 200 -and $px.G -gt 200 -and $px.B -gt 200) {
                [void]$line.Append('#')
            } elseif ($px.B -gt 80 -and $px.R -lt 100) {
                [void]$line.Append('+')
            } else {
                [void]$line.Append('.')
            }
        }
        Write-Host $line.ToString()
    }

    # Sanity checks that matter for a legacy launcher icon.
    Write-Host ''
    $corner = $bmp.GetPixel(0, 0)
    Write-Host ("corner pixel      : R{0} G{1} B{2}  (expect navy plate)" -f $corner.R, $corner.G, $corner.B) -ForegroundColor Gray

    $outside = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $w; $i += [math]::Max(1, [math]::Floor($w / 32))) {
        foreach ($p in @(@($i, 0), @($i, ($h - 1)), @(0, $i), @(($w - 1), $i))) {
            $px = $bmp.GetPixel($p[0], $p[1])
            if ($px.R -gt 200 -and $px.G -gt 200) { $outside++ }
        }
    }
    if ($outside -eq 0) {
        Write-Host 'safe margin       : OK - no white touches the outer 2% border' -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host ("safe margin       : WARNING - {0} white border samples; art may be clipped" -f $outside) -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
} finally {
    $bmp.Dispose()
}


==============================================================================
FILE: TOOLS\pull-db.ps1
==============================================================================
<#
    Pull the app's SQLite database off the device without corrupting it.

    Why not `adb shell cat > file`: adb's shell streams the file through a PTY,
    which rewrites line endings and strips binary bytes - the result is a file
    sqlite3 rejects with "not a database". `adb exec-out` is the raw binary
    channel, and .NET writes the bytes verbatim. PowerShell must not see the
    bytes at all (it would split them into an array and re-encode), so the
    process writes straight to a file handle.

    Also pulls the DataStore preferences file, so an analysis sees the exact
    settings in force (ISS-11).

    Usage:  .\TOOLS\pull-db.ps1 [-OutDir <dir>] [-Adb <path-to-adb>]
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$OutDir = "$PSScriptRoot\..\.git\devicedump",
    [string]$Package = 'com.rewardadguard.app',
    [string]$Adb = ''
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# adb lives in a different place on every machine, so resolve it instead of
# relying on PATH (ISS-11). Mirrors auto_test.ps1's Resolve-Adb.
function Resolve-Adb {
    param([string]$Explicit)

    $candidates = @()
    if ($Explicit) { $candidates += $Explicit }
    if ($env:ADB) { $candidates += $env:ADB }

    $repoRoot = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($PSScriptRoot)) {
        (Get-Location).Path
    } else {
        (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
    }
    $props = Join-Path $repoRoot 'local.properties'
    if (Test-Path $props) {
        $sdkLine = Select-String -Path $props -Pattern '^\s*sdk\.dir\s*=' | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($sdkLine) {
            $sdk = ($sdkLine.Line -split '=', 2)[1].Trim() -replace '\\\\', '\'
            if ($sdk) { $candidates += (Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools\adb.exe') }
        }
    }

    foreach ($envName in 'ANDROID_HOME', 'ANDROID_SDK_ROOT') {
        $sdk = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($envName)
        if ($sdk) { $candidates += (Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools\adb.exe') }
    }

    $candidates += (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe')
    $candidates += 'adb'

    foreach ($candidate in $candidates) {
        if ($candidate -eq 'adb') {
            if (Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { return 'adb' }
        } elseif (Test-Path $candidate) {
            return $candidate
        }
    }
    return $null
}

$Adb = Resolve-Adb -Explicit $Adb
if (-not $Adb) {
    throw 'adb.exe not found. Pass -Adb, set $env:ADB, or add platform-tools to PATH.'
}

# Windows PowerShell 5.1 has no ternary operator, and Serial is an automatic
# variable that only exists when adb was started with -s, so it is checked by
# name rather than used directly.
$serial = $null
if (Get-Variable -Name Serial -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $serial = $Serial }
$null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir

# Databases are in WAL mode, so the -wal and -shm siblings carry the most recent
# writes. All three must be copied together or the copy is inconsistent. The
# DataStore preferences file holds the settings.
$files = @(
    @{ remote = "/data/data/$Package/databases/reward_ad_guard.db";     name = 'reward_ad_guard.db' },
    @{ remote = "/data/data/$Package/databases/reward_ad_guard.db-wal"; name = 'reward_ad_guard.db-wal' },
    @{ remote = "/data/data/$Package/databases/reward_ad_guard.db-shm"; name = 'reward_ad_guard.db-shm' },
    @{ remote = "/data/data/$Package/files/datastore/reward_ad_guard_settings.preferences_pb";
       name = 'reward_ad_guard_settings.preferences_pb' }
)

foreach ($f in $files) {
    $local = Join-Path $OutDir $f.name

    $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
    $psi.FileName = $Adb
    $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
    $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true
    $psi.UseShellExecute = $false
    $psi.CreateNoWindow = $true
    $args = @()
    if ($serial) { $args += @('-s', $serial) }
    $args += @('exec-out', 'run-as', $Package, 'cat', $f.remote)
    $psi.Arguments = ($args | ForEach-Object {
        if ([string]$_ -match '\s') { '"' + $_ + '"' } else { $_ }
    }) -join ' '

    $proc = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi)
    try {
        # Read the raw bytes as bytes. Reading via StreamReader/BaseStream.CopyTo
        # would decode as UTF-16 (adb's exec-out on this device emits a BOM) and
        # silently corrupt the database. Memory is safe here: these files are
        # only a few MB.
        $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
        $proc.StandardOutput.BaseStream.CopyTo($ms)
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($local, $ms.ToArray())
        $ms.Dispose()
    } finally {
        if (-not $proc.HasExited) { $proc.WaitForExit() }
    }

    $size = (Get-Item $local).Length
    if ($size -eq 0) {
        # The DataStore file is only created once a setting has been written, so a
        # 0-byte read is a warning for it, not a hard failure.
        Write-Warning "$($f.name) : 0 bytes (exit $($proc.ExitCode))"
    } else {
        Write-Host ("{0,-44} {1,10} bytes" -f $f.name, $size)
    }
    $proc.Dispose()
}

# Copying a WAL database leaves a stale -shm, which confuses sqlite3 into
# thinking another process holds the lock. Removing it lets the -wal replay.
$shm = Join-Path $OutDir 'reward_ad_guard.db-shm'
if (Test-Path $shm) { Remove-Item $shm -Force }

Write-Host "`nPulled to $OutDir" -ForegroundColor Green

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  手機螢幕關閉／開啟（像 scrcpy 的關螢幕）：只關面板，手機照常運作。
.DESCRIPTION
  自動收取在螢幕關掉時照樣截圖、點擊，手機不會鎖定。
  要亮回來請執行「開啟」。不要按電源鍵：系統仍當螢幕是亮的，按電源鍵會讓手機真的休眠並鎖定，收取會暫停。
  執行一次就結束，不常駐。
.EXAMPLE
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File screen_off.ps1 off
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File screen_off.ps1 on -Serial 192.168.68.100:5555
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Position = 0)][ValidateSet('off', 'on')][string]$Action = 'off',
    [string]$Serial = ''
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$here = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$dex = Join-Path $here 'screenoff.dex'
$remote = '/data/local/tmp/screenoff.dex'

function Find-Adb {
    $cmd = Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
    foreach ($p in @("$env:ANDROID_HOME\platform-tools\adb.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe", 'D:\Claude\android-sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe')) {
        if ($p -and (Test-Path $p)) { return $p }
    }
    throw '找不到 adb，請安裝 platform-tools 或設定 ANDROID_HOME。'
}

$adb = Find-Adb
if (-not (Test-Path $dex)) { throw "找不到 $dex" }

# 手機：指定的、或目前連著的那一台（記住上次成功的位址，連不上時試著連回去）
$state = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'screen_off_last_device.txt'
if (-not $Serial) {
    $devices = & $adb devices | Select-String -Pattern "`tdevice$" | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split "`t")[0] }
    if (@($devices).Count -eq 0 -and (Test-Path $state)) {
        $last = (Get-Content $state -Raw).Trim()
        if ($last) { & $adb connect $last | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
            $devices = & $adb devices | Select-String -Pattern "`tdevice$" | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split "`t")[0] } }
    }
    $devices = @($devices)
    if ($devices.Count -eq 0) { throw '沒有連線中的手機，請先開無線偵錯並 adb connect。' }
    if ($devices.Count -gt 1) { throw ('連著多台手機，請用 -Serial 指定：' + ($devices -join ', ')) }
    $Serial = $devices[0]
} elseif ($Serial -match ':') {
    & $adb connect $Serial | Out-Null
}

# 手機上的程式與這裡的不同（大小不同）才重新推上去
$localSize = (Get-Item $dex).Length
$remoteSize = (& $adb -s $Serial shell "stat -c %s $remote 2>/dev/null").Trim()
if ($remoteSize -ne "$localSize") {
    & $adb -s $Serial push $dex $remote | Out-Null
}

$out = & $adb -s $Serial shell "CLASSPATH=$remote app_process / ScreenOff $Action" 2>&1
$text = ($out | Out-String).Trim()
if ($text -match 'OK (off|on)') {
    if ($Action -eq 'on') {
        # HyperOS turns the panel on without its backlight: nudge the brightness and put it back.
        $level = (& $adb -s $Serial shell settings get system screen_brightness).Trim()
        $mode = (& $adb -s $Serial shell settings get system screen_brightness_mode).Trim()
        if ($level -match '^\d+$') {
            $v = [int]$level
            & $adb -s $Serial shell settings put system screen_brightness_mode 0 | Out-Null
            & $adb -s $Serial shell settings put system screen_brightness $(if ($v -lt 235) { $v + 20 } else { $v - 20 }) | Out-Null
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
            & $adb -s $Serial shell settings put system screen_brightness $v | Out-Null
            if ($mode -match '^[01]$') { & $adb -s $Serial shell settings put system screen_brightness_mode $mode | Out-Null }
        }
    }
    Set-Content -Path $state -Value $Serial -Encoding ASCII
    if ($Action -eq 'off') { Write-Host "手機螢幕已關閉（$Serial）：手機照常運作。要亮回來請執行「手機螢幕開啟」（不要按電源鍵，按了手機會休眠鎖定）。" }
    else { Write-Host "手機螢幕已開啟（$Serial）。" }
    exit 0
}
Write-Host "失敗（$Serial）：$text"
exit 1

import java.lang.reflect.Method;

/**
 * Turns the phone's display panel off (or back on) while the system keeps
 * running, like scrcpy's --turn-screen-off: Android still treats the screen
 * as on, so the auto-collector keeps taking screenshots and tapping, and the
 * phone does not lock. Turn it back on with "on": the power button would
 * put the phone to sleep (Android believes the screen is on) and lock it.
 *
 * Run as the shell user through app_process (TOOLS/screen_off/screen_off.ps1):
 *   CLASSPATH=/data/local/tmp/screenoff.dex app_process / ScreenOff off|on
 *
 * Android 13 and below: SurfaceControl has the display tokens. Android 14+
 * moved them to com.android.server.display.DisplayControl in services.jar,
 * loaded here the way scrcpy does it. Only reflection, no Android SDK needed
 * to compile.
 */
public final class ScreenOff {

    private static final int POWER_MODE_OFF = 0;
    private static final int POWER_MODE_NORMAL = 2;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        if (args.length != 1 || !(args[0].equals("off") || args[0].equals("on"))) {
            System.err.println("usage: ScreenOff off|on");
            System.exit(2);
        }
        int mode = args[0].equals("off") ? POWER_MODE_OFF : POWER_MODE_NORMAL;
        Class<?> surfaceControl = Class.forName("android.view.SurfaceControl");
        Object[] tokens = displayTokens(surfaceControl);
        if (tokens.length == 0) {
            System.err.println("no display token found");
            System.exit(3);
        }
        int done = 0;
        for (Object token : tokens) {
            if (setPowerMode(surfaceControl, token, mode)) done++;
        }
        if (done == 0) {
            System.err.println("setDisplayPowerMode not available");
            System.exit(4);
        }
        System.out.println("OK " + args[0] + " displays=" + done);
        System.out.flush();
        // Skip the runtime's shutdown: unloading android_servers crashed it
        // (Segmentation fault) after the work was already done.
        Runtime.getRuntime().halt(0);
    }

    private static Class<?> displayControl;

    private static Class<?> displayControl() throws Exception {
        if (displayControl != null) return displayControl;
        Class<?> factory = Class.forName("com.android.internal.os.ClassLoaderFactory");
        Method create = factory.getDeclaredMethod("createClassLoader", String.class, String.class,
            String.class, ClassLoader.class, int.class, boolean.class, String.class);
        ClassLoader loader = (ClassLoader) create.invoke(null, "/system/framework/services.jar",
            null, null, null, 0, true, null);
        Class<?> cls = loader.loadClass("com.android.server.display.DisplayControl");
        Method loadLibrary = Runtime.class.getDeclaredMethod("loadLibrary0", Class.class, String.class);
        loadLibrary.setAccessible(true);
        loadLibrary.invoke(Runtime.getRuntime(), cls, "android_servers");
        displayControl = cls;
        return cls;
    }

    private static Object[] displayTokens(Class<?> surfaceControl) throws Exception {
        // Android 10-13.
        try {
            Method m = surfaceControl.getMethod("getInternalDisplayToken");
            Object token = m.invoke(null);
            if (token != null) return new Object[] {token};
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException ignored) {
        }
        // Android 14+: every physical display (some phones report two).
        try {
            Class<?> dc = displayControl();
            long[] ids = (long[]) dc.getMethod("getPhysicalDisplayIds").invoke(null);
            Method tokenOf = dc.getMethod("getPhysicalDisplayToken", long.class);
            java.util.List<Object> tokens = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            for (long id : ids) {
                Object token = tokenOf.invoke(null, id);
                if (token != null) tokens.add(token);
            }
            return tokens.toArray();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            System.err.println("DisplayControl: " + t);
        }
        return new Object[0];
    }

    private static boolean setPowerMode(Class<?> surfaceControl, Object token, int mode) {
        Class<?> binder;
        try {
            binder = Class.forName("android.os.IBinder");
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            surfaceControl.getMethod("setDisplayPowerMode", binder, int.class).invoke(null, token, mode);
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            System.err.println("SurfaceControl.setDisplayPowerMode: " + t);
        }
        try {
            displayControl().getMethod("setDisplayPowerMode", binder, int.class).invoke(null, token, mode);
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            System.err.println("DisplayControl.setDisplayPowerMode: " + t);
        }
        return false;
    }
}

// ???Ｗ???嚗xe ??嚗??璈??Ｗ??Ｘ嚗?璈撣賊?雿???scrcpy ???Ｗ???
// ???撟????撟?摰?敺?蝒????銝虜擏?
// ??蝡臬?蝔? screenoff.dex ?批???exe 鋆∴??閬??芸??其?????
// adb ? exe ??嚗?撣嗥???platform-tools嚗?? PATH / ANDROID_HOME??
// ?賭誘?????Ｗ???.exe off | on [??雿?]   嚗???蝒?蝯?隞?Ⅳ 0=??嚗?
//
// 蝺刻陌嚗indows ?批遣 .NET Framework嚗# 5嚗?TOOLS/screen_off/build_exe.ps1
using System;

    static readonly string StateDir =
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData);

    static readonly string ActionFile = Path.Combine(StateDir, "screen_off_last_action.txt");

    [STAThread]
    static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        if (args.Length >= 1 && (args[0] == "off" || args[0] == "on"))
        {
            string message;
            bool ok = Run(args[0], args.Length > 1 ? args[1] : null, out message);
            Console.WriteLine(message);
            return ok ? 0 : 1;
        }
        Application.EnableVisualStyles();
        Application.SetCompatibleTextRenderingDefault(false);
        Application.Run(new SwitchForm());
        return 0;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- adb

    static string FindAdb()
    {
        string here = Path.GetDirectoryName(Application.ExecutablePath);
        var list = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string> {
            Path.Combine(here, "adb.exe"),
            Path.Combine(here, @"platform-tools\adb.exe")
        };
        foreach (var dir in (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH") ?? "").Split(';'))
        {
            try { if (dir.Trim().Length > 0) list.Add(Path.Combine(dir.Trim(), "adb.exe")); } catch { }
        }
        string home = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ANDROID_HOME");
        if (home != null) list.Add(Path.Combine(home, @"platform-tools\adb.exe"));
        list.Add(Path.Combine(StateDir, @"Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe"));
        list.Add(@"D:\Claude\android-sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe");
        foreach (var c in list) { try { if (File.Exists(c)) return c; } catch { } }
        return null;
    }

    static string Adb(string adb, string arguments, out int exitCode)
    {
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(adb, arguments);
        psi.UseShellExecute = false;
        psi.CreateNoWindow = true;
        psi.RedirectStandardOutput = true;
        psi.RedirectStandardError = true;
        psi.StandardOutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;
        psi.StandardErrorEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;
        using (var p = Process.Start(psi))
        {
            var err = p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync();
            string output = p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();
            if (!p.WaitForExit(60000)) { try { p.Kill(); } catch { } exitCode = -1; return output + " (timeout)"; }
            exitCode = p.ExitCode;
            return output + err.Result;
        }
    }

    static string[] Devices(string adb)
    {
        int code;
        return Adb(adb, "devices", out code)
            .Split('\n')
            .Select(l => l.Trim())
            .Where(l => l.EndsWith("\tdevice"))
            .Select(l => l.Split('\t')[0])
            .ToArray();
    }

    static string LastDevice()
    {
        try { return File.Exists(DeviceFile) ? File.ReadAllText(DeviceFile).Trim() : ""; } catch { return ""; }
    }

    /// <summary>The phone to use: connected now, else the given/last address reconnected.</summary>
    static string ResolveDevice(string adb, string address, out string problem)
    {
        int code;
        problem = null;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(address) && address.Contains(":"))
        {
            Adb(adb, "connect " + address, out code);
        }
        var devices = Devices(adb);
        if (devices.Length == 0)
        {
            string last = LastDevice();
            if (last.Length > 0 && last.Contains(":")) { Adb(adb, "connect " + last, out code); devices = Devices(adb); }
        }
        if (devices.Length == 0) { problem = "瘝????銝剔???嚗??????蝺?荔?頛詨雿?敺??????; return null; }
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(address) && devices.Contains(address)) return address;
        if (devices.Length > 1) { problem = "???憭??嚗??其??甈撓?亥??函???嚗? + string.Join(", ", devices); return null; }
        return devices[0];
    }

    /// <summary>Connection check for the window: the phone's name, or null with why.</summary>
    public static string Check(string address, out string problem)
    {
        string adb = FindAdb();
        if (adb == null) { problem = "?曆???adb嚗?撣嗥?隢???platform-tools 鞈?憭橘?"; return null; }
        return ResolveDevice(adb, address, out problem);
    }

    static byte[] Dex()
    {
        using (var s = typeof(ScreenSwitch).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("screenoff.dex"))
        using (var m = new MemoryStream())
        {
            s.CopyTo(m);
            return m.ToArray();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Turns the phone's panel off or on. False with the reason on failure.</summary>
    public static bool Run(string action, string address, out string message)
    {
        string adb = FindAdb();
        if (adb == null) { message = "?曆???adb嚗?撣嗥?隢???platform-tools 鞈?憭橘?"; return false; }
        int code;
        string problem;
        string serial = ResolveDevice(adb, address, out problem);
        if (serial == null) { message = problem; return false; }

        byte[] dex = Dex();
        string remoteSize = Adb(adb, "-s " + serial + " shell stat -c %s " + Remote, out code).Trim();
        if (remoteSize != dex.Length.ToString())
        {
            string tmp = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "screenoff.dex");
            File.WriteAllBytes(tmp, dex);
            Adb(adb, "-s " + serial + " push \"" + tmp + "\" " + Remote, out code);
            if (code != 0) { message = "?券?蝔??唳?璈仃??; return false; }
        }
        string result = Adb(adb, "-s " + serial + " shell CLASSPATH=" + Remote + " app_process / ScreenOff " + action, out code);
        if (result.Contains("OK " + action))
        {
            // HyperOS turns the panel on without its backlight (2026-11-17):
            // nudging the brightness and putting it back lights it again.
            if (action == "on") NudgeBrightness(adb, serial);
            try { File.WriteAllText(DeviceFile, serial); File.WriteAllText(ActionFile, action); } catch { }
            message = action == "off" ? "?Ｗ?撌脤??????批虜??" : "?Ｗ?撌脤???;
            return true;
        }
        message = "憭望?嚗? + result.Trim();
        return false;
    }

    static void NudgeBrightness(string adb, string serial)
    {
        int code;
        string pre = "-s " + serial + " shell settings ";
        string level = Adb(adb, pre + "get system screen_brightness", out code).Trim();
        string mode = Adb(adb, pre + "get system screen_brightness_mode", out code).Trim();
        int value;
        if (!int.TryParse(level, out value)) return;
        Adb(adb, pre + "put system screen_brightness_mode 0", out code);
        Adb(adb, pre + "put system screen_brightness " + (value < 235 ? value + 20 : value - 20), out code);
        System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(600);
        Adb(adb, pre + "put system screen_brightness " + value, out code);
        if (mode == "0" || mode == "1") Adb(adb, pre + "put system screen_brightness_mode " + mode, out code);
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- UI

    static readonly Color Back = Color.FromArgb(22, 24, 31);
    static readonly Color Card = Color.FromArgb(32, 35, 45);
    static readonly Color Muted = Color.FromArgb(150, 156, 172);
    static readonly Color Green = Color.FromArgb(52, 199, 89);
    static readonly Color Red = Color.FromArgb(255, 99, 99);
    static readonly Color Blue = Color.FromArgb(30, 136, 229);

    static Font UiFont(float size, FontStyle style)
    {
        return new Font("Microsoft JhengHei UI", size, style);
    }

    static GraphicsPath Rounded(Rectangle r, int radius)
    {
        var path = new GraphicsPath();
        int d = radius * 2;
        path.AddArc(r.X, r.Y, d, d, 180, 90);
        path.AddArc(r.Right - d, r.Y, d, d, 270, 90);
        path.AddArc(r.Right - d, r.Bottom - d, d, d, 0, 90);
        path.AddArc(r.X, r.Bottom - d, d, d, 90, 90);
        path.CloseFigure();
        return path;
    }

    /// <summary>A rounded, owner-drawn button with a small moon or sun glyph.</summary>
    class BigButton : Control
    {
        public Color Fill;
        public bool Moon;
        public string Caption;
        public string Sub;
        bool hover;

        public BigButton()
        {
            SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer |
                ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw | ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, true);
            BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            Cursor = Cursors.Hand;
        }

        protected override void OnMouseEnter(EventArgs e) { hover = true; Invalidate(); base.OnMouseEnter(e); }
        protected override void OnMouseLeave(EventArgs e) { hover = false; Invalidate(); base.OnMouseLeave(e); }
        protected override void OnEnabledChanged(EventArgs e) { Invalidate(); base.OnEnabledChanged(e); }

        protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
        {
            var g = e.Graphics;
            g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
            g.TextRenderingHint = TextRenderingHint.ClearTypeGridFit;
            var rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, Width - 1, Height - 1);
            Color fill = !Enabled ? Color.FromArgb(55, 58, 68) : hover ? ControlPaint.Light(Fill, 0.15f) : Fill;
            using (var path = Rounded(rect, 16))
            using (var brush = new SolidBrush(fill))
                g.FillPath(brush, path);

            // glyph
            int gx = 22, gy = Height / 2 - 16, gs = 32;
            if (Moon)
            {
                using (var b = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(255, 205, 70))) g.FillEllipse(b, gx, gy, gs, gs);
                using (var b = new SolidBrush(fill)) g.FillEllipse(b, gx + 11, gy - 6, gs, gs);
            }
            else
            {
                using (var b = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(255, 214, 90))) g.FillEllipse(b, gx + 8, gy + 8, 16, 16);
                using (var p = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(255, 214, 90), 3f))
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                    {
                        double a = i * Math.PI / 4;
                        float cx = gx + 16, cy = gy + 16;
                        g.DrawLine(p, cx + (float)(Math.Cos(a) * 12), cy + (float)(Math.Sin(a) * 12),
                            cx + (float)(Math.Cos(a) * 16), cy + (float)(Math.Sin(a) * 16));
                    }
                }
            }
            using (var f = UiFont(14f, FontStyle.Bold))
                TextRenderer.DrawText(g, Caption, f, new Point(66, Height / 2 - 24), Enabled ? Color.White : Muted);
            using (var f = UiFont(9f, FontStyle.Regular))
                TextRenderer.DrawText(g, Sub, f, new Point(68, Height / 2 + 4), Enabled ? Color.FromArgb(215, 220, 232) : Muted);
        }
    }

        void Busy(bool busy)
        {
            offButton.Enabled = onButton.Enabled = connect.Enabled = !busy;
            Cursor = busy ? Cursors.WaitCursor : Cursors.Default;
        }

        void CheckConnection(string addr)
        {
            Busy(true);
            status.ForeColor = Muted;
            status.Text = "??瑼Ｘ?????銝凌?;
            string serial = null, problem = null;
            var worker = new System.ComponentModel.BackgroundWorker();
            worker.DoWork += delegate { serial = Check(addr, out problem); };
            worker.RunWorkerCompleted += delegate
            {
                Busy(false);
                if (serial != null)
                {
                    status.ForeColor = Green;
                    status.Text = "??撌脤??嚗? + serial;
                    if (address.Text.Trim().Length == 0) address.Text = serial;
                }
                else
                {
                    status.ForeColor = Red;
                    status.Text = "???芷??";
                    result.ForeColor = Red;
                    result.Text = problem;
                }
            };
            worker.RunWorkerAsync();
        }

        void Switch(string action)
        {
            Busy(true);
            result.ForeColor = Muted;
            result.Text = action == "off" ? "甇????Ｗ??? : "甇????Ｗ???;
            string message = null;
            bool ok = false;
            string addr = address.Text.Trim();
            var worker = new System.ComponentModel.BackgroundWorker();
            worker.DoWork += delegate { ok = Run(action, addr, out message); };
            worker.RunWorkerCompleted += delegate
            {
                if (ok)
                {
                    result.ForeColor = Green;
                    result.Text = "??" + message + "嚗? 蝘???嚗?;
                    closeTimer.Start();
                }
                else
                {
                    Busy(false);
                    result.ForeColor = Red;
                    result.Text = "??" + message;
                }
            };
            worker.RunWorkerAsync();
        }
    }
